        - ControlName: "BACKUP_RESOURCES_PROTECTED_BY_BACKUP_PLAN"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template that creates a serverless workflow using Step Functions to send custom events to a custom EventBridge event bus, with a rule forwarding all events to CloudWatch Logs."
Parameters:
  EventBusName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CustomEventBus"
    Description: "Name of the custom EventBridge event bus."
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: "/aws/events/custom-events"
    Description: "Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group for event debugging."
  StateMachineName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CustomEventSender"
    Description: "Name of the Step Functions state machine."
Resources:
  CustomLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 7
  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref EventBusName
  LogGroupResourcePolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: "EventBridgeToCloudWatchLogs"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: !GetAtt CustomLogGroup.Arn
  AllEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: "AllEventsToCloudWatchLogs"
      EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - prefix: ""
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt CustomLogGroup.Arn
          Id: "CloudWatchLogsTarget"
  StepFunctionsToEventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PutEventsToEventBridge
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
  CustomEventStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Ref StateMachineName
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsToEventBridgeRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Comment": "State machine that sends a custom event to the custom EventBridge bus",
            "StartAt": "SendCustomEvent",
            "States": {
              "SendCustomEvent": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::events:putEvents",
                "Parameters": {
                  "Entries": [
                    {
                      "EventBusName": "${EventBusArn}",
                      "Source": "custom.source",
                      "DetailType": "CustomDetailType",
                      "Detail": "{\"key1\": \"value1\", \"key2\": \"value2\"}"
                    }
                  ]
                },
                "End": true
              }
            }
          }
        - EventBusArn: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
Outputs:
  EventBusArn:
    Description: "ARN of the custom EventBridge event bus"
    Value: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Step Functions state machine"
    Value: !Ref CustomEventStateMachine
  LogGroupName:
    Description: "Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group"
    Value: !Ref LogGroupName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for AWS Cloud WAN global network and core network with centralized inspection, segments, network function group, attachment policies, and segment actions.

Parameters:
  GlobalNetworkName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyGlobalNetwork
    Description: Name for the global network.
  CoreNetworkName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyCoreNetwork
    Description: Name for the core network.
  InspectionTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: inspection
    Description: Tag key to identify inspection VPC attachments.
  InspectionTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Tag value for inspection VPC attachments.
  DomainTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: domain
    Description: Tag key whose value determines the segment association (production or development).

Resources:
  GlobalNetwork:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::GlobalNetwork
    Properties:
      Description: Global network for centralized outbound traffic inspection.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref GlobalNetworkName

  CoreNetwork:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::CoreNetwork
    Properties:
      GlobalNetworkId: !Ref GlobalNetwork
      Description: Core network with edge locations in multiple regions.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref CoreNetworkName

  PolicyLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CoreNetworkPolicyAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - networkmanager:PutCoreNetworkPolicy
                  - networkmanager:GetCoreNetworkPolicy
                  - networkmanager:GetCoreNetwork
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:networkmanager::${AWS::AccountId}:core-network/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*:*'

  PolicyFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PolicyLambdaRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.11
      Timeout: 600
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import json
          import time
          import traceback

          def handler(event, context):
              print('Received event:', json.dumps(event))
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              core_network_id = event['ResourceProperties']['CoreNetworkId']
              policy_document = event['ResourceProperties']['PolicyDocument']

              client = boto3.client('networkmanager')
              try:
                  if request_type in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      # Wait for core network to be AVAILABLE with retries
                      max_attempts = 60
                      for attempt in range(max_attempts):
                          try:
                              response = client.get_core_network(CoreNetworkId=core_network_id)
                              state = response['CoreNetwork']['State']
                              print(f'Core network state: {state}')
                              if state == 'AVAILABLE':
                                  break
                          except Exception as e:
                              print(f'Attempt {attempt}: {str(e)}')
                          time.sleep(10)
                      else:
                          raise Exception(f'Core network not AVAILABLE after {max_attempts * 10} seconds')

                      # Apply the policy
                      response = client.put_core_network_policy(
                          CoreNetworkId=core_network_id,
                          PolicyDocument=json.dumps(policy_document)
                      )
                      policy_version_id = response['CoreNetworkPolicy']['PolicyVersionId']
                      print('Policy applied successfully, version:', policy_version_id)

                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'PolicyVersionId': str(policy_version_id)})
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  print('Error occurred:', traceback.format_exc())
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})

  PolicyApplication:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt PolicyFunction.Arn
      CoreNetworkId: !Ref CoreNetwork
      PolicyDocument:
        coreNetworkPolicyVersion: '2022.06'
        segments:
          - name: production
            edgeLocations:
              - us-east-1
              - us-west-2
            isolateAttachments: true
            requireAttachmentAcceptance: false
          - name: development
            edgeLocations:
              - us-east-1
              - us-west-2
            isolateAttachments: false
            requireAttachmentAcceptance: true
        networkFunctionGroups:
          - name: inspection
            edgeLocations:
              - us-east-1
              - us-west-2
        attachmentPolicies:
          - ruleNumber: 10
            action:
              associationMethod: constant
              networkFunctionGroup: inspection
            conditions:
              - type: tag-value
                key: !Ref InspectionTagKey
                value: !Ref InspectionTagValue
          - ruleNumber: 20
            action:
              associationMethod: tag
              tagValueOfKey: !Ref DomainTagKey
            conditions:
              - type: tag-exists
                key: !Ref DomainTagKey
        segmentActions:
          - segment: production
            action: send-to
            destination: inspection
          - segment: development
            action: send-to
            destination: inspection

Outputs:
  GlobalNetworkId:
    Description: ID of the global network.
    Value: !Ref GlobalNetwork
  CoreNetworkArn:
    Description: ARN of the core network.
    Value: !GetAtt CoreNetwork.CoreNetworkArn
  PolicyVersionId:
    Description: Version ID of the applied core network policy.
    Value: !GetAtt PolicyApplication.PolicyVersionId

Description: "CloudFormation template to create an AWS Resource Access Manager resource share named MyResourceShare."
Parameters:
  ResourceShareName:
    Type: String
    Default: "MyResourceShare"
    Description: "Name of the RAM resource share."
  ResourceArns:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Comma-separated list of ARNs of the resources to share (e.g., ec2:subnet:*, rds:cluster:*). If not specified, no resources are shared initially."
  PrincipalArns:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Comma-separated list of principal ARNs to share with (e.g., AWS account IDs, OU ARNs, organization ARNs). If not specified, no principals are added."
  PermissionArns:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional comma-separated list of permission ARNs to associate with the resource share. If not specified, AWS-managed permissions will be used."
  AllowExternalPrincipals:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: "Specifies whether principals outside your AWS organization can access the shared resources."
Conditions:
  HasResourceArns: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ResourceArns, ""]]
  HasPrincipalArns: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PrincipalArns, ""]]
  HasPermissionArns: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PermissionArns, ""]]
  AllowExternalPrincipalsTrue: !Equals [!Ref AllowExternalPrincipals, "true"]
Resources:
  MyResourceShare:
    Type: AWS::RAM::ResourceShare
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ResourceShareName
      ResourceArns: !If
        - HasResourceArns
        - !Split [",", !Ref ResourceArns]
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Principals: !If
        - HasPrincipalArns
        - !Split [",", !Ref PrincipalArns]
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      PermissionArns: !If
        - HasPermissionArns
        - !Split [",", !Ref PermissionArns]
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      AllowExternalPrincipals: !If
        - AllowExternalPrincipalsTrue
        - true
        - false
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: !Ref ResourceShareName
Outputs:
  ResourceShareId:
    Description: "The ID of the RAM resource share."
    Value: !Ref MyResourceShare
  ResourceShareArn:
    Description: "The ARN of the RAM resource share."
    Value: !GetAtt MyResourceShare.Arn

Description: "CloudFormation template to create an Amazon ECR repository for the Strands Agent project with KMS encryption, image scanning on push, immutable tags, and a lifecycle policy retaining 10 images."
Parameters:
  RepositoryName:
    Type: String
    Default: agentic-sales-analyst
    Description: "Name of the ECR repository (must be unique in the region)."
Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for encrypting ECR repository images"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable root user full access"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow ECR to use the key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecr.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/ecr-${RepositoryName}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  ECRRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Ref RepositoryName
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: KMS
        KmsKey: !Ref KMSKey
      LifecyclePolicy:
        LifecyclePolicyText: |
          {
            "rules": [
              {
                "rulePriority": 1,
                "description": "Retain only 10 most recent images",
                "selection": {
                  "tagStatus": "any",
                  "countType": "imageCountMoreThan",
                  "countNumber": 10
                },
                "action": {
                  "type": "expire"

              }

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref RepositoryName
        - Key: Project

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Creates an IAM Access Analyzer named 'MyAccountAnalyzer' with archive rules for a trusted principal account and S3 buckets. Deletes any existing analyzer with the same name to avoid conflicts."
Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AccessAnalyzerManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - access-analyzer:CreateAnalyzer
                  - access-analyzer:DeleteAnalyzer
                  - access-analyzer:GetAnalyzer
                  - access-analyzer:TagResource
                  - access-analyzer:ListAnalyzers
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: LambdaBasicExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
  AnalyzerManagerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.11
      Timeout: 120
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import time

          client = boto3.client('accessanalyzer')

          def delete_analyzer(name):
              try:
                  client.get_analyzer(analyzerName=name)
                  client.delete_analyzer(analyzerName=name)
                  waiter = client.get_waiter('analyzer_deleted')
                  waiter.wait(analyzerName=name)
              except client.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                  pass

          def create_analyzer(properties):
              name = properties['AnalyzerName']
              delete_analyzer(name)
              create_params = {
                  'analyzerName': name,
                  'type': properties['Type']
              }
              if 'Tags' in properties:
                  tags = {tag['Key']: tag['Value'] for tag in properties['Tags']}
                  create_params['tags'] = tags
              if 'ArchiveRules' in properties:
                  create_params['archiveRules'] = properties['ArchiveRules']
              response = client.create_analyzer(**create_params)
              waiter = client.get_waiter('analyzer_created')
              waiter.wait(analyzerName=name)
              return response['arn']

          def handler(event, context):
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              properties = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              physical_resource_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', None)
              try:
                  if request_type == 'Create':
                      arn = create_analyzer(properties)
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'Arn': arn}, arn)
                  elif request_type == 'Update':
                      # Delete the old analyzer
                      if physical_resource_id:
                          old_name = physical_resource_id.split('/')[-1]
                          delete_analyzer(old_name)
                      # Create the new analyzer with updated properties
                      arn = create_analyzer(properties)
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'Arn': arn}, arn)
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      if physical_resource_id:
                          name = physical_resource_id.split('/')[-1]
                          delete_analyzer(name)
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS)
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})
  MyAccountAnalyzer:
    Type: Custom::AccessAnalyzer
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt AnalyzerManagerFunction.Arn
      AnalyzerName: "MyAccountAnalyzer"
      Type: ACCOUNT
      Tags:
        - Key: Kind
          Value: Dev
      ArchiveRules:
        - RuleName: ArchiveByPrincipalAccount
          Filter:
            - Property: principalAccount
              Eq:
                - "123456789012"
        - RuleName: ArchiveByBucket
          Filter:
            - Property: bucket
              Eq:
                - "docs-bucket"
                - "clients-bucket"
Outputs:
  AnalyzerArn:
    Description: "ARN of the created IAM Access Analyzer"
    Value: !GetAtt MyAccountAnalyzer.Arn
  AnalyzerName:
    Description: "Name of the created IAM Access Analyzer"
    Value: "MyAccountAnalyzer"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for serverless workflow monitoring EC2 state changes with Step Functions'

Parameters:
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    Description: Number of days to retain state machine execution logs
  StateMachineName:
    Type: String
    Default: EC2StateChangeHandler
    Description: Name for the Step Functions state machine

Resources:
  StepFunctionsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub '${StateMachineLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  EventBridgeInvokeStepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeStepFunctions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn

  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/stepfunctions/${StateMachineName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Ref StateMachineName
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: |-
        {
          "Comment": "EC2 State Change Handler",
          "StartAt": "ParseState",
          "States": {
            "ParseState": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "ResultPath": "$.detail.state",
              "InputPath": "$",
              "Next": "ChoosePath"
            },
            "ChoosePath": {
              "Type": "Choice",
              "Choices": [
                {
                  "Variable": "$.detail.state",
                  "StringEquals": "running",
                  "Next": "RunningLogic"
                },
                {
                  "Variable": "$.detail.state",
                  "StringEquals": "stopped",
                  "Next": "StoppedLogic"
                },
                {
                  "Variable": "$.detail.state",
                  "StringEquals": "terminated",
                  "Next": "TerminatedLogic"
                }
              ],
              "Default": "UnknownState"
            },
            "RunningLogic": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": "Business logic for running state placeholder",
              "End": true
            },
            "StoppedLogic": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": "Business logic for stopped state placeholder",
              "End": true
            },
            "TerminatedLogic": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": "Business logic for terminated state placeholder",
              "End": true
            },
            "UnknownState": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": "Unhandled state",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn

  EC2StateChangeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: 'Rule to capture EC2 instance state changes to running, stopped, or terminated'
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.ec2
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance State-change Notification
        detail:
          state:
            - running
            - stopped
            - terminated
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref StateMachine
          Id: StepFunctionsTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeStepFunctionsRole.Arn

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  LogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group for state machine logs
    Value: !Ref StateMachineLogGroup
  EventRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule
    Value: !GetAtt EC2StateChangeRule.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Creates an S3 bucket for CloudTrail logs, a Glue database, and a Glue crawler to catalog logs for Athena queries'
Parameters:
  BucketName:
    Description: 'Optional custom name for the S3 bucket. If empty, CloudFormation generates a unique name.'
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must be a valid S3 bucket name or empty for auto-generation'
Conditions:
  HasBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BucketName, '']]
Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: 'AWS::KMS::Key'
    Properties:
      Description: 'KMS key for S3 bucket encryption for CloudTrail logs'
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: 'key-policy'
        Statement:
          - Sid: 'Enable IAM User Permissions'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      Enabled: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: 'AWS::KMS::Alias'
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-s3-encryption-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
  S3Bucket:
    Type: 'AWS::S3::Bucket'
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - HasBucketName
        - !Ref BucketName
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KmsKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
  GlueDatabase:
    Type: 'AWS::Glue::Database'
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-kk-admin-db'
        Description: 'Glue database for cataloging CloudTrail logs'
  GlueCrawlerRole:
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::Role'
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3AndKmsAccessForGlueCrawler
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:GetObjectVersion'
                Resource: !Sub '${S3Bucket.Arn}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                Resource: !Sub '${S3Bucket.Arn}'
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    's3:prefix': 'cloud-trail/AWSLogs/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-glue-crawler-role'
  GlueCrawler:
    Type: 'AWS::Glue::Crawler'
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cloudtrail-crawler'
      Role: !GetAtt GlueCrawlerRole.Arn
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      Targets:
        S3Targets:
          - Path: !Sub 's3://${S3Bucket}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/'
      SchemaChangePolicy:
        UpdateBehavior: UPDATE_IN_DATABASE
        DeleteBehavior: DEPRECATE_IN_DATABASE
      Configuration: '{"Version":1.0,"CrawlerOutput":{"Partitions":{"AddOrUpdateBehavior":"InheritFromTable"}}}'
      TablePrefix: cloudtrail_
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 2 * * ? *)'
      RecrawlPolicy:
        RecrawlBehavior: CRAWL_EVERYTHING
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cloudtrail-crawler'
Outputs:
  BucketName:
    Description: 'Name of the S3 bucket for CloudTrail logs'
    Value: !Ref S3Bucket
  BucketArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the S3 bucket for CloudTrail logs'
    Value: !GetAtt S3Bucket.Arn
  GlueDatabaseName:
    Description: 'Name of the Glue database'
    Value: !Ref GlueDatabase
  GlueDatabaseArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the Glue database'
    Value: !Sub 'arn:aws:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:database/${GlueDatabase}'
  CrawlerName:
    Description: 'Name of the Glue crawler'
    Value: !Ref GlueCrawler
  CrawlerRoleArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the IAM role used by the Glue crawler'
    Value: !GetAtt GlueCrawlerRole.Arn
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the KMS key used for S3 bucket encryption'
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

        Statement:

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SchemaDiscovererPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - schemas:CreateDiscoverer
                  - schemas:DescribeDiscoverer
                  - schemas:DeleteDiscoverer
                  - schemas:ListDiscoverers
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: LambdaLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "arn:aws:logs:*:*:log-group:/aws/lambda/SchemaDiscovererFunction:*"
  SchemaDiscovererFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: "SchemaDiscovererFunction"
      Runtime: python3.14
      Role: !GetAtt SchemaDiscovererLambdaRole.Arn

      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3, cfnresponse, logging
          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Event: %s", event)
              client = boto3.client('schemas')
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              bus_arn = props.get('EventBusArn', '')
              phys_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', None)
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Create':
                      resp = client.create_discoverer(EventBusArn=bus_arn, Enabled=True, Description='Schema discoverer for retail demo store')
                      phys_id = resp['DiscovererId']
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'DiscovererId': phys_id}, phys_id)

                  logger.error("Error: %s", str(e))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)}, phys_id)

    Type: Custom::SchemaDiscoverer
    Properties:

      EventBusArn: !GetAtt RetailEventBus.Arn

    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: RetailDemoStore-eventbus
      Type: String

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Chaos Engineering Workflow: Terminate EC2, Wait, Check ECS Health, Alert via SNS'
Parameters:
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t2.micro
    AllowedValues:
      - t2.micro
      - t2.small
      - t2.medium
      - t3.micro
    Description: EC2 instance type for the ECS container instance
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet
  EcsClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: ChaosEcsCluster
    Description: Name for the ECS cluster
  EcsServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: ChaosService
    Description: Name for the ECS service
  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Desired number of ECS tasks
  HealthCheckWaitTime:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 600
    Description: Wait time in seconds before health check
  LatestAmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id
    Description: Latest ECS-optimized AMI ID
  SshCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block allowed for SSH access to EC2 instance
Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for SNS and EBS encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
      Enabled: true
  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/chaos-engineering-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ChaosVPC
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ChaosIGW
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ChaosSubnet
  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ChaosRouteTable
  Route:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
  EC2SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EC2 container instance and ECS tasks
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: !Ref SshCidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ChaosEC2SG
  ECSVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecs
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EC2SecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  ECRDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EC2SecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  ECRApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EC2SecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EC2SecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref RouteTable
  EC2Instance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    DependsOn: SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      NetworkInterfaces:
        - AssociatePublicIpAddress: true
          DeviceIndex: 0
          GroupSet:
            - !Ref EC2SecurityGroup
          SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref EC2InstanceProfile
      MetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpEndpoint: enabled
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            Encrypted: true
            KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      UserData:
        Fn::Base64: !Sub |
          #!/bin/bash
          echo ECS_CLUSTER=${EcsClusterName} >> /etc/ecs/ecs.config
          systemctl enable --now ecs
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ChaosEC2Instance
  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole
  EC2InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonEC2ContainerServiceforEC2Role
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EC2DescribePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: KMSAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Ref EcsClusterName
      CapacityProviders:
        - FARGATE
      DefaultCapacityProviderStrategy:
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE
          Base: 0
          Weight: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref EcsClusterName
  ECSTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: chaos-nginx
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSExecutionRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: nginx
          Image: nginx:latest
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ECSLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: nginx
  ECSExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KMSAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
  ECSLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /ecs/chaos-nginx
      RetentionInDays: 7
  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: EC2Instance
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      ServiceName: !Ref EcsServiceName
      TaskDefinition: !Ref ECSTaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: ENABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref Subnet
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref EC2SecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref EcsServiceName
  SNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: ChaosAlertTopic
      DisplayName: Chaos Engineering Alert
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
      Subscription:
        - Protocol: email
          Endpoint: admin@example.com
  LambdaTerminateRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EC2TerminatePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*
  LambdaTerminateFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: ChaosTerminateInstance
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaTerminateRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.14
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              instance_id = event['InstanceId']
              ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
              response = ec2.terminate_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps(f'Instance {instance_id} termination initiated')
              }
  LambdaHealthCheckRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ECSHealthCheckPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:DescribeServices
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref SNSTopic
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
  LambdaHealthCheckFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: ChaosHealthCheckService
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaHealthCheckRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.14
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SNSTopic
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3
          
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              cluster = event['ClusterName']
              service = event['ServiceName']
              ecs = boto3.client('ecs')
              sns = boto3.client('sns')
              
              response = ecs.describe_services(cluster=cluster, services=[service])
              service_info = response['services'][0]
              status = service_info['status']
              desired_count = service_info['desiredCount']
              running_count = service_info['runningCount']
              deployments = service_info.get('deployments', [])
              
              is_healthy = (status == 'ACTIVE' and running_count == desired_count)
              
              if not is_healthy:
                  message = f'ECS Service {service} in cluster {cluster} is unhealthy. Status: {status}, Desired: {desired_count}, Running: {running_count}'
                  sns.publish(
                      TopicArn=os.environ['SNS_TOPIC_ARN'],
                      Subject='Chaos Engineering Alert: ECS Service Unhealthy',
                      Message=message
                  )
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'body': json.dumps('Alert sent: Service unhealthy')
                  }
              else:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'body': json.dumps('Service is healthy')
                  }
  ChaosStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: ChaosEngineeringWorkflow
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "Chaos Engineering Workflow: Terminate EC2, Wait, Check ECS Health",
          "StartAt": "TerminateInstance",
          "States": {
            "TerminateInstance": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${LambdaTerminateFunction.Arn}",
              "Parameters": {
                "InstanceId.$": "$.InstanceId"
              },
              "Next": "WaitForHealthCheck"
            },
            "WaitForHealthCheck": {
              "Type": "Wait",
              "Seconds": ${HealthCheckWaitTime},
              "Next": "CheckServiceHealth"
            },
            "CheckServiceHealth": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${LambdaHealthCheckFunction.Arn}",
              "Parameters": {
                "ClusterName.$": "$.ClusterName",
                "ServiceName.$": "$.ServiceName"
              },
              "Next": "HealthDecision"
            },
            "HealthDecision": {
              "Type": "Choice",
              "Choices": [
                {
                  "Variable": "$.body",
                  "StringMatches": "*healthy*",
                  "Next": "SuccessState"
                }
              ],
              "Default": "AlertSentState"
            },
            "SuccessState": {
              "Type": "Succeed"
            },
            "AlertSentState": {
              "Type": "Succeed"
            }
          }
        }
  StepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:

        Version: '2012-10-17'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template to create a DevOps Agent Space with IAM roles, trust relationships, managed policies, monitoring account association, and relevant outputs."

    Description: "Source ARN for agent service role trust policy condition."

        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service: "aidevops.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "aws:SourceAccount": !Ref SourceAccountId
              ArnEquals:
                "aws:SourceArn": !Ref SourceArn

        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess"

            Version: "2012-10-17"

                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    "iam:AWSServiceName": "aidevops.amazonaws.com"
  OperatorApplicationRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-OperatorApplicationRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service: "aidevops.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "aws:SourceAccount": !Ref SourceAccountId
              ArnEquals:
                "aws:SourceArn": !Ref OperatorAppSourceArn
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess"
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-LambdaExecutionRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service: "lambda.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"

          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "iam:PassRole"
                  - "devops-guru:*"
                Resource: "*"
  CreateAgentSpaceFunction:

      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CreateAgentSpaceFunction"

      Handler: "index.lambda_handler"
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import uuid
          import os

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  request_type = event['RequestType']
                  props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
                  agent_space_name = props.get('AgentSpaceName', 'DefaultAgentSpace')
                  agent_role_arn = props.get('AgentRoleArn', '')
                  operator_role_arn = props.get('OperatorRoleArn', '')
                  account_id = props.get('AccountId', '')
                  region = os.environ.get('AWS_DEFAULT_REGION', context.invoked_function_arn.split(':')[3])
                  if request_type == 'Create':
                      agent_space_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
                      agent_space_arn = f"arn:aws:devops-guru:{region}:{context.invoked_function_arn.split(':')[4]}:agent-space/{agent_space_id}"
                      operator_url = f"https://{region}.console.aws.amazon.com/devops-guru/home?region={region}#/agent-space/{agent_space_id}"
                      response_data = {
                          'AgentSpaceId': agent_space_id,
                          'AgentSpaceArn': agent_space_arn,
                          'AgentSpaceName': agent_space_name,
                          'OperatorUrl': operator_url
                      }
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, response_data, agent_space_id)
                  elif request_type == 'Update':
                      physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', str(uuid.uuid4()))
                      agent_space_id = physical_id
                      agent_space_arn = f"arn:aws:devops-guru:{region}:{context.invoked_function_arn.split(':')[4]}:agent-space/{agent_space_id}"
                      operator_url = f"https://{region}.console.aws.amazon.com/devops-guru/home?region={region}#/agent-space/{agent_space_id}"
                      response_data = {
                          'AgentSpaceId': agent_space_id,
                          'AgentSpaceArn': agent_space_arn,
                          'AgentSpaceName': agent_space_name,
                          'OperatorUrl': operator_url
                      }
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, response_data, physical_id)
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})
  AgentSpace:
    Type: "AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource"
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt CreateAgentSpaceFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: "Creates SSM parameters, a Secrets Manager secret, and a Lambda function to demo parameter and secret retrieval."
Resources:
  Param1:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/${AWS::StackName}/param1"
      Type: String
      Value: "value1"
  Param2:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/${AWS::StackName}/param2"
      Type: String
      Value: "value2"
  DemoSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/${AWS::StackName}/demo-secret"
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username":"demo"}'
        GenerateStringKey: "password"
        PasswordLength: 16
        ExcludePunctuation: true
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMAndSecretsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                  - secretsmanager:ListSecrets
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: "*"
  DemoLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: ParameterStoreDemo
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
          secrets = boto3.client('secretsmanager')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              stack_name = os.environ.get('STACK_NAME')
              if not stack_name:
                  return {"statusCode": 400, "body": "STACK_NAME environment variable not set"}

              path = "/" + stack_name + "/"
              logger.info(f"Retrieving parameters under path: {path}")
              try:
                  params = []
                  paginator = ssm.get_paginator('get_parameters_by_path')
                  for page in paginator.paginate(Path=path, Recursive=True):
                      for param in page['Parameters']:
                          params.append(param['Name'])
                  logger.info(f"Parameters found: {params}")
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Error retrieving parameters: {e}")

              logger.info(f"Retrieving secrets with prefix: {path}")
              try:
                  secret_list = []
                  paginator = secrets.get_paginator('list_secrets')
                  for page in paginator.paginate(Filter=[{"Key":"name", "Values":[path]}]):
                      for secret in page['SecretList']:
                          secret_list.append(secret['Name'])
                  logger.info(f"Secrets found: {secret_list}")
                  for secret_name in secret_list:
                      try:
                          value = secrets.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret_name)
                          logger.info(f"Secret {secret_name} value: {value.get('SecretString', 'binary')[:50]}...")
                      except Exception as e:
                          logger.error(f"Error getting secret {secret_name}: {e}")
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Error listing secrets: {e}")

              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "Success"}
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STACK_NAME: !Ref AWS::StackName
Outputs:
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Description: "Lambda function name"
    Value: !Ref DemoLambda
  SecretName:
    Description: "Secret name"
    Value: !Ref DemoSecret

    Type: String
    Default: "5 minutes"
    Description: "Rate expression for CloudWatch Events rule (e.g., '5 minutes', '1 hour')"

  LambdaExecutionRole:

    Properties:

        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:

            Action: sts:AssumeRole

Parameters:
  LinuxProcessKeywords:
    Type: String
    Default: "CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached"
    Description: "Comma-separated list of process keywords to search for on Linux instances."
  WindowsProcessKeywords:
    Type: String
    Default: "sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached"
    Description: "Comma-separated list of process keywords to search for on Windows instances."
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: "rate(30 days)"
    Description: "Cron or rate expression for the SSM association schedule."

Resources:
  CustomInventoryDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Command
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "2.2"
        description: "Custom document to collect running database and caching process inventory."
        parameters:
          LinuxProcessKeywords:
            type: String
            description: "Comma-separated process keywords for Linux"
            default: "CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached"
          WindowsProcessKeywords:
            type: String
            description: "Comma-separated process keywords for Windows"
            default: "sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached"
        mainSteps:
          - action: aws:runShellScript
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Linux
            name: "CollectLinuxProcessInventory"
            inputs:
              runCommand: |
                #!/bin/bash
                KEYWORDS="{{ LinuxProcessKeywords }}"
                INVENTORY_DIR="/var/log/amazon/ssm/custom-inventory"
                INVENTORY_FILE="${INVENTORY_DIR}/CustomProcessInventory.json"
                mkdir -p "${INVENTORY_DIR}"
                # Get instance ID
                TOKEN=$(curl -s -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600")
                INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -s -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id)
                # Build regex pattern from comma-separated keywords
                PATTERN=$(echo "$KEYWORDS" | sed 's/,/|/g')
                # Get matching processes (skip grep itself)
                PROCESSES=$(ps aux | grep -E "$PATTERN" | grep -v grep | awk '{print "{\"User\":\""$1"\",\"PID\":"$2",\"CPU\":"$3",\"Memory\":"$4",\"Command\":\""$11"\"}"}' | paste -sd, -)
                # Build JSON content
                if [ -z "$PROCESSES" ]; then
                  PROCESSES="[]"
                else
                  PROCESSES="[$PROCESSES]"
                fi
                cat > "${INVENTORY_FILE}" << EOF
                {
                  "SchemaVersion": "1.0",
                  "TypeName": "Custom:ProcessInventory",
                  "Content": [
                    {
                      "InstanceId": "$INSTANCE_ID",
                      "Processes": $PROCESSES
                    }
                  ]
                }
                EOF
          - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Windows
            name: "CollectWindowsProcessInventory"
            inputs:
              runCommand: |
                $keywords = "{{ WindowsProcessKeywords }}"
                $inventoryDir = "$env:ProgramData\Amazon\SSM\Data\CustomInventory"
                $inventoryFile = Join-Path $inventoryDir "CustomProcessInventory.json"
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $inventoryDir | Out-Null
                # Get instance ID using metadata service
                $token = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put -Uri "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -Headers @{"X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds" = "21600"}
                $instanceId = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Get -Uri "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id" -Headers @{"X-aws-ec2-metadata-token" = $token}
                # Split keywords into array and build regex pattern
                $pattern = ($keywords -split ',' | ForEach-Object { [regex]::Escape($_.Trim()) }) -join '|'
                # Get matching processes
                $processes = Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match $pattern } | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, @{N='CPU';E={$_.CPU}}, @{N='StartTime';E={$_.StartTime.ToString('o')}}
                $content = @{
                    SchemaVersion = "1.0"
                    TypeName = "Custom:ProcessInventory"
                    Content = @(
                        @{
                            InstanceId = $instanceId
                            Processes = @($processes)
                        }
                    )
                }
                $content | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $inventoryFile

  CustomInventoryAssociation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Association
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref CustomInventoryDocument
      AssociationName: "Custom-Inventory-Processes"
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      Targets:
        - Key: "InstanceIds"
          Values:
            - "*"
      Parameters:
        LinuxProcessKeywords:
          - !Ref LinuxProcessKeywords
        WindowsProcessKeywords:
          - !Ref WindowsProcessKeywords

Outputs:
  DocumentName:
    Description: "Name of the SSM Command document created"
    Value: !Ref CustomInventoryDocument
  AssociationId:
    Description: "ID of the SSM Association"
    Value: !Ref CustomInventoryAssociation

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet1'
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet2'
  ColorTellerNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::HttpNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}.local'
  ColorTellerService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: colorteller
      NamespaceId: !Ref ColorTellerNamespace
  GatewayLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: colorgateway
      Scheme: internal
      Type: network
      IpAddressType: ipv4
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: load_balancing.cross_zone.enabled
          Value: 'true'
  BlueTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: colorteller-blue-tg
      Port: 9080
      Protocol: TCP
      TargetType: ip
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /ping
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 5
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 2
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 2
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
  GreenTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: colorteller-green-tg
      Port: 9080
      Protocol: TCP
      TargetType: ip
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /ping
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 5
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 2
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 2
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
  GatewayListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          ForwardConfig:
            TargetGroups:
              - TargetGroupArn: !Ref BlueTargetGroup
                Weight: 50
              - TargetGroupArn: !Ref GreenTargetGroup
                Weight: 50
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref GatewayLoadBalancer
      Port: 9080
      Protocol: TCP
  BlueCloudMapInstance:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Instance
    Properties:
      InstanceId: blue-node
      ServiceId: !Ref ColorTellerService
      InstanceAttributes:
        AWS_INSTANCE_PORT: '9080'
        AWS_INSTANCE_IPV4: '10.0.1.100'
  GreenCloudMapInstance:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Instance
    Properties:
      InstanceId: green-node
      ServiceId: !Ref ColorTellerService
      InstanceAttributes:
        AWS_INSTANCE_PORT: '9080'
        AWS_INSTANCE_IPV4: '10.0.2.100'
Outputs:
  GatewayDNSName:
    Value: !GetAtt GatewayLoadBalancer.DNSName
    Description: DNS name of the virtual gateway load balancer
  CloudMapServiceARN:
    Value: !GetAtt ColorTellerService.Arn
    Description: ARN of the Cloud Map service for colorteller
  BlueTargetGroupARN:
    Value: !Ref BlueTargetGroup
    Description: Target group for blue node
  GreenTargetGroupARN:
    Value: !Ref GreenTargetGroup
    Description: Target group for green node

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for creating private S3 buckets for a data processing pipeline with customer-managed KMS encryption

Parameters:
  CreateEMRLogBucket:
    Description: Whether to create an EMR log bucket
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'

Mappings:
  RegionToStorageClass:
    us-east-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    us-east-2:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    us-west-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    us-west-2:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    af-south-1:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    ap-east-1:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    ap-south-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    ap-northeast-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    ap-northeast-2:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    ap-northeast-3:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    ap-southeast-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    ap-southeast-2:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    ap-southeast-3:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    ca-central-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    eu-central-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    eu-west-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    eu-west-2:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    eu-west-3:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    eu-north-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    eu-south-1:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    me-south-1:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    sa-east-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    cn-north-1:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    cn-northwest-1:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    us-gov-east-1:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    us-gov-west-1:
      StorageClass: GLACIER

Conditions:
  CreateEMRLogBucketCondition:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: CreateEMRLogBucket
      - 'true'

Resources:
  BucketEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for S3 bucket encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                Fn::Sub: arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow S3 service to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
      Enabled: true

  BucketEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/data-pipeline-bucket-key
      TargetKeyId:
        Ref: BucketEncryptionKey

  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID:
                Ref: BucketEncryptionKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: DataPipelineLifecycleRule
            Status: Disabled
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass:
                  Fn::FindInMap:
                    - RegionToStorageClass
                    - Ref: AWS::Region
                    - StorageClass
                TransitionInDays: 90
            ExpirationInDays: 2555

  TargetBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID:
                Ref: BucketEncryptionKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: DataPipelineLifecycleRule
            Status: Disabled
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass:
                  Fn::FindInMap:
                    - RegionToStorageClass
                    - Ref: AWS::Region
                    - StorageClass
                TransitionInDays: 90
            ExpirationInDays: 2555

  EMRLogBucket:
    Condition: CreateEMRLogBucketCondition
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID:
                Ref: BucketEncryptionKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: DataPipelineLifecycleRule
            Status: Enabled
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass:
                  Fn::FindInMap:
                    - RegionToStorageClass
                    - Ref: AWS::Region
                    - StorageClass
                TransitionInDays: 90
            ExpirationInDays: 2555

  EMRLogBucketPolicy:
    Condition: CreateEMRLogBucketCondition
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket:
        Ref: EMRLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Stack that automatically disables IMDSv1 on EC2 instances when started, using EventBridge and SSM Automation"
Parameters:
  HttpPutResponseHopLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 64
    Description: "The hop limit for the HTTP PUT response from the instance metadata service. Valid range: 1-64."
Resources:
  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "AutomationExecutionPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
                Resource: "*"
      ManagedPolicyArns: []
  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "EventBridgeInvokeSSMAutomationPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
  EventBridgeRule:
    Type: "AWS::Events::Rule"
    Properties:
      Description: "Triggers SSM Automation to disable IMDSv1 on EC2 instances when they enter running state"
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.ec2
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance State-change Notification
        detail:
          state:
            - running
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata:$DEFAULT"
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn
          Id: "ConfigureEC2Metadata"
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              instanceId: "$.detail.instance-id"
            InputTemplate: !Sub |
              {
                "InstanceId": <instanceId>,
                "HttpTokens": "required",
                "HttpPutResponseHopLimit": ${HttpPutResponseHopLimit}
              }
Outputs:
  EventBridgeRuleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the EventBridge rule"
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeRule.Arn
  AutomationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the role used by SSM Automation"
    Value: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
  EventBridgeRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the role used by EventBridge to start automation"
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn
