AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Creates a scheduled Lambda function to clean expired items from a DynamoDB table named throttle. Uses Python 3.12 runtime, 5-minute timeout, hourly schedule by default, logs retained for 30 days.'
Parameters:
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Type: String
    Default: throttle
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table to clean.
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: rate(1 hour)
    Description: Schedule expression for Lambda trigger (e.g., rate(1 hour)). Set empty to disable the schedule.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Number of days to retain Lambda logs.
  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 900
    Description: Lambda function timeout in seconds.
  LambdaRuntime:
    Type: String
    Default: python3.12
    AllowedValues: [python3.12]
    Description: Lambda runtime identifier.
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: DynamoDBCleanupFunction
    Description: Name of the Lambda function.
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: id
    Description: Name of the partition key attribute in the DynamoDB table.
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: timestamp
    Description: Name of the sort key attribute in the DynamoDB table (used as expiration timestamp).
Conditions:
  HasSchedule: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ScheduleExpression, ""]]
Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${DynamoDBTableName}'
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: 'arn:aws:logs:*:*:*'
      RoleName: !Sub '${LambdaFunctionName}-Role'
  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunctionName
      Runtime: !Ref LambdaRuntime
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref DynamoDBTableName
          PARTITION_KEY: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          SORT_KEY: !Ref SortKeyName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import os
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          def handler(event, context):
              dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
              table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
              partition_key = os.environ.get('PARTITION_KEY', 'id')
              sort_key = os.environ.get('SORT_KEY', 'timestamp')

              table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)
              current_time = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

              deleted_count = 0
              last_evaluated_key = None
              while True:
                  scan_kwargs = {
                      'FilterExpression': boto3.dynamodb.conditions.Attr(sort_key).lte(current_time),
                      'Limit': 100
                  }
                  if last_evaluated_key:
                      scan_kwargs['ExclusiveStartKey'] = last_evaluated_key

                  response = table.scan(**scan_kwargs)
                  items = response.get('Items', [])
                  if items:
                      with table.batch_writer() as batch:
                          for item in items:
                              key = {partition_key: item[partition_key], sort_key: item[sort_key]}
                              batch.delete_item(Key=key)
                      deleted_count += len(items)

                  last_evaluated_key = response.get('LastEvaluatedKey')
                  if not last_evaluated_key:
                      break

              print(f'Deleted {deleted_count} expired items')
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': f'Deleted {deleted_count} items'
              }
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${LambdaFunctionName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
  EventRule:
    Condition: HasSchedule
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
          Id: !Ref LambdaFunctionName
  LambdaPermission:
    Condition: HasSchedule
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunctionName
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: events.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt EventRule.Arn
Outputs:
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the cleanup Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table being cleaned
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTableName
  ScheduleExpression:
    Description: Schedule expression for the Lambda trigger
    Value: !If [HasSchedule, !Ref ScheduleExpression, "No schedule (disabled)"]

      - ADVANCED_HD

    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:

    Default: Project
  CustomTagValue:

    Type: String
    Default: MyProject

        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey

    Type: AWS::IVS::StreamKey

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

      LogGroupName: !Sub "/ecs/${EcrRepoName}"

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

        Version: "2012-10-17"

            Action: sts:AssumeRole

            Version: "2012-10-17"

                  - ssmmessages:CreateDataChannel
                  - ssmmessages:OpenControlChannel
                  - ssmmessages:OpenDataChannel

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TaskExecutionRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Resources:
  TurbineAssetModel:
    Type: AWS::IoTSiteWise::AssetModel
    Properties:
      AssetModelName: TurbineAssetModel
      AssetModelDescription: "Asset model for a wind turbine in a wind farm demo"
      AssetModelProperties:
        - LogicalId: TurbineName
          Name: TurbineName
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
        - LogicalId: Location
          Name: Location
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
        - LogicalId: Torque
          Name: Torque
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type:
            TypeName: Measurement
        - LogicalId: WindSpeed
          Name: WindSpeed
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type:
            TypeName: Measurement
        - LogicalId: Power
          Name: Power
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type:
            TypeName: Measurement
        - LogicalId: OverdriveState
          Name: OverdriveState
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type:
            TypeName: Transform
            Transform:
              Expression: "gt(torque, 3)"
              Variables:
                - Name: torque
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: Torque
        - LogicalId: AvgWindSpeed
          Name: AvgWindSpeed
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: "avg(wind_speed)"
              Variables:
                - Name: wind_speed
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: WindSpeed
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
        - LogicalId: OverdriveTime
          Name: OverdriveTime
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: "sum(overdrive_state)"
              Variables:
                - Name: overdrive_state
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: OverdriveState
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
        - LogicalId: AvgPower
          Name: AvgPower
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: "avg(power)"
              Variables:
                - Name: power
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: Power
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
  WindFarmAssetModel:
    Type: AWS::IoTSiteWise::AssetModel
    Properties:
      AssetModelName: WindFarmAssetModel
      AssetModelDescription: "Asset model for a wind farm aggregating multiple turbine metrics"
      AssetModelProperties:
        - LogicalId: FarmName
          Name: FarmName
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
        - LogicalId: Location
          Name: Location
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
        - LogicalId: TotalAvgWindSpeed
          Name: TotalAvgWindSpeed
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: "avg(turbine)"
              Variables:
                - Name: turbine
                  Value:
                    HierarchyLogicalId: TurbineHierarchy
                    PropertyLogicalId: AvgWindSpeed
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
        - LogicalId: TotalOverdriveTime
          Name: TotalOverdriveTime
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: "sum(turbine)"
              Variables:
                - Name: turbine
                  Value:
                    HierarchyLogicalId: TurbineHierarchy
                    PropertyLogicalId: OverdriveTime
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
        - LogicalId: TotalAvgPower
          Name: TotalAvgPower
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: "avg(turbine)"
              Variables:
                - Name: turbine
                  Value:
                    HierarchyLogicalId: TurbineHierarchy
                    PropertyLogicalId: AvgPower
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m

        - LogicalId: TurbineHierarchy
          Name: TurbineHierarchy
          ChildAssetModelId: !Ref TurbineAssetModel
Outputs:

Description: 'CloudFormation template for two Cognito identity pools (Lambda and Step Functions) with unauthenticated identities and supporting IAM roles.'
Resources:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: PCI Compliance Automation Role and SSM Automation Documents
Resources:
  AutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "pciautomationassumerole-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PCIAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:ReleaseAddress
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
                  - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
                Resource: "*"

  RestrictDefaultSGDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Revoke all ingress and egress rules from default security groups.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Required) The ARN of the role that allows automation to perform the actions.
            default: !Sub '${AutomationRole.Arn}'
        mainSteps:
          - name: DescribeDefaultSecurityGroups
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeSecurityGroups
              Filters:
                - Name: group-name
                  Values:
                    - default
            outputs:
              - Name: SecurityGroups
                Selector: $.SecurityGroups
                Type: StringList
          - name: RevokeRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                import boto3
                ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                def handler(event, context):
                    sgs = event['SecurityGroups']
                    for sg in sgs:
                        group_id = sg['GroupId']
                        if sg.get('IpPermissions'):
                            ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(GroupId=group_id, IpPermissions=sg['IpPermissions'])
                        if sg.get('IpPermissionsEgress'):
                            ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(GroupId=group_id, IpPermissions=sg['IpPermissionsEgress'])
                    return {'Success': True}
              InputPayload:
                SecurityGroups: '{{ DescribeDefaultSecurityGroups.SecurityGroups }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.Payload.Success
                Type: Boolean

  DeleteUnusedSGDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Delete unused security groups (not associated with any resource and not default).
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Required) The ARN of the role that allows automation to perform the actions.
            default: !Sub '${AutomationRole.Arn}'
        mainSteps:
          - name: DescribeAllSecurityGroups
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeSecurityGroups
            outputs:
              - Name: SecurityGroups
                Selector: $.SecurityGroups
                Type: StringList
          - name: IdentifyUnusedSecurityGroups
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                import boto3
                ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                def handler(event, context):
                    sgs = event['SecurityGroups']
                    unused = []
                    for sg in sgs:
                        if sg['GroupName'] == 'default':
                            continue
                        enis = ec2.describe_network_interfaces(
                            Filters=[{'Name': 'group-id', 'Values': [sg['GroupId']]}]
                        )['NetworkInterfaces']
                        if not enis:
                            unused.append(sg['GroupId'])
                    return {'UnusedGroupIds': unused}
              InputPayload:
                SecurityGroups: '{{ DescribeAllSecurityGroups.SecurityGroups }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: UnusedGroupIds
                Selector: $.Payload.UnusedGroupIds
                Type: StringList
          - name: DeleteUnusedSecurityGroups
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                import boto3
                ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                def handler(event, context):
                    group_ids = event['UnusedGroupIds']
                    for group_id in group_ids:
                        ec2.delete_security_group(GroupId=group_id)
                    return {'DeletedCount': len(group_ids)}
              InputPayload:
                UnusedGroupIds: '{{ IdentifyUnusedSecurityGroups.UnusedGroupIds }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: DeletedCount
                Selector: $.Payload.DeletedCount
                Type: Integer

  ReleaseUnassociatedEIPDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Release all unassociated Elastic IP addresses.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Required) The ARN of the role that allows automation to perform the actions.
            default: !Sub '${AutomationRole.Arn}'
        mainSteps:
          - name: DescribeAddresses
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeAddresses
            outputs:
              - Name: Addresses
                Selector: $.Addresses
                Type: StringList
          - name: FilterUnassociatedAddresses
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def handler(event, context):
                    addresses = event['Addresses']
                    unassociated = []
                    for addr in addresses:
                        if addr.get('AssociationId') is None:
                            unassociated.append(addr['AllocationId'])
                    return {'UnassociatedAllocationIds': unassociated}
              InputPayload:
                Addresses: '{{ DescribeAddresses.Addresses }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: UnassociatedAllocationIds
                Selector: $.Payload.UnassociatedAllocationIds
                Type: StringList
          - name: ReleaseAddresses
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                import boto3
                ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                def handler(event, context):
                    allocation_ids = event['UnassociatedAllocationIds']
                    for allocation_id in allocation_ids:
                        ec2.release_address(AllocationId=allocation_id)
                    return {'ReleasedCount': len(allocation_ids)}
              InputPayload:
                UnassociatedAllocationIds: '{{ FilterUnassociatedAddresses.UnassociatedAllocationIds }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: ReleasedCount
                Selector: $.Payload.ReleasedCount
                Type: Integer

  UpdateASGHealthCheckDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Update an Auto Scaling group's health check type to ELB with a grace period of 300 seconds.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Required) The ARN of the role that allows automation to perform the actions.
            default: !Sub '${AutomationRole.Arn}'
          AutoScalingGroupName:
            type: String
            description: (Required) The name of the Auto Scaling group to update.
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateAutoScalingGroup
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: autoscaling
              Api: UpdateAutoScalingGroup
              AutoScalingGroupName: '{{ AutoScalingGroupName }}'
              HealthCheckType: ELB
              HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.ResponseMetadata.RequestId
                Type: String

Outputs:
  AutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for PCI automation
    Value: !GetAtt AutomationRole.Arn
  RestrictDefaultSGDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM document to restrict default security group
    Value: !Ref RestrictDefaultSGDoc
  DeleteUnusedSGDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM document to delete unused security groups
    Value: !Ref DeleteUnusedSGDoc
  ReleaseUnassociatedEIPDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM document to release unassociated Elastic IP addresses
    Value: !Ref ReleaseUnassociatedEIPDoc
  UpdateASGHealthCheckDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM document to update ASG health check type
    Value: !Ref UpdateASGHealthCheckDoc

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Parameters:
  TargetReplicaRegion:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS region to replicate CodeCommit repositories to
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-\d$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region code (e.g., us-east-1)
Resources:
  MirrorKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting CodeBuild artifacts and logs
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow S3 Service
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:s3:arn: !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${AWS::StackName}-artifacts-*
          - Sid: Allow CodeBuild
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
  MirrorKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${AWS::StackName}-mirror-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref MirrorKmsKey
  ArtifactsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-artifacts-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref MirrorKmsKey
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireArtifacts
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 30
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
  CodeBuildRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeCommitMirrorAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codecommit:GitPull
                  - codecommit:GitPush
                  - codecommit:GetRepository
                  - codecommit:BatchGetRepositories
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service
                  - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service
                  - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline
                  - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${TargetReplicaRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service
                  - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${TargetReplicaRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service
                  - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${TargetReplicaRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/codebuild/*:*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt MirrorKmsKey.Arn
  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EventBridgeCodeBuildAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: codebuild:StartBuild
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:codebuild:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:project/${AWS::StackName}-codebuild-mirror
  CodeBuildProject:
    Type: AWS::CodeBuild::Project
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-codebuild-mirror
      Description: Mirrors CodeCommit repositories from current region to replica region
      ServiceRole: !GetAtt CodeBuildRole.Arn
      EncryptionKey: !GetAtt MirrorKmsKey.Arn
      Source:
        Type: NO_SOURCE
        BuildSpec: |
          version: 0.2
          env:
            git-credential-helper: yes
          phases:
            install:
              runtime-versions:
                python: 3.8
              commands:
                - pip install git-remote-codecommit
            build:
              commands:
                - |
                  if [ -n "$REPOSITORY_NAME" ]; then
                    REPOS=("$REPOSITORY_NAME")
                  else
                    REPOS=("card-service" "rule-service" "ecs-pipeline")
                  fi
                  for REPO in "${REPOS[@]}"; do
                    echo "Mirroring $REPO from $AWS_DEFAULT_REGION to $TARGET_REPLICA_REGION"
                    git clone codecommit::$AWS_DEFAULT_REGION://$REPO
                    cd $REPO
                    git remote add target codecommit::$TARGET_REPLICA_REGION://$REPO
                    git push target --all
                    git push target --tags
                    cd ..
                    rm -rf $REPO
                  done
      Artifacts:
        Type: S3
        Location: !Ref ArtifactsBucket
        Path: build-output
        EncryptionDisabled: false
      Environment:
        Type: LINUX_CONTAINER
        ComputeType: BUILD_GENERAL1_SMALL
        Image: aws/codebuild/standard:7.0
        EnvironmentVariables:
          - Name: TARGET_REPLICA_REGION
            Value: !Ref TargetReplicaRegion
            Type: PLAINTEXT
        PrivilegedMode: false
      LogsConfig:
        S3Logs:
          Status: ENABLED
          Location: !Sub ${ArtifactsBucket}/logs
          EncryptionDisabled: false
      TimeoutInMinutes: 30
      QueuedTimeoutInMinutes: 60
      ConcurrentBuildLimit: 1
      BadgeEnabled: false
  CodeCommitEventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-codecommit-push-mainline
      Description: Triggers CodeBuild mirror on pushes to mainline branch
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        resources:
          - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service
          - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service
          - !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline
        detail:
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - mainline
          event:
            - referenceCreated
            - referenceUpdated
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn
          Id: CodeBuildTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              repo: $.detail.repositoryName
            InputTemplate: |
              {
                "environmentVariablesOverride": [
                  {
                    "name": "REPOSITORY_NAME",
                    "value": <repo>,
                    "type": "PLAINTEXT"
                  }
                ]
              }
Outputs:
  CodeBuildProjectName:
    Description: Name of the CodeBuild project
    Value: !Ref CodeBuildProject
  CodeBuildProjectArn:
    Description: ARN of the CodeBuild project
    Value: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn
  EventBridgeRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule
    Value: !GetAtt CodeCommitEventRule.Arn
  ArtifactsBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket for build artifacts and logs
    Value: !Ref ArtifactsBucket
  KmsKeyId:
    Description: KMS key ID used for encryption
    Value: !Ref MirrorKmsKey

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: testanu
    Description: Application name used for naming resources.
Resources:
  LogBucket:

      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import cfnresponse
          import boto3
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  request_type = event['RequestType']
                  properties = event['ResourceProperties']
                  hosted_zone_id = properties['HostedZoneId']
                  record_sets = json.loads(properties['RecordSets'])
                  acm_validation_name = properties.get('AcmValidationName', '')
                  acm_validation_value = properties.get('AcmValidationValue', '')

                  # Add ACM validation CNAME if provided
                  if acm_validation_name and acm_validation_value:
                      record_sets.append({
                          'Name': acm_validation_name,
                          'Type': 'CNAME',
                          'TTL': 60,
                          'ResourceRecords': [{'Value': acm_validation_value}]
                      })

                  # For delete, we must remove all records we created (UPSERT changes to DELETE)
                  if request_type == 'Delete':
                      # We need to delete the records we created. But we don't know if they still exist.
                      # We'll attempt to delete them, but ignore errors if they don't exist.
                      changes = [{'Action': 'DELETE', 'ResourceRecordSet': rs} for rs in record_sets]
                      route53 = boto3.client('route53')
                      try:
                          route53.change_resource_record_sets(
                              HostedZoneId=hosted_zone_id,
                              ChangeBatch={'Changes': changes}
                          )
                      except Exception:
                          pass  # Ignore deletion errors
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
                      return

                  # For create/update, UPSERT all records
                  changes = [{'Action': 'UPSERT', 'ResourceRecordSet': rs} for rs in record_sets]
                  route53 = boto3.client('route53')
                  route53.change_resource_record_sets(
                      HostedZoneId=hosted_zone_id,
                      ChangeBatch={'Changes': changes}
                  )
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: acm-validation-resolver
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.handler

      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import cfnresponse
          import boto3
          import time
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  request_type = event['RequestType']
                  if request_type == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
                      return

                  properties = event['ResourceProperties']
                  certificate_arn = properties['CertificateArn']
                  acm = boto3.client('acm')

                  max_retries = 20
                  for attempt in range(max_retries):
                      response = acm.describe_certificate(CertificateArn=certificate_arn)
                      cert = response['Certificate']
                      options = cert.get('DomainValidationOptions', [])
                      if options and options[0].get('ResourceRecord'):
                          option = options[0]
                          validation_name = option['ResourceRecord']['Name']
                          validation_value = option['ResourceRecord']['Value']
                          cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {
                              'ValidationName': validation_name,
                              'ValidationValue': validation_value
                          })
                          return
                      time.sleep(min(2 ** attempt, 4))

                  raise Exception('Failed to retrieve DNS validation records after retries')
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for Aurora Global Database failover automation infrastructure using SSM, Lambda, and Route 53 ARC'
Parameters:
  PrimaryRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: Primary region for the Aurora Global Database
  SecondaryRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    Description: Secondary region for the Aurora Global Database
  SSMDocumentName:
    Type: String
    Default: AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
    Description: Name for the SSM Automation document
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: TriggerFailover
    Description: Name for the Lambda function
  AutomationAssumeRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: SSMAutomationRole
    Description: Name for the IAM role assumed by SSM Automation
  LambdaExecutionRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: LambdaExecutionRole
    Description: Name for the IAM role assumed by Lambda
  GlobalClusterIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: my-global-cluster
    Description: Identifier of the Aurora Global Database cluster
  RoutingControlPrimaryArn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'arn:aws:route53-recovery-control::123456789012:controlpanel/placeholder/routingcontrol/primary'
    Description: ARN of the routing control for the primary region
  RoutingControlSecondaryArn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'arn:aws:route53-recovery-control::123456789012:controlpanel/placeholder/routingcontrol/secondary'
    Description: ARN of the routing control for the secondary region
  SecretName:
    Type: String
    Default: aurora-global-writer-endpoint
    Description: Name of the Secrets Manager secret to update with the writer endpoint
Resources:
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref AutomationAssumeRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonRDSFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/SecretsManagerReadWrite
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: Route53RecoveryControlConfigAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:DescribeRoutingControl
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:UpdateRoutingControl
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:ListRoutingControls
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:ListControlPanels
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:ListClusters
                Resource: '*'
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref LambdaExecutionRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMAutomationAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                  - ssm:StopAutomationExecution
                Resource: '*'
  SSMAutomationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: !Ref SSMDocumentName
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'Automation document for Aurora Global Database failover with Route 53 ARC routing control management and Secrets Manager updates'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          primaryRegion:
            type: String
            default: us-east-1
            description: Primary region for the Aurora Global Database
          secondaryRegion:
            type: String
            default: us-west-2
            description: Secondary region for the Aurora Global Database
          globalClusterIdentifier:
            type: String
            default: my-global-cluster
            description: Identifier of the Aurora Global Database cluster
          routingControlPrimaryArn:
            type: String
            default: 'arn:aws:route53-recovery-control::123456789012:controlpanel/placeholder/routingcontrol/primary'
            description: ARN of the routing control for the primary region
          routingControlSecondaryArn:
            type: String
            default: 'arn:aws:route53-recovery-control::123456789012:controlpanel/placeholder/routingcontrol/secondary'
            description: ARN of the routing control for the secondary region
          secretName:
            type: String
            default: aurora-global-writer-endpoint
            description: Name of the Secrets Manager secret to update with the writer endpoint
        mainSteps:
          - name: DetermineActiveRegion
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: 'Determine the active region by reading ARC routing control states'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                primaryRegion: '{{ primaryRegion }}'
                secondaryRegion: '{{ secondaryRegion }}'
                routingControlPrimaryArn: '{{ routingControlPrimaryArn }}'
                routingControlSecondaryArn: '{{ routingControlSecondaryArn }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import json

                def handler(event, context):
                    primary_region = event['primaryRegion']
                    secondary_region = event['secondaryRegion']
                    routing_control_primary_arn = event['routingControlPrimaryArn']
                    routing_control_secondary_arn = event['routingControlSecondaryArn']
                    
                    client = boto3.client('route53-recovery-control-config', region_name=primary_region)
                    
                    primary_state = client.describe_routing_control(RoutingControlArn=routing_control_primary_arn)
                    secondary_state = client.describe_routing_control(RoutingControlArn=routing_control_secondary_arn)
                    
                    primary_on = primary_state['RoutingControlState'] == 'On'
                    secondary_on = secondary_state['RoutingControlState'] == 'On'
                    
                    if primary_on and not secondary_on:
                        active_region = primary_region
                    elif secondary_on and not primary_on:
                        active_region = secondary_region
                    else:
                        active_region = primary_region
                    
                    return {
                        'ActiveRegion': active_region
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: ActiveRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.ActiveRegion
                Type: String
          - name: PerformGlobalClusterFailover
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: 'Perform the global cluster failover to the secondary region'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                primaryRegion: '{{ primaryRegion }}'
                secondaryRegion: '{{ secondaryRegion }}'
                activeRegion: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.ActiveRegion }}'
                globalClusterIdentifier: '{{ globalClusterIdentifier }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import json

                def handler(event, context):
                    primary_region = event['primaryRegion']
                    secondary_region = event['secondaryRegion']
                    active_region = event['activeRegion']
                    global_cluster_id = event['globalClusterIdentifier']
                    
                    if active_region == primary_region:
                        target_region = secondary_region
                    else:
                        target_region = primary_region
                    
                    rds = boto3.client('rds', region_name=target_region)
                    
                    response = rds.failover_global_cluster(
                        GlobalClusterIdentifier=global_cluster_id,
                        TargetRegion=target_region
                    )
                    
                    return {
                        'Success': True,
                        'GlobalClusterIdentifier': global_cluster_id,
                        'TargetRegion': target_region
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: Success
                Selector: $.Payload.Success
                Type: Boolean
          - name: FlipRoutingControlAndUpdateSecret
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: 'Flip ARC routing control states and update Secrets Manager secret with the new writer endpoint'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                primaryRegion: '{{ primaryRegion }}'
                secondaryRegion: '{{ secondaryRegion }}'
                activeRegion: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.ActiveRegion }}'
                routingControlPrimaryArn: '{{ routingControlPrimaryArn }}'
                routingControlSecondaryArn: '{{ routingControlSecondaryArn }}'
                secretName: '{{ secretName }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import json

                def handler(event, context):
                    primary_region = event['primaryRegion']
                    secondary_region = event['secondaryRegion']
                    active_region = event['activeRegion']
                    routing_control_primary_arn = event['routingControlPrimaryArn']
                    routing_control_secondary_arn = event['routingControlSecondaryArn']
                    secret_name = event['secretName']
                    
                    arc_client = boto3.client('route53-recovery-control-config', region_name=primary_region)
                    secrets_client = boto3.client('secretsmanager', region_name=primary_region)
                    rds = boto3.client('rds', region_name=primary_region)
                    
                    if active_region == primary_region:
                        new_active_region = secondary_region
                        arc_client.update_routing_control(
                            RoutingControlArn=routing_control_primary_arn,
                            RoutingControlState='Off'
                        )
                        arc_client.update_routing_control(
                            RoutingControlArn=routing_control_secondary_arn,
                            RoutingControlState='On'
                        )
                    else:
                        new_active_region = primary_region
                        arc_client.update_routing_control(
                            RoutingControlArn=routing_control_primary_arn,
                            RoutingControlState='On'
                        )
                        arc_client.update_routing_control(
                            RoutingControlArn=routing_control_secondary_arn,
                            RoutingControlState='Off'
                        )
                    
                    db_clusters = rds.describe_db_clusters(
                        Filters=[
                            {
                                'Name': 'db-cluster-id',
                                'Values': [event['globalClusterIdentifier']]
                            }
                        ]
                    )
                    
                    writer_endpoint = ''
                    for cluster in db_clusters['DBClusters']:
                        if cluster['DBClusterIdentifier'] == event['globalClusterIdentifier']:
                            writer_endpoint = cluster['Endpoint']
                            break
                    
                    secrets_client.update_secret(
                        SecretId=secret_name,
                        SecretString=json.dumps({
                            'writerEndpoint': writer_endpoint,
                            'region': new_active_region,
                            'timestamp': context.aws_request_id
                        })
                    )
                    
                    return {
                        'Success': True,
                        'NewActiveRegion': new_active_region,
                        'WriterEndpoint': writer_endpoint
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: Success
                Selector: $.Payload.Success
                Type: Boolean
  TriggerFailoverLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunctionName
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn

      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SSM_DOCUMENT_NAME: !Ref SSMDocumentName
          PRIMARY_REGION: !Ref PrimaryRegion
          SECONDARY_REGION: !Ref SecondaryRegion
          GLOBAL_CLUSTER_IDENTIFIER: !Ref GlobalClusterIdentifier
          ROUTING_CONTROL_PRIMARY_ARN: !Ref RoutingControlPrimaryArn

          SECRET_NAME: !Ref SecretName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |

          import json
          import os
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          ssm_client = boto3.client('ssm')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f'Received event: {json.dumps(event)}')
              
              document_name = os.environ.get('SSM_DOCUMENT_NAME', 'AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument')
              primary_region = os.environ.get('PRIMARY_REGION', 'us-east-1')
              secondary_region = os.environ.get('SECONDARY_REGION', '')
              global_cluster_id = os.environ.get('GLOBAL_CLUSTER_IDENTIFIER', '')
              routing_control_primary_arn = os.environ.get('ROUTING_CONTROL_PRIMARY_ARN', '')
              routing_control_secondary_arn = os.environ.get('ROUTING_CONTROL_SECONDARY_ARN', '')
              secret_name = os.environ.get('SECRET_NAME', '')
              
              primary_region = event.get('primaryRegion', primary_region)
              secondary_region = event.get('secondaryRegion', secondary_region)
              global_cluster_id = event.get('globalClusterIdentifier', global_cluster_id)
              routing_control_primary_arn = event.get('routingControlPrimaryArn', routing_control_primary_arn)
              routing_control_secondary_arn = event.get('routingControlSecondaryArn', routing_control_secondary_arn)
              secret_name = event.get('secretName', secret_name)
              
              if not secondary_region:
                  raise ValueError('secondaryRegion is required and must be provided via environment variable or event payload')
              if not routing_control_primary_arn:
                  raise ValueError('routingControlPrimaryArn is required')
              if not routing_control_secondary_arn:
                  raise ValueError('routingControlSecondaryArn is required')
              
              response = ssm_client.start_automation_execution(
                  DocumentName=document_name,
                  Parameters={
                      'primaryRegion': [primary_region],
                      'secondaryRegion': [secondary_region],
                      'globalClusterIdentifier': [global_cluster_id],
                      'routingControlPrimaryArn': [routing_control_primary_arn],
                      'routingControlSecondaryArn': [routing_control_secondary_arn],
                      'secretName': [secret_name]
                  }
              )
              
              automation_execution_id = response['AutomationExecutionId']
              logger.info(f'Started automation execution: {automation_execution_id}')
              
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({
                      'message': 'SSM Automation started successfully',
                      'automationExecutionId': automation_execution_id,
                      'documentName': document_name
                  })
              }

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Custom SSM Automation to enable VPC Flow Logs (reject traffic) with Change Manager integration, aligned with CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark"

Parameters:
  LogGroupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3653
    Description: "Retention days for CloudWatch Logs log group (default 10 years)"
  AutomationExecutionRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: "VpcFlowLogsAutomationExecutionRole"
    Description: "Name for the SSM Automation execution role"
  FlowLogRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: "VpcFlowLogsDeliveryRole"
    Description: "Name for the VPC Flow Logs delivery role"
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: "/aws/vpc/flowlogs/reject"
    Description: "Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group for flow logs"

Resources:
  ApprovalTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for SNS topic encryption for VPC Flow Logs change approvals"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow SNS Service to use key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: "SNS encryption for change approvals"

  ApprovalTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: "VpcFlowLogsChangeApproval"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt ApprovalTopicKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: "Change Manager approval notifications for VPC Flow Logs"

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogGroupRetentionDays

  FlowLogDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref FlowLogRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "WriteFlowLogsToCloudWatch"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${FlowLogsLogGroup}:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: "VPC Flow Logs delivery and automation assumption"

  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref AutomationExecutionRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "AutomationPermissions"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:StopAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:SendAutomationSignal
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: "SSM Automation execution for VPC Flow Logs"

  EnableVpcFlowLogsDirect:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: "EnableVpcFlowLogs-Direct"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Enable VPC Flow Logs for rejected traffic on a given VPC"
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: "The VPC ID to enable flow logs on"
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            default: !Ref LogGroupName
            description: "CloudWatch Logs log group name for flow logs"
          DeliveryRoleArn:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt FlowLogDeliveryRole.Arn
            description: "IAM role ARN for flow log delivery"
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
            description: "(Optional) IAM role ARN for automation execution"
        mainSteps:
          - name: "EnableFlowLogs"
            action: "aws:executeScript"
            description: "Enable VPC Flow Logs with REJECT traffic filter"
            timeoutSeconds: 300
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.10
              Handler: "enable_flow_logs"
              InputPayload:
                vpc_id: "{{ VpcId }}"
                log_group_name: "{{ LogGroupName }}"
                delivery_role_arn: "{{ DeliveryRoleArn }}"
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import time

                def enable_flow_logs(event, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    vpc_id = event['vpc_id']
                    log_group_name = event['log_group_name']
                    delivery_role_arn = event['delivery_role_arn']

                    filters = [
                        {'Name': 'resource-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]},
                        {'Name': 'traffic-type', 'Values': ['REJECT']}
                    ]
                    response = ec2.describe_flow_logs(Filters=filters)
                    existing = response.get('FlowLogs', [])
                    if existing:
                        return {'message': 'Flow log already exists', 'flow_log_id': existing[0]['FlowLogId']}

                    try:
                        resp = ec2.create_flow_logs(
                            ResourceIds=[vpc_id],
                            ResourceType='VPC',
                            TrafficType='REJECT',
                            LogGroupName=log_group_name,
                            DeliverLogsPermissionArn=delivery_role_arn
                        )
                        flow_log_id = resp['FlowLogIds'][0]
                        return {'message': 'Flow log created', 'flow_log_id': flow_log_id}
                    except Exception as e:
                        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to create flow log: {str(e)}")
            outputs:
              - Name: "Message"
                Selector: "$.Payload.message"
                Type: String
              - Name: "FlowLogId"
                Selector: "$.Payload.flow_log_id"
                Type: String

  EnableVpcFlowLogsChangeManaged:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: "EnableVpcFlowLogs-ChangeManaged"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Enable VPC Flow Logs for rejected traffic after change approval (via Change Manager)"
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: "The VPC ID to enable flow logs on"
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            default: !Ref LogGroupName
            description: "CloudWatch Logs log group name for flow logs"
          DeliveryRoleArn:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt FlowLogDeliveryRole.Arn
            description: "IAM role ARN for flow log delivery"
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
            description: "(Optional) IAM role ARN for automation execution"
          SnsArn:
            type: String
            default: !Ref ApprovalTopic
            description: "SNS topic ARN for approval notifications"
        mainSteps:
          - name: "RequestApproval"
            action: "aws:approve"
            description: "Submit change request for approval"
            timeoutSeconds: 3600
            inputs:
              Approvers:
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
              NotificationArn: "{{ SnsArn }}"
              Message: "Request to enable VPC Flow Logs (REJECT) on VPC {{ VpcId }}"
              MinRequiredApprovals: 1
          - name: "EnableFlowLogs"
            action: "aws:executeAutomation"
            description: "Execute the direct flow log enablement automation"
            inputs:
              DocumentName: !Ref EnableVpcFlowLogsDirect
              RuntimeParameters:
                VpcId: "{{ VpcId }}"
                LogGroupName: "{{ LogGroupName }}"
                DeliveryRoleArn: "{{ DeliveryRoleArn }}"
                AutomationAssumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"

Outputs:
  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: "CloudWatch Logs group for VPC flow logs"
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
  FlowLogDeliveryRoleArn:
    Description: "IAM role ARN for VPC flow log delivery"
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogDeliveryRole.Arn
  AutomationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: "IAM role ARN for SSM Automation execution"
    Value: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
  DirectAutomationDocumentName:
    Description: "SSM Automation document name for direct enablement"
    Value: !Ref EnableVpcFlowLogsDirect
  ChangeManagedAutomationDocumentName:
    Description: "SSM Automation document name for change-managed enablement"
    Value: !Ref EnableVpcFlowLogsChangeManaged
  ApprovalTopicArn:
    Description: "SNS topic ARN for change approval notifications"
    Value: !Ref ApprovalTopic

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: CloudFormation template to create a reusable Route53 delegation set using a custom resource backed by a Lambda function.
Parameters:
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: ReusableDelegationSet
    Description: Name of the Lambda function that manages the delegation set.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 3653
    Description: Retention period for CloudWatch logs (in days).
Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: Route53DelegationSetPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - route53:CreateReusableDelegationSet
                  - route53:DeleteReusableDelegationSet
                  - route53:GetReusableDelegationSet
                  - route53:ListReusableDelegationSets
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: LogPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                Resource: "*"
  ReusableDelegationSetFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunctionName
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import socket
          import logging
          import os

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          # Create log group with specified retention on first invocation
          LOG_GROUP_NAME = f"/aws/lambda/{os.environ.get('AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME', 'ReusableDelegationSet')}"
          RETENTION_DAYS = int(os.environ.get('LOG_RETENTION_DAYS', '14'))
          logs_client = boto3.client('logs')
          try:
              logs_client.create_log_group(logGroupName=LOG_GROUP_NAME)
          except logs_client.exceptions.ResourceAlreadyExistsException:
              pass
          try:
              logs_client.put_retention_policy(logGroupName=LOG_GROUP_NAME, retentionInDays=RETENTION_DAYS)
          except Exception as e:
              logger.warning(f"Could not set retention: {e}")

          def get_ips(hostname):
              ips_v4 = []
              ips_v6 = []
              try:
                  infos = socket.getaddrinfo(hostname, None)
                  for info in infos:
                      if info[0] == socket.AF_INET:
                          ips_v4.append(info[4][0])
                      elif info[0] == socket.AF_INET6:
                          ips_v6.append(info[4][0])
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.warning(f"Failed to resolve {hostname}: {e}")
              return (ips_v4[0] if ips_v4 else '', ips_v6[0] if ips_v6 else '')

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f"Received event: {event}")
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              properties = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              physical_resource_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', None)
              caller_reference = properties.get('CallerReference', '')

              client = boto3.client('route53')
              data = {}
              try:
                  if request_type == 'Create':
                      response = client.create_reusable_delegation_set(
                          CallerReference=caller_reference
                      )
                      delegation_set = response['DelegationSet']
                      delegation_set_id = delegation_set['Id']
                      name_servers = delegation_set['NameServers']
                      ns_data = {}
                      for i, ns in enumerate(name_servers[:4], start=1):
                          ipv4, ipv6 = get_ips(ns)
                          ns_data[f"NameServer{i}"] = ns
                          ns_data[f"NameServer{i}IPv4"] = ipv4
                          ns_data[f"NameServer{i}IPv6"] = ipv6
                      data['DelegationSetId'] = delegation_set_id
                      data.update(ns_data)
                      physical_resource_id = delegation_set_id
                  elif request_type == 'Update':
                      if physical_resource_id:
                          response = client.get_reusable_delegation_set(Id=physical_resource_id)
                          delegation_set = response['DelegationSet']
                          name_servers = delegation_set['NameServers']
                          ns_data = {}
                          for i, ns in enumerate(name_servers[:4], start=1):
                              ipv4, ipv6 = get_ips(ns)
                              ns_data[f"NameServer{i}"] = ns
                              ns_data[f"NameServer{i}IPv4"] = ipv4
                              ns_data[f"NameServer{i}IPv6"] = ipv6
                          data['DelegationSetId'] = physical_resource_id
                          data.update(ns_data)
                      else:
                          raise Exception("PhysicalResourceId not provided for Update")
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      if physical_resource_id:
                          client.delete_reusable_delegation_set(Id=physical_resource_id)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, data, physical_resource_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Error: {e}")
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {"Error": str(e)}, physical_resource_id)
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_RETENTION_DAYS: !Ref LogRetentionDays
  ReusableDelegationSetCustomResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ReusableDelegationSetFunction.Arn
      CallerReference: !Sub "${AWS::StackId}-DelegationSet"
Outputs:
  DelegationSetId:
    Value: !GetAtt ReusableDelegationSetCustomResource.DelegationSetId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DelegationSetId"
  NameServer1:
    Value: !GetAtt ReusableDelegationSetCustomResource.NameServer1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NameServer1"
  NameServer2:
    Value: !GetAtt ReusableDelegationSetCustomResource.NameServer2
    Export:

  NameServer3:

  NameServer4:

    Export:

  NameServer1IPv4:
    Value: !GetAtt ReusableDelegationSetCustomResource.NameServer1IPv4
    Export:

  NameServer1IPv6:

  NameServer2IPv6:

    Value: !GetAtt ReusableDelegationSetCustomResource.NameServer3IPv4

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    Description: API Gateway stage name for the WebSocket API
Resources:
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: WebSocketApi
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: "$request.body.action"
  ApiGatewayToStepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource:
                  Ref: StateMachine
  StepFunctionsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  Fn::GetAtt:
                    - SendMessageFunction
                    - Arn
  SendMessageFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: WebSocketSendMessageFunction
      Runtime: nodejs24.x
      Role:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - LambdaExecutionRole
          - Arn
      Handler: index.handler
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          const AWS = require('aws-sdk');
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            const { connectionId, message, apiEndpoint } = event;
            const apigw = new AWS.ApiGatewayManagementApi({
              endpoint: apiEndpoint
            });
            const params = {
              ConnectionId: connectionId,
              Data: JSON.stringify(message)
            };
            try {
              await apigw.postToConnection(params).promise();
              return { statusCode: 200, body: 'Message sent' };
            } catch (err) {
              console.error(err);
              throw err;
            }
          };
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ApiGatewayManagementPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: execute-api:Invoke
                Resource:
                  Fn::Sub: arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/POST/@connections/*
        - PolicyName: LogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: WebSocketResponseStateMachine
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - StepFunctionsExecutionRole
          - Arn
      DefinitionString: |
        {
          "Comment": "WebSocket response state machine",
          "StartAt": "WaitFiveSeconds",
          "States": {
            "WaitFiveSeconds": {
              "Type": "Wait",
              "Seconds": 5,
              "Next": "SendMessage"
            },
            "SendMessage": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke",
              "Parameters": {
                "FunctionName": "WebSocketSendMessageFunction",
                "Payload": {
                  "connectionId.$": "$.connectionId",
                  "message.$": "$.message",
                  "apiEndpoint.$": "$.apiEndpoint"
                }
              },
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }
  StepFunctionsIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId:
        Ref: WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri:
        Fn::Sub: arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution
      CredentialsArn:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - ApiGatewayToStepFunctionsRole
          - Arn
      RequestTemplates:
        application/json:
          Fn::Sub: |
            #set($body = $input.json('$'))
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine}",
              "input": "{\"connectionId\":\"$context.connectionId\",\"message\":$body,\"apiEndpoint\":\"https://$context.domainName/$context.stage\"}"
            }
  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId:
        Ref: WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: "$default"
      Target:
        Fn::Join:
          - /
          - - integrations
            - Ref: StepFunctionsIntegration
  WebSocketApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - DefaultRoute
      - StepFunctionsIntegration
    Properties:
      ApiId:
        Ref: WebSocketApi
      Description: Deployment for the WebSocket API
  WebSocketApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName:
        Ref: StageName
      ApiId:
        Ref: WebSocketApi
      DeploymentId:
        Ref: WebSocketApiDeployment
      DefaultRouteSettings:
        DetailedMetricsEnabled: false
        LoggingLevel: ERROR
        ThrottlingBurstLimit: 5000
        ThrottlingRateLimit: 10000
      AutoDeploy: true
Outputs:
  WebSocketUrl:
    Description: WebSocket API URL for clients to connect
    Value:
      Fn::Sub: wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value:
      Ref: StateMachine
