AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: Serverless API for content moderation using Amazon Rekognition
Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RekognitionAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                Resource: '*'
  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.11
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import urllib.error
          import io
          import os
          import boto3
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          rekognition = boto3.client('rekognition')
          MAX_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024  # 5 MB
          SUPPORTED_TYPES = {'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/jpg'}
          # JPEG magic: FF D8 FF, PNG magic: 89 50 4E 47
          MAGIC_JPEG = b'\xff\xd8\xff'
          MAGIC_PNG = b'\x89\x50\x4e\x47'

          def validate_image_format(data):
              if data[:3] == MAGIC_JPEG:
                  return 'image/jpeg'
              elif data[:4] == MAGIC_PNG:
                  return 'image/png'
              else:
                  return None

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
                  url = body.get('url')
                  if not url:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 400,
                          'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing URL in request body'})
                      }
              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 400,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Invalid JSON'})
                  }

              # Fetch image with size limit check
              try:
                  req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
                      content_length = response.headers.get('Content-Length')
                      if content_length and int(content_length) > MAX_SIZE:
                          return {
                              'statusCode': 413,
                              'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                              'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Image too large (max 5MB)'})
                          }
                      # Read in chunks to avoid exceeding memory
                      data = io.BytesIO()
                      total = 0
                      while True:
                          chunk = response.read(8192)
                          if not chunk:
                              break
                          total += len(chunk)
                          if total > MAX_SIZE:
                              return {
                                  'statusCode': 413,
                                  'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                                  'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Image too large (max 5MB)'})
                              }
                          data.write(chunk)
                      image_bytes = data.getvalue()
              except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': e.code,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': f'Failed to fetch image: HTTP {e.code}'})
                  }
              except urllib.error.URLError:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 404,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Image not found or URL unreachable'})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f'Error fetching image: {str(e)}')
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Internal server error while fetching image'})
                  }

              # Validate image format
              detected_type = validate_image_format(image_bytes)
              if not detected_type:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 415,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Unsupported image format. Only JPEG and PNG are allowed.'})
                  }

              # Call Rekognition
              try:
                  response = rekognition.detect_moderation_labels(
                      Image={'Bytes': image_bytes},
                      MinConfidence=60
                  )
                  labels = response.get('ModerationLabels', [])
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'moderationLabels': labels})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f'Rekognition error: {str(e)}')
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Content moderation service error'})
                  }
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*
  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: ContentModeration
      Description: API for image content moderation
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
  ApiRootMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        TimeoutInMillis: 29000
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: ApiRootMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      StageName: prod
Outputs:

    Description: URL of the ContentModeration API
    Value: !Sub https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CloudFormation template for scheduled AWS Organization account closure workflow.
  Creates an hourly EventBridge rule that triggers an EXPRESS Step Functions state machine.
  The state machine paginates through accounts tagged with 'organizations:account-closure':'REQUESTED',
  describes each account, and if ACTIVE, closes it using Organizations CloseAccount API,
  then tags the account with 'ACKNOWLEDGED'. Includes error handling, CloudWatch logging with 365-day retention,
  and least-privilege IAM roles.

Parameters:
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: 'rate(1 hour)'
    Description: Schedule expression for the EventBridge rule (e.g., rate(1 hour), cron(0 * * * ? *))
  LogGroupRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    Description: Retention period in days for CloudWatch Logs
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]

Resources:
  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vendedlogs/states/${AWS::StackName}-AccountClosureWorkflow'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogGroupRetentionInDays

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: OrganizationsReadClose
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                  - organizations:CloseAccount
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ResourceGroupsTaggingAPI
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - tag:GetResources
                  - tag:TagResources
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsAccessLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vendedlogs/states/${AWS::StackName}-AccountClosureWorkflow'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsAccessLogStream
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vendedlogs/states/${AWS::StackName}-AccountClosureWorkflow:log-stream:*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsManageDeliveries
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                Resource: '*'

  EventBridgeInvokeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeStateMachinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine

  AccountClosureStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    DependsOn: StateMachineLogGroup
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AccountClosureWorkflow'
      StateMachineType: EXPRESS
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Level: ALL
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: "Paginate through accounts tagged with organizations:account-closure:REQUESTED, close them if ACTIVE, and tag as ACKNOWLEDGED"
        StartAt: "Initialize"
        States:
          Initialize:
            Type: Pass
            Result:
              TagFilter:
                ResourceTypeFilters:
                  - "organizations:account"
                TagFilters:
                  - Key: "organizations:account-closure"
                    Values: ["REQUESTED"]
              ProcessedAccounts: []
            ResultPath: "$.Pagination"
            Next: "ListTaggedAccounts"
          ListTaggedAccounts:
            Type: Task
            Resource: "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:resourcegroupstaggingapi:getResources"
            Parameters:
              ResourceTypeFilters.$: "$.Pagination.TagFilter.ResourceTypeFilters"
              TagFilters.$: "$.Pagination.TagFilter.TagFilters"
              PaginationToken.$: "$.Pagination.NextToken"
              ResourcesPerPage: 50
            ResultPath: "$.ApiResult"
            Next: "ProcessAccounts"
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - "ResourceGroupsTaggingAPI.AWS.ResourceGroupsTaggingAPI.ThrottlingException"
                  - "ResourceGroupsTaggingAPI.AWS.ResourceGroupsTaggingAPI.TooManyRequestsException"
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 5
                BackoffRate: 2
            Catch:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - "States.ALL"
                ResultPath: "$.Error"
                Next: "HandleError"
          ProcessAccounts:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - Variable: "$.ApiResult.ResourceTagMappingList"
                IsPresent: true
                Next: "MapAccounts"
            Default: "CheckNextToken"
          MapAccounts:
            Type: Map
            Iterator:
              StartAt: "DescribeAccount"
              States:
                DescribeAccount:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:describeAccount"
                  Parameters:
                    AccountId.$: "$.AccountId"
                  ResultPath: "$.AccountInfo"
                  Next: "CheckStatus"
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - "Organizations.AWS.Organizations.ThrottlingException"
                        - "Organizations.AWS.Organizations.TooManyRequestsException"
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 5
                      BackoffRate: 2
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - "Organizations.AWS.Organizations.AccountNotFoundException"
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      MaxAttempts: 3
                      BackoffRate: 2
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - "States.ALL"
                      ResultPath: "$.Error"
                      Next: "SkipAccount"
                CheckStatus:
                  Type: Choice
                  Choices:
                    - Variable: "$.AccountInfo.Account.Status"
                      StringEquals: "ACTIVE"
                      Next: "CloseAccount"
                  Default: "SkipAccount"
                CloseAccount:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:closeAccount"
                  Parameters:
                    AccountId.$: "$.AccountId"
                  ResultPath: "$.CloseResult"
                  Next: "TagAccount"
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - "Organizations.AWS.Organizations.ThrottlingException"
                        - "Organizations.AWS.Organizations.TooManyRequestsException"
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 5
                      BackoffRate: 2
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - "Organizations.AWS.Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException"
                      IntervalSeconds: 10
                      MaxAttempts: 3
                      BackoffRate: 2
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - "States.ALL"
                      ResultPath: "$.Error"
                      Next: "SkipAccount"
                TagAccount:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:resourcegroupstaggingapi:tagResources"
                  Parameters:
                    ResourceARNList.$: "States.Array($$.Map.Item.Value.ResourceARN)"
                    Tags:
                      "organizations:account-closure": "ACKNOWLEDGED"
                  ResultPath: "$.TagResult"
                  Next: "AccountDone"
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - "ResourceGroupsTaggingAPI.AWS.ResourceGroupsTaggingAPI.ThrottlingException"
                        - "ResourceGroupsTaggingAPI.AWS.ResourceGroupsTaggingAPI.TooManyRequestsException"
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 5
                      BackoffRate: 2
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - "States.ALL"
                      ResultPath: "$.Error"
                      Next: "AccountDone"
                AccountDone:
                  Type: Pass
                  End: true
                SkipAccount:
                  Type: Pass
                  End: true
            ItemsPath: "$.ApiResult.ResourceTagMappingList"
            Parameters:
              AccountId.$: "States.ArrayGetItem(States.StringSplit($$.Map.Item.Value.ResourceARN, '/'), 2)"
            ResultPath: "$.MapResult"
            Next: "CheckNextToken"
          CheckNextToken:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - Variable: "$.ApiResult.PaginationToken"
                IsPresent: true
                Next: "PrepareNextPage"
            Default: "Success"
          PrepareNextPage:
            Type: Pass
            Parameters:
              NextToken.$: "$.ApiResult.PaginationToken"
              TagFilter.$: "$.Pagination.TagFilter"
              ProcessedAccounts.$: "$.Pagination.ProcessedAccounts"
            ResultPath: "$.Pagination"
            Next: "ListTaggedAccounts"
          Success:
            Type: Succeed
          HandleError:
            Type: Fail
            Cause: "Workflow failed due to unrecoverable error"

  AccountClosureEventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Triggers account closure state machine every hour
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeRole.Arn
          Id: TargetAccountClosureStateMachine
          Input: '{}'

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine
  EventRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule
    Value: !GetAtt AccountClosureEventRule.Arn
  LogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Log Group for state machine execution logs
    Value: !Ref StateMachineLogGroup

  UserPoolDomain:

      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
  GoogleOAuthSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret

        client_secret: !Sub '{{resolve:secretsmanager:${GoogleOAuthSecret}:SecretString:client_secret}}'
        authorize_scopes: profile email openid

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:

    Value: !Ref GoogleOAuthSecret
    Description: The ARN of the Secrets Manager secret containing Google OAuth credentials

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Security Hub automation rules to suppress accepted findings. Enables Security Hub if not already active."
Parameters:
  ExcludedUser1:
    Type: String
    Default: "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/placeholder1"
    Description: "ARN of the first human user to exclude from IAM finding suppression."
  ExcludedUser2:
    Type: String
    Default: "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/placeholder2"
    Description: "ARN of the second human user to exclude from IAM finding suppression."
  DesignatedSubAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: "123456789012"
    Description: "AWS account ID for CIS benchmark findings suppression."
  AccountForEBS:
    Type: String
    Default: "123456789012"
    Description: "AWS account ID for EBS default encryption finding suppression."
  AutomationAccount1:
    Type: String
    Default: "123456789012"
    Description: "First AWS account ID for unused credential/access key rotation suppression."
  AutomationAccount2:
    Type: String
    Default: "123456789012"
    Description: "Second AWS account ID for unused credential/access key rotation suppression."
Resources:
  EnableSecurityHub:
    Type: "AWS::SecurityHub::Hub"
    Properties: {}
  SuppressIAMFindingsExcludingUsers:
    Type: "AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule"
    DependsOn: EnableSecurityHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: "SuppressIAMFindingsExcludingUsers"
      RuleOrder: 1
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Description: "Suppresses IAM-related findings across the organization, excluding two specific human users."
      Criteria:
        GeneratorId:
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/iam-policy"
        ResourceId:
          - Comparison: NOT_EQUALS
            Value: !Ref ExcludedUser1
          - Comparison: NOT_EQUALS
            Value: !Ref ExcludedUser2
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: "IAM findings reviewed and accepted as expected."
              UpdatedBy: "AutomationRule"
  SuppressCISFindingsForSubAccount:
    Type: "AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule"
    DependsOn: EnableSecurityHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: "SuppressCISFindingsForSubAccount"
      RuleOrder: 2
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Description: "Suppresses CIS benchmark findings scoped to a designated sub-account."
      Criteria:
        AwsAccountId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref DesignatedSubAccountId
        GeneratorId:
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark"
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: "CIS findings for this account are reviewed and accepted."
              UpdatedBy: "AutomationRule"
  SuppressCISAndFSBPSpecificFindings:
    Type: "AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule"
    DependsOn: EnableSecurityHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: "SuppressCISAndFSBPSpecificFindings"
      RuleOrder: 3
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Description: "Suppresses specific CIS and AWS Foundational Security Best Practices findings organization-wide, including security groups, S3 buckets, and Config coverage."
      Criteria:
        GeneratorId:
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark"
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/aws-foundational-security-best-practices"
        Title:
          - Comparison: CONTAINS
            Value: "Security group allows unrestricted access"
          - Comparison: CONTAINS
            Value: "S3 bucket public read"
          - Comparison: CONTAINS
            Value: "S3 bucket HTTP"
          - Comparison: CONTAINS
            Value: "Config"
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: "Reviewed and accepted: security groups for bastion, public S3 buckets, and Config coverage."
              UpdatedBy: "AutomationRule"
  SuppressPublicAccessForKnownBuckets:
    Type: "AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule"
    DependsOn: EnableSecurityHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: "SuppressPublicAccessForKnownBuckets"
      RuleOrder: 4
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Description: "Suppresses public-access findings for a known list of intentionally public S3 buckets."
      Criteria:
        ResourceId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: "arn:aws:s3:::intentional-public-bucket-1"
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: "arn:aws:s3:::intentional-public-bucket-2"
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: "arn:aws:s3:::intentional-public-bucket-3"
        GeneratorId:
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/aws-foundational-security-best-practices"
        Title:
          - Comparison: CONTAINS
            Value: "S3 bucket public read"
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: "Bucket is intentionally public; reviewed and accepted."
              UpdatedBy: "AutomationRule"
  SuppressEBSDefaultEncryptionForAccount:
    Type: "AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule"
    DependsOn: EnableSecurityHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: "SuppressEBSDefaultEncryptionForAccount"
      RuleOrder: 5
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Description: "Suppresses EBS default-encryption finding for a specific account."
      Criteria:
        AwsAccountId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref AccountForEBS
        GeneratorId:
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/aws-foundational-security-best-practices"
        Title:
          - Comparison: CONTAINS
            Value: "EBS default encryption"
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: "EBS default encryption not required for this account; reviewed."
              UpdatedBy: "AutomationRule"
  SuppressUnusedCredentialsAndKeyRotation:
    Type: "AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule"
    DependsOn: EnableSecurityHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: "SuppressUnusedCredentialsAndKeyRotation"
      RuleOrder: 6
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Description: "Suppresses unused-credential and access-key-rotation findings for two accounts that run infrequent automation."
      Criteria:
        AwsAccountId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref AutomationAccount1
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref AutomationAccount2
        GeneratorId:
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/iam-policy"
        Title:
          - Comparison: CONTAINS
            Value: "Unused credential"
          - Comparison: CONTAINS
            Value: "Access key rotation"
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: "Accounts run infrequent automation; reviewed and accepted."
              UpdatedBy: "AutomationRule"
  SuppressGuardDutyCrossAccountBedrock:
    Type: "AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule"
    DependsOn: EnableSecurityHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: "SuppressGuardDutyCrossAccountBedrock"
      RuleOrder: 7
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Description: "Suppresses one specific GuardDuty finding type related to expected cross-account Bedrock API activity."
      Criteria:
        GeneratorId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: "arn:aws:securityhub:::product/aws/guardduty"
        Title:
          - Comparison: CONTAINS
            Value: "Cross-account Bedrock"
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: "Expected cross-account Bedrock API activity; reviewed and accepted."
              UpdatedBy: "AutomationRule"
Outputs:
  SecurityHubArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Security Hub hub (enabled or existing)."
    Value: !GetAtt EnableSecurityHub.ARN
  Rule1Id:
    Description: "Automation rule ID for IAM findings suppression."
    Value: !Ref SuppressIAMFindingsExcludingUsers
  Rule2Id:
    Description: "Automation rule ID for CIS findings in sub-account."
    Value: !Ref SuppressCISFindingsForSubAccount
  Rule3Id:
    Description: "Automation rule ID for CIS/FSBP specific findings."
    Value: !Ref SuppressCISAndFSBPSpecificFindings
  Rule4Id:
    Description: "Automation rule ID for known public buckets."
    Value: !Ref SuppressPublicAccessForKnownBuckets
  Rule5Id:
    Description: "Automation rule ID for EBS default encryption."
    Value: !Ref SuppressEBSDefaultEncryptionForAccount
  Rule6Id:
    Description: "Automation rule ID for unused credentials and key rotation."
    Value: !Ref SuppressUnusedCredentialsAndKeyRotation
  Rule7Id:
    Description: "Automation rule ID for GuardDuty cross-account Bedrock."
    Value: !Ref SuppressGuardDutyCrossAccountBedrock

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for bac-mcp-tool Lambda function and IAM roles for Bedrock AgentCore Gateway

Parameters:
  FunctionMemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    Description: Memory size for the Lambda function in MB
  FunctionTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    Description: Timeout for the Lambda function in seconds
  LogGroupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    Description: Retention days for the CloudWatch log group

Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: bac-mcp-tool-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaBedrockPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: LambdaCostExplorerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ce:GetCostAndUsage
                  - ce:GetCostForecast
                  - ce:GetDimensionValues
                  - ce:GetReservationUtilization
                  - ce:GetRightsizingRecommendation
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: LambdaS3Policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: LambdaLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/bac-mcp-tool:*"

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: bac-mcp-tool
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def handler(event, context):
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "Hello from bac-mcp-tool"}
      Timeout: !Ref FunctionTimeout
      MemorySize: !Ref FunctionMemorySize
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn

  FunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/bac-mcp-tool
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogGroupRetentionDays

  BedrockAgentCoreGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: bedrock-agentcore-gateway-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GatewayInvokeLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
        - PolicyName: GatewayManageBedrock
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: bedrock:*
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: GatewayPassRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:

        - PolicyName: GatewayS3Access

            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: GatewayLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/bac-mcp-tool:*"

Outputs:
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the bac-mcp-tool Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
  LambdaExecutionRoleArn:

  BedrockGatewayRoleArn:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for an automated EC2 Image Builder pipeline producing a CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM AMI with Elastic Beanstalk compatibility, daily builds, vulnerability scanning, 50 GB root volume, cross-account distribution, and 6-month lifecycle policy. Security hardened.'
Parameters:
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Description: 'AWS Organization ID (e.g., o-xxxxxxxxxx) for AMI launch permissions. Provide a valid organization ID.'
    Default: 'o-xxxxxxxxxx'
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
  DevAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: 'AWS account ID for the dev environment to share AMI with. Provide a valid 12-digit account ID.'
    Default: '123456789012'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
  ProdAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: 'AWS account ID for the prod environment to share AMI with. Provide a valid 12-digit account ID.'
    Default: '210987654321'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
  ParentImageArn:
    Type: String
    Description: 'ARN of the CIS hardened parent image'
    Default: 'arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:image/cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi/x.x.x'
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Cron expression for daily build schedule'
    Default: 'cron(0 6 * * ? *)'
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Description: 'EC2 instance type for building the image'
    Default: 'a1.large'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'a1.large'
      - 'a1.xlarge'
      - 'a1.2xlarge'
      - 'a1.4xlarge'
  AllowedSshCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: 'CIDR block allowed for SSH access to build instances'
    Default: '10.0.0.0/16'
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
Resources:
  S3KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: 'KMS key for S3 bucket encryption'
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: '*'
      Enabled: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
  S3KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-s3-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref S3KmsKey
  EcrRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-image-scan-results'
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      LifecyclePolicy:
        LifecyclePolicyText: '{"rules":[{"rulePriority":1,"description":"Expire old images","selection":{"tagStatus":"any","countType":"imageCountMoreThan","countNumber":100},"action":{"type":"expire"}}]}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-scan-repo'
  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/EC2ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceConnect
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderServicePermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
                  - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:CreateImage
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:StopInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeImageAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeKeyPairs
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeSpotPriceHistory
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResource
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:ListImages
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-service-role'
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceConnect
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderInstancePermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:ListImages
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-instance-role'
  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole
  LifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/EC2ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LifecycleCustomPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeImageAttribute
                  - imagebuilder:GetImage
                  - imagebuilder:ListImages
                  - imagebuilder:ListImageBuildVersions
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lifecycle-execution-role'
  ElasticBeanstalkComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-config'
      Description: 'Custom component to pre-configure Amazon Linux 2023 ARM for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility'
      Platform: 'Linux'
      Version: '1.0.0'
      ChangeDescription: 'Initial version'
      Data: |
        name: ElasticBeanstalkConfiguration
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: UpdateSystem
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf update -y
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: InstallCommonPackages
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y python3 python3-pip python3-devel gcc git curl wget unzip tar gzip bzip2 make openssl-devel bzip2-devel libffi-devel zlib-devel sqlite-devel nginx httpd-tools procps-ng which findutils
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: InstallEBPlatformPackages
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - pip3 install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
                    - pip3 install awsebcli botocore boto3 awscli
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: SetupNginx
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - systemctl enable nginx
                    - systemctl start nginx
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: ConfigureLogging
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - mkdir -p /var/log/nginx /var/log/app
                    - chmod 755 /var/log/nginx /var/log/app
                    - chown nginx:nginx /var/log/nginx
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: SetupCloudWatchAgent
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y amazon-cloudwatch-agent
                    - mkdir -p /opt/aws/amazon-cloudwatch-agent/etc
                    - cat > /opt/aws/amazon-cloudwatch-agent/etc/amazon-cloudwatch-agent.json << 'EOF'
                    - '{"logs":{"logs_collected":{"files":{"collect_list":[{"file_path":"/var/log/nginx/access.log","log_group_name":"/aws/elasticbeanstalk/nginx/access","log_stream_name":"{instance_id}","timestamp_format":"%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S %z"},{"file_path":"/var/log/nginx/error.log","log_group_name":"/aws/elasticbeanstalk/nginx/error","log_stream_name":"{instance_id}","timestamp_format":"%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S %z"},{"file_path":"/var/log/app/*.log","log_group_name":"/aws/elasticbeanstalk/app","log_stream_name":"{instance_id}","timestamp_format":"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"}]}}}}'
                    - systemctl enable amazon-cloudwatch-agent
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: SetupSysctl
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - echo "net.core.somaxconn = 1024" >> /etc/sysctl.conf
                    - echo "net.ipv4.tcp_fin_timeout = 30" >> /etc/sysctl.conf
                    - echo "net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse = 1" >> /etc/sysctl.conf
                    - echo "net.ipv4.tcp_tw_recycle = 0" >> /etc/sysctl.conf
                    - echo "net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time = 600" >> /etc/sysctl.conf
                    - echo "net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range = 1024 65535" >> /etc/sysctl.conf
                    - sysctl -p
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: ConfigureSecurity
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sed -i 's/^#PermitRootLogin.*/PermitRootLogin without-password/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config
                    - sed -i 's/^#PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config
                    - systemctl restart sshd
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: Cleanup
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf clean all
                    - rm -rf /var/cache/dnf/*
                    - rm -rf /tmp/*
                    - history -c
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: ValidateNginx
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - nginx -t
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: ValidatePython
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3 --version
                    - pip3 --version
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: ValidateDiskSpace
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - df -h /
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-component'
  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-eb-recipe'
      Description: 'CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM AMI with Elastic Beanstalk compatibility'
      Version: '1.0.0'
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageArn
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: '/dev/xvda'
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 50
            VolumeType: 'gp3'
            Encrypted: true
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-recipe'
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infra-config'
      Description: 'Infrastructure configuration for Image Builder pipeline'
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref InstanceType
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt BuildSecurityGroup.GroupId
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref BuildLogsBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/logs/'
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      ResourceTags:
        InstanceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-instance'
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infra-config'
  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder build instances (restricted egress)
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedSshCidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedSshCidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedSshCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-sg'
  BuildVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: '10.0.0.0/16'
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-vpc'
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      CidrBlock: '10.0.0.0/24'
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - '0'
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet'
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw'
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'
  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway
  BuildSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      CidrBlock: '10.0.1.0/24'
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - '0'
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-subnet'
  BuildSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  BuildLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref S3KmsKey
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireLogs
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 90
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-logs'
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-distribution-config'
      Description: 'Distributes AMI to current region with launch permissions to organization and accounts'
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-eb-ami-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: 'CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM AMI with Elastic Beanstalk compatibility'
            AmiTags:
              Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-eb-ami'
              Environment: 'Production'
              Compliance: 'CIS-Level1'
              Platform: 'Amazon-Linux-2023-ARM'
              ElasticBeanstalk: 'Enabled'
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
              UserIds:
                - !Ref DevAccountId
                - !Ref ProdAccountId
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-distribution-config'
  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-eb-pipeline'
      Description: 'Automated pipeline for CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM AMI with Elastic Beanstalk compatibility'
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 120
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: 'EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY'
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        EcrConfiguration:
          RepositoryName: !Ref EcrRepository
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pipeline'
  ImageLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lifecycle-policy'
      Description: 'Automatically deletes AMIs and snapshots after 6 months'
      ResourceType: 'AMI_IMAGE'
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecycleExecutionRole.Arn
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: 'DELETE'
          Filter:
            Type: 'AGE'
            Value: 180
            Unit: 'DAYS'
      ResourceSelection:
        Recipes:
          - Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-eb-recipe'
            SemanticVersion: '1.0.0'
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lifecycle-policy'
Outputs:
  PipelineArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the Image Builder pipeline'
    Value: !Ref ImagePipeline
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-arn'
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the image recipe'
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipe
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-recipe-arn'
  ComponentArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the Elastic Beanstalk configuration component'
    Value: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkComponent
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-component-arn'
  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the distribution configuration'
    Value: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-distribution-config-arn'
  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the infrastructure configuration'
    Value: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infra-config-arn'
  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the image lifecycle policy'
    Value: !Ref ImageLifecyclePolicy
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lifecycle-policy-arn'
  BuildVpcId:
    Description: 'VPC ID used for build instances'
    Value: !Ref BuildVpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-vpc-id'
  BuildSubnetId:
    Description: 'Subnet ID used for build instances'
    Value: !Ref BuildSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-subnet-id'
  ScanRepositoryUri:
    Description: 'ECR repository URI for vulnerability scan results'
    Value: !GetAtt EcrRepository.RepositoryUri
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-scan-repo-uri'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Serverless Maths MCP Server with API Gateway, Lambda, and Cognito Authentication'
Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment stage name for API Gateway
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name for the Cognito User Pool
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name for the Cognito User Pool App Client
Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      Schema:

  MathMcpFunction:

  ApiGatewayRestApi:

  ApiGatewayResourceMcp:

  ApiGatewayMethodGetRoot:

  ApiGatewayDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment

    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage
  LambdaPermissionApiGateway:

      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ApiGatewayRestApi}/*/POST/mcp'
Outputs:

  CognitoUserPoolId:

  CognitoUserPoolClientId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool Client ID
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient

Description: "CloudFormation template for nih-grants Cognito authentication infrastructure"
Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: nih-grants-user-pool
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      EmailVerificationMessage: "Your verification code is {####}"
      EmailVerificationSubject: "Your verification code"
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      UserAttributeUpdateSettings:
        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:
          - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 11
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
        EmailMessage: "Your verification code is {####}"
        EmailSubject: "Your verification code"
  CognitoUserPoolClientWeb:

      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_CUSTOM_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
  CognitoUserPoolClientGeneral:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: nih-grants-general-client

      GenerateSecret: true
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_CUSTOM_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH

      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days

        - COGNITO
  CognitoIdentityPool:

      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClientWeb

        - ClientId: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClientGeneral
          ProviderName: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true
  IAMRoleAuthenticated:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:

        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:

            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: nih-grants-s3-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:DeleteObjectTagging
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::nih-grants-context-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}/*"

              - Effect: Allow

        Statement:

        unauthenticated: !GetAtt IAMRoleUnauthenticated.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Serverless REST API for email submission via SES with API key, usage plan, and request validation using Lambda"

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: "The stage name for the API deployment (e.g., dev, prod)"
  ApiKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: email-apikey
    Description: "The name of the API key for authentication"
  SesRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: "The AWS region where Amazon SES is configured"

Resources:
  # Lambda function to send email via SES
  SendEmailFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: nodejs24.x
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          const AWS = require('aws-sdk');
          const ses = new AWS.SES({ region: process.env.SES_REGION });
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            try {
              const body = JSON.parse(event.body);
              const params = {
                Source: body.from,
                Destination: {
                  ToAddresses: body.to,
                  CcAddresses: body.cc || [],
                  BccAddresses: body.bcc || []
                },
                Message: {
                  Subject: { Data: body.subject || "No Subject" },
                  Body: {
                    Text: { Data: body.text },
                    Html: { Data: body.html }
                  }
                }
              };
              const result = await ses.sendEmail(params).promise();
              return {
                statusCode: 200,
                headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                body: JSON.stringify({ message: "Email sent successfully", requestId: result.MessageId })
              };
            } catch (err) {
              return {
                statusCode: 500,
                headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                body: JSON.stringify({ error: err.message })
              };
            }
          };
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SES_REGION: !Ref SesRegion

  # IAM role for Lambda to send emails via SES
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SendEmailPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ses:SendEmail
                Resource: "*"

  # REST API Gateway
  EmailApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: EmailSubmissionAPI
      Description: "REST API for email submission via Amazon SES"
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - EDGE

  # JSON schema model for request validation
  EmailModel:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Model
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailApi
      ContentType: application/json
      Name: EmailSubmissionModel
      Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          to:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
              format: email
            minItems: 1
          from:
            type: string
            format: email
          html:
            type: string
          text:
            type: string
          cc:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
              format: email
          bcc:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
              format: email
          subject:
            type: string
        required:
          - to
          - from
          - html
          - text
        additionalProperties: false

  # Request validator for the POST method
  RequestValidator:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RequestValidator
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailApi
      Name: body-validator
      ValidateRequestBody: true
      ValidateRequestParameters: false

  # POST method on the root resource
  PostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt EmailApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref RequestValidator
      RequestModels:
        application/json: !Ref EmailModel
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: "Empty"
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.X-Request-Id: false
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${SendEmailFunction.Arn}/invocations"
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.X-Request-Id: integration.response.header.X-Amzn-Trace-Id

  # Permission for API Gateway to invoke Lambda
  ApiGatewayInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt SendEmailFunction.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${EmailApi}/*/POST/"

  # API key for authentication
  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::ApiKey
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ApiKeyName
      Description: "API key for email submission endpoint"
      Enabled: true
      StageKeys: []

  # Deployment of the API (depends on the POST method)
  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailApi
      Description: "Deployment for email submission API"
    DependsOn:
      - PostMethod

  # Stage for the deployment
  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment
      Description: "Stage for email submission API"
      MethodSettings:
        - HttpMethod: POST
          ResourcePath: /
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 500
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 1000
          DataTraceEnabled: false
          MetricsEnabled: true
          LoggingLevel: INFO

  # Usage plan with throttling and quota
  UsagePlan:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan
    Properties:
      ApiStages:
        - ApiId: !Ref EmailApi
          Stage: !Ref StageName
      Description: "Usage plan for email submission API"
      Quota:
        Limit: 10000
        Period: MONTH
      Throttle:
        BurstLimit: 1000
        RateLimit: 500
    DependsOn:
      - Stage

  # Associate the API key with the usage plan
  UsagePlanKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlanKey
    Properties:
      KeyId: !Ref ApiKey
      KeyType: API_KEY
      UsagePlanId: !Ref UsagePlan

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: "The base URL of the API"
    Value: !Sub "https://${EmailApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}"
  ApiKeyId:
    Description: "The ID of the API key (retrieve value from AWS Console)"
    Value: !Ref ApiKey
  UsagePlanId:
    Description: "The ID of the usage plan"
    Value: !Ref UsagePlan

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Nested stack that subscribes multiple endpoint types to an existing SNS topic"
Parameters:
  TopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "ARN of the SNS topic to subscribe to (required; provide a non-empty value)"
  EmailAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: "no-email"
    Description: "Email address for email subscription (leave as 'no-email' to skip)"
  SqsQueueArn:
    Type: String
    Default: "no-sqs"
    Description: "ARN of the SQS queue for SQS subscription (leave as 'no-sqs' to skip)"
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Type: String
    Default: "no-lambda"
    Description: "ARN of the Lambda function for Lambda subscription (leave as 'no-lambda' to skip)"
  HttpsEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Default: "no-https"
    Description: "HTTPS endpoint URL for HTTPS subscription (leave as 'no-https' to skip)"
Conditions:
  HasTopicArn: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TopicArn, ""]]
  IsEmailProvided: !And [!Condition HasTopicArn, !Not [!Equals [!Ref EmailAddress, "no-email"]]]
  IsSqsProvided: !And [!Condition HasTopicArn, !Not [!Equals [!Ref SqsQueueArn, "no-sqs"]]]
  IsLambdaProvided: !And [!Condition HasTopicArn, !Not [!Equals [!Ref LambdaFunctionArn, "no-lambda"]]]
  IsHttpsProvided: !And [!Condition HasTopicArn, !Not [!Equals [!Ref HttpsEndpoint, "no-https"]]]
Resources:
  EmailSubscription:
    Condition: IsEmailProvided
    Type: "AWS::SNS::Subscription"
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      TopicArn: !Ref TopicArn
      Endpoint: !Ref EmailAddress
  SqsSubscription:
    Condition: IsSqsProvided
    Type: "AWS::SNS::Subscription"
    Properties:
      Protocol: sqs
      TopicArn: !Ref TopicArn
      Endpoint: !Ref SqsQueueArn
  LambdaSubscription:
    Condition: IsLambdaProvided
    Type: "AWS::SNS::Subscription"
    Properties:
      Protocol: lambda
      TopicArn: !Ref TopicArn
      Endpoint: !Ref LambdaFunctionArn
  HttpsSubscription:
    Condition: IsHttpsProvided
    Type: "AWS::SNS::Subscription"
    Properties:
      Protocol: https
      TopicArn: !Ref TopicArn
      Endpoint: !Ref HttpsEndpoint
      DeliveryPolicy:
        healthyRetryPolicy:
          numRetries: 3
          minDelayTarget: 1
          maxDelayTarget: 20
          numMinDelayRetries: 0
          numMaxDelayRetries: 0
          backoffFunction: exponential
          maxReceivesPerSecond: 5
Outputs:
  EmailSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: IsEmailProvided
    Value: !Ref EmailSubscription
    Description: "ARN of the email subscription"
  SqsSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: IsSqsProvided
    Value: !Ref SqsSubscription
    Description: "ARN of the SQS subscription"
  LambdaSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: IsLambdaProvided
    Value: !Ref LambdaSubscription
    Description: "ARN of the Lambda subscription"
  HttpsSubscriptionArn:
    Condition: IsHttpsProvided
    Value: !Ref HttpsSubscription
    Description: "ARN of the HTTPS subscription"
