AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Comprehensive QuickSight administrative monitoring and data pipeline environment with S3 data lake, Glue ETL jobs, CloudWatch metric streams, and Kinesis Firehose delivery."
Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: admin-console-cfn-dataprepare-code
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket for Glue ETL scripts.
  AdminBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Leave empty to auto-generate as admin-suite-{AccountId}"
  GlueScriptsPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: scripts/
    Description: S3 prefix for Glue ETL scripts.
Conditions:
  IsDefaultAdminBucket: !Equals [!Ref AdminBucketName, ""]
Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "CMK for admin-suite S3 buckets and encryption"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow AWS Services to use the key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - s3.amazonaws.com
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/admin-suite-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
  AdminS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If [IsDefaultAdminBucket, !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}", !Ref AdminBucketName]
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpirationInDays: 90
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KmsKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
  ScriptS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref ScriptBucketName
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KmsKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
  ScriptUploadRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ScriptUploadPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
      Path: /
  ScriptUploadFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt ScriptUploadRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 256
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3, cfnresponse
          s3 = boto3.client('s3')
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  request_type = event['RequestType']
                  bucket = event['ResourceProperties']['BucketName']
                  prefix = event['ResourceProperties'].get('Prefix', 'scripts/')
                  if request_type in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      script = """
          import sys, boto3
          from awsglue.transforms import *
          from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions
          from pyspark.context import SparkContext
          from awsglue.context import GlueContext
          from awsglue.job import Job

          args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME', 'S3_BUCKET', 'S3_PREFIX', 'PIPELINE'])
          sc = SparkContext()
          glueContext = GlueContext(sc)
          spark = glueContext.spark_session
          job = Job(glueContext)
          job.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)
          qs = boto3.client('quicksight')
          account_id = boto3.client('sts').get_caller_identity()['Account']
          pipeline = args['PIPELINE']
          items = []
          if pipeline == 'assets_access':
              paginator = qs.get_paginator('list_users')
              for page in paginator.paginate(AwsAccountId=account_id, Namespace='default'):
                  items.extend(page.get('UserList', []))
          elif pipeline == 'dataset_metadata':
              paginator = qs.get_paginator('list_data_sets')
              for page in paginator.paginate(AwsAccountId=account_id):
                  items.extend(page.get('DataSetSummaries', []))
          elif pipeline == 'folder_assets':
              paginator = qs.get_paginator('list_folders')
              for page in paginator.paginate(AwsAccountId=account_id):
                  for folder in page.get('FolderSummaryList', []):
                      members = qs.list_folder_members(AwsAccountId=account_id, FolderId=folder['FolderId']).get('MemberIdArnList', [])
                      for m in members:
                          items.append({'FolderId': folder['FolderId'], 'MemberArn': m})
          elif pipeline == 'q_metadata':
              topics = qs.list_topics(AwsAccountId=account_id).get('Topics', [])
              items.extend(topics)
          elif pipeline == 'datasource_properties':
              paginator = qs.get_paginator('list_data_sources')
              for page in paginator.paginate(AwsAccountId=account_id):
                  items.extend(page.get('DataSources', []))
          df = spark.createDataFrame(items)
          df.write.mode('overwrite').parquet(f\"s3://{args['S3_BUCKET']}/{args['S3_PREFIX']}{pipeline}/\")
          job.commit()
          """
                      s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=prefix + 'etl_script.py', Body=script.strip())
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      try:
                          s3.delete_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=prefix + 'etl_script.py')
                      except:
                          pass
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'Message': 'Script uploaded successfully'})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Message': str(e)})
  ScriptUploadCustomResource:
    Type: Custom::ScriptUploader
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ScriptUploadFunction.Arn

    DependsOn:

              - Effect: Allow

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for Puppet Quick Start VPC infrastructure'

Parameters:
  VPCCIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$

  SubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet
    Default: 10.0.0.0/19
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[9]|2[0-9]|3[0-2]))$

  PuppetIP:
    Type: String
    Description: IP address for puppet.example.com
    Default: 10.0.0.10
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$

  LinuxAgentIP:
    Type: String
    Description: IP address for linuxagent.example.com
    Default: 10.0.0.11
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$

  WindowsAgentIP:
    Type: String
    Description: IP address for windowsagent.example.com
    Default: 10.0.0.12
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$

Conditions: {}

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VPCCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetQuickStartVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetQuickStartIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetQuickStartPublicSubnet

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetQuickStartPublicRT

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet

  PrivateHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: example.com
      VPCs:
        - VPCId: !Ref VPC
          VPCRegion: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Private hosted zone for Puppet Quick Start

  PuppetRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PrivateHostedZone
      Name: puppet.example.com
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PuppetIP

  LinuxAgentRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PrivateHostedZone
      Name: linuxagent.example.com
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref LinuxAgentIP

  WindowsAgentRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PrivateHostedZone
      Name: windowsagent.example.com
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref WindowsAgentIP

Outputs:
  VPCID:
    Description: The ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPCID'

  SubnetID:
    Description: The ID of the public subnet
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SubnetID'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice with Cloud Map service discovery, VPC, and auto scaling
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the environment (e.g., dev, staging, prod)
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$
  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the microservice
    Default: my-service
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$
  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Description: Container image URI (e.g., nginx:latest)
    Default: nginx:latest
  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Description: Port on which the container listens
    Default: 80
  Cpu:
    Type: String
    Description: CPU units for the Fargate task (e.g., 256, 512)
    Default: '256'
    AllowedValues:
      - '256'
      - '512'
      - '1024'
      - '2048'
      - '4096'
  Memory:
    Type: String
    Description: Memory in MiB for the Fargate task (e.g., 512, 1024)
    Default: '512'
    AllowedValues:
      - '512'
      - '1024'
      - '2048'
      - '3072'
      - '4096'
  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Description: Desired number of tasks
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10
  CustomRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional IAM role ARN for the container to assume (leave blank if not needed)
    Default: ''
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
  PublicSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
Conditions:
  HasCustomRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomRoleArn, '']]
Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-vpc
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-igw
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-subnet
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-1
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-2
  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat-gateway
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-rt
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-rt
  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster
      CapacityProviders:
        - FARGATE
      DefaultCapacityProviderStrategy:
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE
          Weight: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster
  CloudMapNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${ServiceName}.local
      Description: Private DNS namespace for service discovery
      Vpc: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cloudmap-ns
  CloudMapService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      Description: Cloud Map service for ECS tasks
      DnsConfig:
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
      NamespaceId: !GetAtt CloudMapNamespace.Id
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cloudmap-svc
  EcsTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-exec-role
  EcsTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      Cpu: !Ref Cpu
      Memory: !Ref Memory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If [HasCustomRole, !Ref CustomRoleArn, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-log-group
  EcsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS tasks allowing intra-VPC traffic only
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 0
          ToPort: 65535
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-ecs-sg
  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref EcsTaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !GetAtt EcsSecurityGroup.GroupId
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt CloudMapService.Arn
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-ecs-svc
  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 2
      ResourceId: !Sub service/${EcsCluster}/${ServiceName}
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
  AutoScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ECSAutoScalingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:DescribeServices
                  - ecs:UpdateService
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-auto-scaling-role
  ScaleUpPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-up-policy
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 10
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 10
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 3
  ScaleDownPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-down-policy

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Self-contained AWS network backbone for hybrid interconnect demonstrations with OCI"
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC"
    Type: String
    Default: "10.94.0.0/16"
    AllowedPattern: "^(\\d{1,3}\\.){3}\\d{1,3}/\\d{1,2}$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid CIDR notation"
  SubnetCIDR:
    Description: "CIDR block for the private subnet"
    Type: String
    Default: "10.94.10.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: "^(\\d{1,3}\\.){3}\\d{1,3}/\\d{1,2}$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid CIDR notation within the VPC CIDR"
  InternalCIDR:
    Description: "Internal CIDR range allowed HTTPS inbound to the security group"
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/8"
    AllowedPattern: "^(\\d{1,3}\\.){3}\\d{1,3}/\\d{1,2}$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid CIDR notation"
  OCIBackboneCIDR:
    Description: "OCI backbone CIDR range allowed HTTPS outbound from the security group and routed via Transit Gateway"
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/8"
    AllowedPattern: "^(\\d{1,3}\\.){3}\\d{1,3}/\\d{1,2}$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid CIDR notation"
  CreateVPN:
    Description: "Flag to conditionally create Customer Gateway and VPN Connection to OCI"
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
  CustomerGatewayIp:
    Description: "Public IP address of the OCI Customer Gateway (required if CreateVPN is true)"
    Type: String
    Default: "0.0.0.0"
    AllowedPattern: "^(\\d{1,3}\\.){3}\\d{1,3}$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid IPv4 address"
  CustomerGatewayBgpAsn:
    Description: "BGP ASN for the Customer Gateway (required even for static routing)"
    Type: Number
    Default: 65000
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 4294967295
  TransitGatewayAsn:
    Description: "Amazon side ASN for the Transit Gateway"
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    MinValue: 64512
    MaxValue: 65534
  FlowLogsTrafficType:
    Description: "Type of traffic to capture for VPC Flow Logs"
    Type: String
    Default: "ALL"
    AllowedValues:
      - "ACCEPT"
      - "REJECT"
      - "ALL"
Conditions:
  CreateVPNCondition: !Equals [!Ref CreateVPN, "true"]
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPC"
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: "Hybrid Interconnect Demo"
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IGW"
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet"
  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable"
  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayAsn
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: "disable"
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: "disable"
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: "disable"
      DnsSupport: "enable"
      VpnEcmpSupport: "enable"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TGW"
  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TGW-RouteTable"
  TransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TGW-VPCAttachment"
  TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for hybrid interconnect allowing HTTPS from internal CIDR to OCI backbone"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalCIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SG"
  FlowLogsKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
  FlowLogsKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsKey"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKMSKey
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}"
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKMSKey
  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "flowlogs-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "logs:CreateLogStream"
                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogGroups"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogStreams"
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "kms:Encrypt"
                  - "kms:Decrypt"
                  - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
                  - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
                  - "kms:DescribeKey"
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKMSKey.Arn
  FlowLogs:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: !Ref FlowLogsTrafficType
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
  CustomerGateway:
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Properties:
      Type: "ipsec.1"
      BgpAsn: !Ref CustomerGatewayBgpAsn
      IpAddress: !Ref CustomerGatewayIp
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CGW"
  VPNConnection:
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Properties:
      Type: "ipsec.1"
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref CustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPN"
  VPNConnectionRoute:
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnectionRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR
      VpnConnectionId: !Ref VPNConnection
  TransitGatewayRouteForOCI:
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR
      VpnConnectionId: !Ref VPNConnection
Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: "ID of the created VPC"
    Value: !Ref VPC
  SubnetId:
    Description: "ID of the created private subnet"
    Value: !Ref Subnet
  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: "ID of the Transit Gateway"
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: "ID of the security group"
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroup
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Description: "CloudWatch Logs group for VPC Flow Logs"
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
  VPNConnectionId:
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    Description: "ID of the VPN Connection to OCI (if created)"
    Value: !Ref VPNConnection

    Type: String
    Default: "cron(0 0 * * ? *)"
    Description: "Cron expression for pipeline schedule (daily at midnight)."
  pRootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: "Root volume size in GB."
  pRootVolumeType:
    Type: String
    Default: "gp3"
    AllowedValues: [gp2, gp3, io1, io2, sc1, st1, standard]
    Description: "Root volume type."
  pVpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: "VPC ID for the build instance."
  pSubnetId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id
    Description: "Subnet ID for the build instance."
  pSecurityGroupIds:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Comma-separated list of security group IDs. Leave empty to create a default one."
  pLogBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "S3 bucket for Image Builder logs (must exist). Leave empty to disable logging."
  pDeprecateAgeDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: "Number of days after which AMIs are deprecated."

Conditions:
  UseDefaultSecurityGroup: !Equals [!Ref pSecurityGroupIds, ""]
  EnableLogging: !Not [!Equals [!Ref pLogBucketName, ""]]

Resources:
  ImageBuilderSecurityGroup:
    Condition: UseDefaultSecurityGroup
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for Image Builder build instances"
      VpcId: !Ref pVpcId
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      SecurityGroupIngress: []
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${pPipelineName}-sg"

  EC2ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3ReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderInstanceCustom
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                Resource: "*"
      Path: "/"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${pPipelineName}-instance-role"

  EC2ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2ImageBuilderInstanceRole
      Path: "/"

  EC2ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2ImageBuilderServiceRolePolicy
      Path: "/"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${pPipelineName}-service-role"

  EC2ImageBuilderLifecyclePolicyRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LifecyclePolicyExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - imagebuilder:GetImage
                  - imagebuilder:ListImages
                Resource: "*"
      Path: "/"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${pPipelineName}-lifecycle-role"

  ChefRecipeComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref pComponentName
      Platform: Linux
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: "Custom component to download Chef recipe from S3, run it, update SSM agent, and collect metadata."
      Data: !Sub
        - |
          name: ChefRecipeComponent
          description: Custom component for Chef recipe execution and metadata collection
          schemaVersion: 1.0
          phases:
            - name: build
              steps:
                - name: UpdateSSMAgent
                  action: ExecuteBash
                  inputs:
                    commands:
                      - sudo yum update -y amazon-ssm-agent
                - name: DownloadChefRecipe
                  action: ExecuteBash
                  inputs:
                    commands:
                      - aws s3 cp s3://${S3Bucket}/${S3Key} /tmp/chef-recipe.tar.gz
                      - tar -xzf /tmp/chef-recipe.tar.gz -C /tmp/chef-recipe
                - name: RunChefSolo
                  action: ExecuteBash
                  inputs:
                    commands:
                      - sudo chef-solo -c /tmp/chef-recipe/solo.rb -j /tmp/chef-recipe/attributes.json
                - name: CollectMetadata
                  action: ExecuteBash
                  inputs:
                    commands:
                      - aws ec2 describe-instances --instance-id $(curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id) > /tmp/metadata.json
        - {S3Bucket: !Ref pS3BucketName, S3Key: !Ref pS3Key}

  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref pRecipeName
      Version: 1.0.0
      ParentImage: "resolve-ssm:/aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id"
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref pRootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: !Ref pRootVolumeType
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ChefRecipeComponent

  InfraConfig:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref pInfraConfigName
      Description: "Infrastructure configuration with termination on failure"
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref EC2ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      SecurityGroupIds: !If [UseDefaultSecurityGroup, [!Ref ImageBuilderSecurityGroup], !Split [",", !Ref pSecurityGroupIds]]
      SubnetId: !Ref pSubnetId
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !If [EnableLogging, !Ref pLogBucketName, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

  DistConfig:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref pDistConfigName
      Description: "Distribution configuration to share AMI with current account in target region"
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref pTargetRegion
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: "{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}-{{ imagebuilder:buildVersion }}"
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref "AWS::AccountId"

  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref pPipelineName
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfraConfig
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistConfig
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref pScheduleExpression
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 1440
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true

  LifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref pLifecyclePolicyName
      Description: "Deprecates AMIs based on age"
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt EC2ImageBuilderLifecyclePolicyRole.Arn
      ResourceSelection:
        ResourceType: "AMI_IMAGE"
        TagMap:
          Deprecate: "true"
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: !Ref pDeprecateAgeDays

Outputs:
  PipelineArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Image Builder pipeline"
    Value: !Ref ImagePipeline
  ComponentArn:
    Description: "ARN of the custom component"
    Value: !Ref ChefRecipeComponent
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: "ARN of the image recipe"
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipe
  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: "ARN of the infrastructure configuration"
    Value: !Ref InfraConfig
  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: "ARN of the distribution configuration"
    Value: !Ref DistConfig
  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: "ARN of the lifecycle policy"
    Value: !Ref LifecyclePolicy

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for PII classification scanner using S3 Access Point, Lambda, Comprehend, DynamoDB, and SNS."

Parameters:
  AccessPointArn:
    Type: String
    Default: "arn:aws:s3:us-east-1:123456789012:accesspoint/placeholder"
    AllowedPattern: "^arn:aws:s3:[a-z0-9-]+:\\d{12}:accesspoint/[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$"
    Description: "ARN of the S3 Access Point to scan. Replace the placeholder with your actual ARN."
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^vpc-[0-9a-fA-F]{8,17}$"
    Description: "VPC ID where Lambda should be deployed (required if access point is VPC-scoped)"
  SubnetIds:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^subnet-[0-9a-fA-F]{8,17}(,subnet-[0-9a-fA-F]{8,17})*$"
    Description: "Comma-separated list of subnet IDs for Lambda VPC config"
  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^sg-[0-9a-fA-F]{8,17}$"
    Description: "Security group ID for Lambda VPC config"
  RouteTableIds:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^rtb-[0-9a-fA-F]{8,17}(,rtb-[0-9a-fA-F]{8,17})*$"
    Description: "Comma-separated list of route table IDs for Gateway VPC endpoints"
  CreateEndpoints:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: "Set to false if VPC already has required endpoints (S3, DynamoDB, Comprehend, SNS)"
  LambdaMemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
    Description: "Memory size for the scanner Lambda (MB)"
  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 900
    Description: "Timeout for the scanner Lambda (seconds)"
  ComprehendLanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: "en"
    AllowedValues: ["en", "es", "fr", "de", "it", "pt", "ar", "hi", "ja", "ko", "zh"]
    Description: "Language code for Comprehend PII detection"
  MaxFilesToScan:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10000
    Description: "Maximum number of files to scan per invocation"
  SnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^arn:aws:sns:[a-z0-9-]+:\\d{12}:[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$"
    Description: "Optional existing SNS topic ARN for notifications"

Conditions:
  HasVpc: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, ""]]
  HasSubnets: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SubnetIds, ""]]
  HasSg: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SecurityGroupId, ""]]
  HasRouteTables: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RouteTableIds, ""]]
  HasAllVpcResources: !And
    - !Condition HasVpc
    - !Condition HasSubnets
    - !Condition HasSg
    - !Condition HasRouteTables
  CreateEndpointsTrue: !Equals [!Ref CreateEndpoints, "true"]
  CreateEndpointsEnabled: !And
    - !Condition CreateEndpointsTrue
    - !Condition HasAllVpcResources
  SnsTopicProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SnsTopicArn, ""]]
  CreateSnsTopic: !Not [!Condition SnsTopicProvided]

Rules:
  VpcValidation:
    RuleCondition: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, ""]]
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SubnetIds, ""]]
        AssertDescription: "SubnetIds must be provided when VpcId is specified"
      - Assert: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SecurityGroupId, ""]]
        AssertDescription: "SecurityGroupId must be provided when VpcId is specified"
      - Assert: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RouteTableIds, ""]]
        AssertDescription: "RouteTableIds must be provided when VpcId is specified"

Resources:
  SnsTopicKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateSnsTopic
    Properties:
      Description: "CMK for SNS topic encryption"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      Enabled: true

  SnsTopicKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateSnsTopic
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/pii-scanner-sns-key-${AWS::StackName}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SnsTopicKmsKey

  ReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: "file_key"
          AttributeType: "S"
        - AttributeName: "scan_timestamp"
          AttributeType: "S"
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: "file_key"
          KeyType: "HASH"
        - AttributeName: "scan_timestamp"
          KeyType: "RANGE"
      BillingMode: "PAY_PER_REQUEST"
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      TableName: !Sub "pii-scanner-reports-${AWS::StackName}"

  ScannerLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ScannerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetAccessPoint
                Resource:
                  - !Ref AccessPointArn
                  - !Sub "${AccessPointArn}/object/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: !GetAtt ReportTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !If [SnsTopicProvided, !Ref SnsTopicArn, !Ref SnsTopic]
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
                Resource: "*"

  SnsTopicKmsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: CreateSnsTopic
    Properties:
      PolicyName: SnsTopicKmsPolicy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: !GetAtt SnsTopicKmsKey.Arn
      Roles:
        - !Ref ScannerLambdaExecutionRole

  ScannerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      Role: !GetAtt ScannerLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref ReportTable
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN: !Ref AccessPointArn
          COMPREHEND_LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref ComprehendLanguageCode
          MAX_FILES_TO_SCAN: !Ref MaxFilesToScan
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !If [SnsTopicProvided, !Ref SnsTopicArn, !Ref SnsTopic]
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3, os, json, datetime, logging, textwrap
          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
              access_point_arn = os.environ['ACCESS_POINT_ARN']
              language_code = os.environ.get('COMPREHEND_LANGUAGE_CODE', 'en')
              max_files = int(os.environ.get('MAX_FILES_TO_SCAN', 500))
              sns_topic_arn = os.environ.get('SNS_TOPIC_ARN', '')
              s3 = boto3.client('s3')
              s3control = boto3.client('s3control')
              comprehend = boto3.client('comprehend')
              dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
              table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)
              account_id = context.invoked_function_arn.split(':')[4]
              # Verify access point network origin
              try:
                  access_point_name = access_point_arn.split(':')[-1].split('/')[-1]
                  resp = s3control.get_access_point(AccountId=account_id, Name=access_point_name)
                  network_origin = resp['NetworkOrigin']
                  logger.info(f"Access point network origin: {network_origin}")
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Failed to get access point info: {e}")
                  raise
              paginator = s3.get_paginator('list_objects_v2')
              pages = paginator.paginate(Bucket=access_point_arn, MaxKeys=100)
              file_count = 0
              for page in pages:
                  if 'Contents' in page:
                      for obj in page['Contents']:
                          if file_count >= max_files:
                              break
                          key = obj['Key']
                          size = obj['Size']
                          if size == 0:
                              continue
                          # Read object content (sample first 100KB)
                          try:
                              resp = s3.get_object(Bucket=access_point_arn, Key=key, Range='bytes=0-102399')
                              text = resp['Body'].read().decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
                          except Exception as e:
                              logger.error(f"Failed to read {key}: {e}")
                              continue
                          # Detect PII using Comprehend
                          try:
                              pii_response = comprehend.detect_pii_entities(Text=text, LanguageCode=language_code)
                              entities = pii_response.get('Entities', [])
                              pii_found = len(entities) > 0
                          except Exception as e:
                              logger.error(f"Comprehend error for {key}: {e}")
                              pii_found = 'error'
                          # Write to DynamoDB
                          timestamp = datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
                          try:
                              table.put_item(Item={
                                  'file_key': key,
                                  'scan_timestamp': timestamp,
                                  'status': 'scanned',
                                  'pii_found': str(pii_found),
                                  'entity_count': len(entities) if isinstance(pii_found, bool) else -1
                              })
                          except Exception as e:
                              logger.error(f"DynamoDB put error for {key}: {e}")
                              continue
                          file_count += 1
                          logger.info(f"Scanned {key} - PII found: {pii_found}")
                  if file_count >= max_files:
                      break
              # Send SNS notification if configured
              if sns_topic_arn:
                  sns = boto3.client('sns')
                  sns.publish(TopicArn=sns_topic_arn, Message=f"Scan completed. Files scanned: {file_count}", Subject="PII Scanner Report")
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps(f'Scanned {file_count} files')}
      VpcConfig: !If
        - HasAllVpcResources
        - SubnetIds: !Split [",", !Ref SubnetIds]
          SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref SecurityGroupId]
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpointsEnabled
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Split [",", !Ref RouteTableIds]

  DynamoDBGatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpointsEnabled
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Split [",", !Ref RouteTableIds]

  ComprehendInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpointsEnabled
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.comprehend"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds: !Split [",", !Ref SubnetIds]
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref SecurityGroupId]
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SNSInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpointsEnabled
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sns"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds: !Split [",", !Ref SubnetIds]
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref SecurityGroupId]
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SnsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: CreateSnsTopic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "pii-scanner-notifications-${AWS::StackName}"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SnsTopicKmsKey

Outputs:
  ScannerFunctionArn:
    Description: "ARN of the scanner Lambda function"
    Value: !GetAtt ScannerFunction.Arn
  ReportTableName:
    Description: "Name of the DynamoDB table for scan reports"
    Value: !Ref ReportTable
  ExampleInvocationCommand:
    Description: "Example AWS CLI command to invoke the scanner function"
    Value: !Sub "aws lambda invoke --function-name ${ScannerFunction} --payload '{}' response.json"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for Glue databases and tables for property graph and RDF data."

Parameters:
  GraphDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database
    Description: "Name of the Glue database for property graph (LPG) tables."
  RdfDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database-rdf
    Description: "Name of the Glue database for RDF tables."
  FieldDelimiter:
    Type: String
    Default: ","
    Description: "Field delimiter for Glue tables."

Resources:
  # Glue Databases
  GraphDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref GraphDatabaseName
        Description: "Database for property graph (LPG) tables."

  RdfDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref RdfDatabaseName
        Description: "Database for RDF tables."

  # LPG Tables
  AirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GraphDatabase
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabaseName
      TableInput:
        Name: airport
        Description: "Airport vertices."
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          graph_label: "vertex"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: airport_code
              Type: string
            - Name: name
              Type: string
            - Name: city
              Type: string
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: latitude
              Type: double
            - Name: longitude
              Type: double
            - Name: elevation
              Type: int
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: !Ref FieldDelimiter
          Location: ""

  CountryTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GraphDatabase
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabaseName
      TableInput:
        Name: country
        Description: "Country vertices."
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          graph_label: "vertex"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: name
              Type: string
            - Name: continent
              Type: string
            - Name: population
              Type: int
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: !Ref FieldDelimiter
          Location: ""

  ContinentTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GraphDatabase
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabaseName
      TableInput:
        Name: continent
        Description: "Continent vertices."
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          graph_label: "vertex"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: name
              Type: string
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: !Ref FieldDelimiter
          Location: ""

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GraphDatabase
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabaseName
      TableInput:
        Name: route
        Description: "Route edges."
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          graph_label: "edge"
          gremlin_query: "g.V().hasLabel('airport').outE('route').inV().path().by('airport_code').limit(10)"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: source_airport
              Type: string
            - Name: destination_airport
              Type: string
            - Name: distance
              Type: int
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: !Ref FieldDelimiter
          Location: ""

  CustomairportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: GraphDatabase
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabaseName
      TableInput:
        Name: customairport
        Description: "Custom airport view."
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          graph_label: "view"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: airport_code
              Type: string
            - Name: name
              Type: string
            - Name: city
              Type: string
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: latitude
              Type: double
            - Name: longitude
              Type: double
            - Name: elevation
              Type: int
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: !Ref FieldDelimiter
          Location: ""

  # RDF Tables
  AirportRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: RdfDatabase
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref RdfDatabaseName
      TableInput:
        Name: airport_rdf
        Description: "Airport RDF table with class query mode."
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classuri: "class:Airport"
          querymode: "class"
          rdf_type: "true"
          strip_uri_prefixes: "true"
          class_namespace_uri: "http://www.semanticweb.org/air-routes/ontologies/2015/06/air-routes#"
          datatype_property_namespace_uri: "http://www.semanticweb.org/air-routes/ontologies/2015/06/air-routes#"
          object_property_namespace_uri: "http://www.semanticweb.org/air-routes/ontologies/2015/06/air-routes#"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: airport_code
              Type: string
            - Name: name
              Type: string
            - Name: city
              Type: string
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: latitude
              Type: double
            - Name: longitude
              Type: double
            - Name: elevation
              Type: int
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: !Ref FieldDelimiter
          Location: ""

  RouteRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: RdfDatabase
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref RdfDatabaseName
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf
        Description: "Route RDF table with SPARQL query using prefixes."
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          querymode: "sparql"
          rdf_type: "true"
          strip_uri_prefixes: "true"
          class_namespace_uri: "http://www.semanticweb.org/air-routes/ontologies/2015/06/air-routes#"
          datatype_property_namespace_uri: "http://www.semanticweb.org/air-routes/ontologies/2015/06/air-routes#"
          object_property_namespace_uri: "http://www.semanticweb.org/air-routes/ontologies/2015/06/air-routes#"
          sparql_query: >
            PREFIX air: <http://www.semanticweb.org/air-routes/ontologies/2015/06/air-routes#>
            SELECT ?incode ?outcode ?dist
            WHERE {
              ?route air:hasSource ?source .
              ?route air:hasDestination ?dest .
              ?source air:code ?incode .
              ?dest air:code ?outcode .
              ?route air:distance ?dist .
            }
            LIMIT 10
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: !Ref FieldDelimiter
          Location: ""

  RouteRdfNopfxTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: RdfDatabase
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref RdfDatabaseName
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf_nopfx
        Description: "Route RDF table with embedded URIs in SPARQL query."
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          querymode: "sparql"
          rdf_type: "true"
          strip_uri_prefixes: "true"
          sparql_query: >
            SELECT ?incode ?outcode ?dist
            WHERE {
              ?route <http://www.semanticweb.org/air-routes/ontologies/2015/06/air-routes#hasSource> ?source .
              ?route <http://www.semanticweb.org/air-routes/ontologies/2015/06/air-routes#hasDestination> ?dest .
              ?source <http://www.semanticweb.org/air-routes/ontologies/2015/06/air-routes#code> ?incode .
              ?dest <http://www.semanticweb.org/air-routes/ontologies/2015/06/air-routes#code> ?outcode .
              ?route <http://www.semanticweb.org/air-routes/ontologies/2015/06/air-routes#distance> ?dist .
            }
            LIMIT 10
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: !Ref FieldDelimiter
          Location: ""

Outputs:
  GraphDatabaseName:
    Description: "Name of the Glue database for property graph tables."
    Value: !Ref GraphDatabase
  RdfDatabaseName:
    Description: "Name of the Glue database for RDF tables."
    Value: !Ref RdfDatabase
  AirportTableName:
    Description: "Name of the airport table."
    Value: !Ref AirportTable
  CountryTableName:
    Description: "Name of the country table."
    Value: !Ref CountryTable
  ContinentTableName:
    Description: "Name of the continent table."
    Value: !Ref ContinentTable
  RouteTableName:
    Description: "Name of the route table."
    Value: !Ref RouteTable
  CustomairportTableName:
    Description: "Name of the customairport table."
    Value: !Ref CustomairportTable
  AirportRdfTableName:
    Description: "Name of the airport_rdf table."
    Value: !Ref AirportRdfTable
  RouteRdfTableName:
    Description: "Name of the route_rdf table."
    Value: !Ref RouteRdfTable
  RouteRdfNopfxTableName:
    Description: "Name of the route_rdf_nopfx table."
    Value: !Ref RouteRdfNopfxTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for PiBot Cognito authentication setups - Main Web App and IoT Trusted User Provisioning"

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: PiBot
    Description: "Project name used to prefix resource names"

Resources:
  # Main Web App Setup
  MainWebAppUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-MainWebApp-UserPool"
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true

  MainWebAppUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-MainWebApp-Client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref MainWebAppUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false

  MainWebAppIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-MainWebApp-IdentityPool"
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ProviderName: !GetAtt MainWebAppUserPool.ProviderName
          ClientId: !Ref MainWebAppUserPoolClient

  MainWebAppUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-MainWebApp-UnauthRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref MainWebAppIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-MainWebApp-UnauthPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-sync:ListRecords
                Resource: "*"

  MainWebAppAuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-MainWebApp-AuthRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref MainWebAppIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-MainWebApp-AuthPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                  - iot:DeleteThingShadow
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:GetMedia
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                  - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - mobileanalytics:*
                Resource: "*"

  MainWebAppIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref MainWebAppIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt MainWebAppAuthRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt MainWebAppUnauthRole.Arn

  # Provisioning Setup
  ProvisioningUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-Provisioning-UserPool"
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true

  ProvisioningUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-Provisioning-Client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false

  ProvisioningIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-Provisioning-IdentityPool"
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ProviderName: !GetAtt ProvisioningUserPool.ProviderName
          ClientId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPoolClient

  ProvisioningUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-Provisioning-UnauthRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-Provisioning-UnauthPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-sync:ListRecords
                Resource: "*"

  ProvisioningAuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-Provisioning-AuthRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-Provisioning-AuthPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:CreateKeysAndCertificate
                  - iot:RegisterThing
                  - iot:AttachThingPrincipal
                  - iot:AttachPolicy
                  - iot:DescribeEndpoint
                  - iot:DescribeCertificate
                  - iot:UpdateCertificate
                Resource: "*"

  ProvisioningIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt ProvisioningAuthRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt ProvisioningUnauthRole.Arn

Outputs:
