Resources:
  HostedZone:
    Type: "AWS::Route53::HostedZone"
    Properties:
      Name: radiotopia.fm

  # ACM Certificates for CloudFront subdomains (validation via HostedZoneId)
  CertMedia:
    Type: "AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate"
    Properties:
      DomainName: media.radiotopia.fm
      ValidationMethod: DNS
      DomainValidationOptions:
        - DomainName: media.radiotopia.fm
          HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone

  CertTower:
    Type: "AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate"
    Properties:
      DomainName: tower.radiotopia.fm
      ValidationMethod: DNS
      DomainValidationOptions:
        - DomainName: tower.radiotopia.fm
          HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone

  CertV1:
    Type: "AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate"
    Properties:
      DomainName: v1.radiotopia.fm
      ValidationMethod: DNS
      DomainValidationOptions:
        - DomainName: v1.radiotopia.fm
          HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone

  CertPlus:
    Type: "AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate"
    Properties:
      DomainName: plus.radiotopia.fm
      ValidationMethod: DNS
      DomainValidationOptions:
        - DomainName: plus.radiotopia.fm
          HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone

  # WAF Web ACL for CloudFront
  WebACL:
    Type: "AWS::WAFv2::WebACL"
    Properties:
      Name: CloudFrontWebACL
      Scope: CLOUDFRONT
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}
      VisibilityConfig:
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: CloudFrontWebACL
      Rules:
        - Name: AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          Priority: 1
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
        - Name: AWS-AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
          Priority: 2
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
        - Name: AWS-AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
          Priority: 3
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
        - Name: AWS-AWSManagedRulesAnonymousIpList
          Priority: 4
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesAnonymousIpList
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesAnonymousIpList

  # CloudFront Distributions for subdomains with WAF association
  DistMedia:
    Type: "AWS::CloudFront::Distribution"
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Aliases:
          - media.radiotopia.fm
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: mediaOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: false
            Cookies:
              Forward: none
          TrustedSigners: []
        Enabled: true
        Origins:
          - DomainName: !Ref MediaOriginDomain
            Id: mediaOrigin
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: https-only
        ViewerCertificate:
          AcmCertificateArn: !Ref CertMedia
          SslSupportMethod: sni-only
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
        WebACLId: !GetAtt WebACL.Arn

  DistTower:
    Type: "AWS::CloudFront::Distribution"
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Aliases:
          - tower.radiotopia.fm
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: towerOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: false
            Cookies:
              Forward: none
          TrustedSigners: []
        Enabled: true
        Origins:
          - DomainName: !Ref TowerOriginDomain
            Id: towerOrigin
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: https-only
        ViewerCertificate:
          AcmCertificateArn: !Ref CertTower
          SslSupportMethod: sni-only
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
        WebACLId: !GetAtt WebACL.Arn

  DistV1:
    Type: "AWS::CloudFront::Distribution"
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Aliases:
          - v1.radiotopia.fm
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: v1Origin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: false
            Cookies:
              Forward: none
          TrustedSigners: []
        Enabled: true
        Origins:
          - DomainName: !Ref V1OriginDomain
            Id: v1Origin
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: https-only
        ViewerCertificate:
          AcmCertificateArn: !Ref CertV1
          SslSupportMethod: sni-only
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
        WebACLId: !GetAtt WebACL.Arn

  DistPlus:
    Type: "AWS::CloudFront::Distribution"
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Aliases:
          - plus.radiotopia.fm
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: plusOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: false
            Cookies:
              Forward: none
          TrustedSigners: []
        Enabled: true
        Origins:
          - DomainName: !Ref PlusOriginDomain
            Id: plusOrigin
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: https-only
        ViewerCertificate:
          AcmCertificateArn: !Ref CertPlus
          SslSupportMethod: sni-only
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
        WebACLId: !GetAtt WebACL.Arn

  # DNS Record Set Group
  DNSRecords:
    Type: "AWS::Route53::RecordSetGroup"
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      RecordSets:
        # Apex TXT (SPF + verification tokens)
        - Name: radiotopia.fm.
          Type: TXT
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub
              - "\"v=spf1 ${Includes} -all\""
              - Includes: !Join [" ", !Ref SPFIncludes]
            - !Ref DomainVerificationToken1
            - !Ref DomainVerificationToken2
        # DMARC TXT
        - Name: _dmarc.radiotopia.fm.
          Type: TXT
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub "\"v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:${DmarcRua};\""
        # MX record
        - Name: radiotopia.fm.
          Type: MX
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub "${EmailMxPriority} ${EmailMxHost}"
        # Apex A records
        - Name: radiotopia.fm.
          Type: A
          TTL: 60
          ResourceRecords: !Ref ApexIPs
        # www CNAME
        - Name: www.radiotopia.fm.
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref WwwCnameTarget
        # Media alias A and AAAA
        - Name: media.radiotopia.fm.
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt DistMedia.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        - Name: media.radiotopia.fm.
          Type: AAAA
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt DistMedia.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        # Tower alias A and AAAA
        - Name: tower.radiotopia.fm.
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt DistTower.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        - Name: tower.radiotopia.fm.
          Type: AAAA
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt DistTower.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        # V1 alias A and AAAA
        - Name: v1.radiotopia.fm.
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt DistV1.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        - Name: v1.radiotopia.fm.
          Type: AAAA
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt DistV1.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        # Plus alias A and AAAA
        - Name: plus.radiotopia.fm.
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt DistPlus.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        - Name: plus.radiotopia.fm.
          Type: AAAA
          AliasTarget:
            DNSName: !GetAtt DistPlus.DomainName
            HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        # Podcast feed CNAME
        - Name: feed.radiotopia.fm.
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref PodcastFeedCnameTarget
        # Special event A record
        - Name: !Ref SpecialEventSubdomainName
          Type: A
          TTL: 60
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref SpecialEventSubdomainIP
        # Zendesk CNAME
        - Name: !Ref ZendeskCnameRecordName
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref ZendeskCnameRecordValue
        # Zendesk TXT
        - Name: !Ref ZendeskTxtRecordName
          Type: TXT
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref ZendeskTxtRecordValue
        # MailChimp CNAME
        - Name: !Ref MailChimpCnameRecordName
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref MailChimpCnameRecordValue
        # MailChimp TXT
        - Name: !Ref MailChimpTxtRecordName
          Type: TXT
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref MailChimpTxtRecordValue
        # Squarespace CNAME
        - Name: !Ref SquarespaceCnameRecordName
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref SquarespaceCnameRecordValue
        # Squarespace TXT
        - Name: !Ref SquarespaceTxtRecordName
          Type: TXT
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref SquarespaceTxtRecordValue
        # Campaign Monitor CNAME
        - Name: !Ref CampaignMonitorCnameRecordName
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref CampaignMonitorCnameRecordValue
        # Campaign Monitor TXT
        - Name: !Ref CampaignMonitorTxtRecordName
          Type: TXT
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref CampaignMonitorTxtRecordValue
        # Google Workspace CNAME
        - Name: !Ref GoogleWorkspaceCnameRecordName
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref GoogleWorkspaceCnameRecordValue
        # Google Workspace TXT verification
        - Name: !Ref GoogleWorkspaceTxtRecordName
          Type: TXT
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref GoogleWorkspaceTxtRecordValue
        # Google Workspace DKIM TXT
        - Name: !Ref GoogleWorkspaceDkimRecordName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway infrastructure for MCP integration, supporting protein variant effect prediction. Creates placeholder Lambda function and Cognito User Pool to satisfy deployment dependencies.
Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    Description: Project name used for resource naming and SSM parameter paths.
  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: Gateway for MCP-based protein variant effect prediction agent
    Description: Description of the AgentCore Gateway.
  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional name for the gateway. If left blank, it auto-generates from the project name.
  BedrockRoleArnParamName:
    Type: String
    Default: /protein-engineering/gateway-role-arn
    Description: SSM parameter path where the new IAM role ARN for Bedrock AgentCore will be stored.
Conditions:
  IsGatewayNameEmpty:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: GatewayName
      - ''
Resources:
  PlaceholderLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
  PlaceholderLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName:
        Fn::Sub: ${ProjectName}-placeholder-lambda
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role:
        Fn::GetAtt: PlaceholderLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps('Placeholder Lambda for Bedrock AgentCore Gateway')
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value:
            Ref: ProjectName
  LambdaArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name:
        Fn::Sub: /${ProjectName}/lambda-arn
      Type: String
      Value:
        Fn::GetAtt: PlaceholderLambda.Arn
      Description: Lambda function ARN for the AgentCore Gateway (placeholder).
      Tags:
        Project:
          Ref: ProjectName
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName:
        Fn::Sub: ${ProjectName}-user-pool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Project:
          Ref: ProjectName
  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName:
        Fn::Sub: ${ProjectName}-client
      UserPoolId:
        Ref: CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
  CognitoIssuerParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name:
        Fn::Sub: /${ProjectName}/cognito-issuer
      Type: String
      Value:
        Fn::Sub: https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}
      Description: Cognito issuer URL for JWT validation.
      Tags:
        Project:
          Ref: ProjectName
  CognitoClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name:
        Fn::Sub: /${ProjectName}/cognito-client-id
      Type: String
      Value:
        Ref: CognitoUserPoolClient
      Description: Cognito client ID for JWT validation.
      Tags:
        Project:
          Ref: ProjectName
  BedrockAgentCoreRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName:
        Fn::Sub: ${ProjectName}-bedrock-agentcore-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  Fn::GetAtt: PlaceholderLambda.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value:
            Ref: ProjectName
  StoreBedrockRoleArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name:
        Ref: BedrockRoleArnParamName
      Type: String
      Value:
        Fn::GetAtt: BedrockAgentCoreRole.Arn
      Description: IAM role ARN for Bedrock AgentCore to invoke Lambda.
      Tags:
        Project:
          Ref: ProjectName
  ApiGateway:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name:
        Fn::If:
          - IsGatewayNameEmpty
          - Fn::Sub: ${ProjectName}-gateway
          - Ref: GatewayName
      Description:
        Ref: GatewayDescription
      ProtocolType: HTTP
      Tags:
        Project:
          Ref: ProjectName
  Authorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Authorizer
    Properties:
      ApiId:
        Ref: ApiGateway
      AuthorizerType: JWT
      IdentitySource:
        - $request.header.Authorization
      JwtConfiguration:
        Audience:
          - Ref: CognitoUserPoolClient
        Issuer:
          Fn::Sub: https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}
      Name:
        Fn::Sub: ${ProjectName}-authorizer
  Integration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId:
        Ref: ApiGateway
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri:
        Fn::Sub: arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${PlaceholderLambda.Arn}/invocations
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'
  RouteInvokeEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId:
        Ref: ApiGateway
      RouteKey: POST /invoke_endpoint
      AuthorizationType: JWT
      AuthorizerId:
        Ref: Authorizer
      Target:
        Fn::Sub: integrations/${Integration}
  RouteGetResults:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId:
        Ref: ApiGateway
      RouteKey: GET /get_results
      AuthorizationType: JWT
      AuthorizerId:
        Ref: Authorizer
      Target:
        Fn::Sub: integrations/${Integration}
  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    Properties:
      ApiId:
        Ref: ApiGateway
    DependsOn:
      - RouteInvokeEndpoint
      - RouteGetResults
  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId:
        Ref: ApiGateway
      DeploymentId:
        Ref: Deployment
      StageName: prod
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName:
        Fn::GetAtt: PlaceholderLambda.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn:
        Fn::Sub: arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ApiGateway}/*/*
Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: The base URL of the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value:
      Fn::Sub: https://${ApiGateway}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod
  BedrockRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role ARN for Bedrock AgentCore to invoke Lambda.
    Value:
      Ref: StoreBedrockRoleArn
  CognitoUserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID for the gateway.
    Value:
      Ref: CognitoUserPool
  CognitoClientId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool Client ID.
    Value:
      Ref: CognitoUserPoolClient
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the placeholder Lambda function.
    Value:
      Fn::GetAtt: PlaceholderLambda.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Private VPC infrastructure with private subnets for ALB and Lambda, optional NAT Gateway, and KMS-encrypted artifact bucket.'
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
  AlbPrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the first private ALB subnet
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
  AlbPrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the second private ALB subnet
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
  LambdaPrivateSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the private Lambda subnet
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
  PublicSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the public NAT Gateway subnet (only used if NAT Gateway is enabled)

    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'
  EnableNATGateway:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable or disable the NAT Gateway for internet egress
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment name for tagging resources
    Default: dev
Conditions:
  HasNatGateway: !Equals [!Ref EnableNATGateway, 'true']
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  AlbPrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbPrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-alb-private-subnet-1'
  AlbPrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbPrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-alb-private-subnet-2'
  LambdaPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref LambdaPrivateSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-lambda-private-subnet'
  PublicSubnet:

    Properties:

    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Creates a Step Functions state machine with a two-step pass workflow, two separate API Gateway REST APIs (GET and POST) each with its own IAM role, and deploys each API to a stage."
Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Name of the API Gateway stage for deployment.
  StateMachineName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyTwoStepStateMachine
    Description: Name of the Step Functions state machine.
  GetApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: GetStateMachineAPI
    Description: Name of the API Gateway REST API exposing the GET endpoint.
  PostApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: PostStateMachineAPI
    Description: Name of the API Gateway REST API exposing the POST endpoint.
Resources:
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Ref StateMachineName
      DefinitionString: |
        {
          "StartAt": "FirstStep",
          "States": {
            "FirstStep": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": { "step": "first" },
              "Next": "SecondStep"
            },
            "SecondStep": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": { "step": "second" },
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
  GetApiGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeStateMachineFromGetApi
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn
  PostApiGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeStateMachineFromPostApi
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn
  GetRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref GetApiName
      Description: "REST API exposing a GET endpoint to start the state machine execution."
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
  GetApiRootMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt GetRestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Credentials: !GetAtt GetApiGatewayRole.Arn
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution"
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "input": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.params('input')).replaceAll(\"\\'\",\"'\")",
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine.Arn}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            SelectionPattern: ""
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                {
                  "executionArn": "$input.path('$.executionArn')",
                  "startDate": "$input.path('$.startDate')"
                }
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
  GetApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - GetApiRootMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
  PostRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref PostApiName
      Description: "REST API exposing a POST endpoint to start the state machine execution."
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
  PostApiRootMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt PostRestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Credentials: !GetAtt PostApiGatewayRole.Arn
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution"
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "input": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.body).replaceAll(\"\\'\",\"'\")",
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine.Arn}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            SelectionPattern: ""
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                {
                  "executionArn": "$input.path('$.executionArn')",
                  "startDate": "$input.path('$.startDate')"
                }
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
  PostApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - PostApiRootMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn
  GetApiUrl:
    Description: URL for the GET API endpoint
    Value: !Sub "https://${GetRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}"
  PostApiUrl:
    Description: URL for the POST API endpoint
    Value: !Sub "https://${PostRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}"
  GetApiId:
    Description: ID of the GET REST API
    Value: !Ref GetRestApi
  PostApiId:
    Description: ID of the POST REST API
    Value: !Ref PostRestApi

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for audit SQS queue with KMS encryption, optional DLQ, and CloudWatch alarms with SNS notifications.'
Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    Default: dev
    Description: 'Deployment environment. DLQ created only for non-dev environments.'
  MessageRetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 345600
    Description: 'Number of seconds for message retention (default 4 days).'
  VisibilityTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: 'Visibility timeout in seconds (default 30).'
  OldMessageThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 86400
    Description: 'Threshold in seconds for approximate age of oldest message to trigger alarm (default 1 day).'
  DLQMessageThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: 'Number of messages visible in DLQ to trigger alarm (default 1).'
  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Optional email address to subscribe to SNS topic for alarms. Leave empty for no subscription.'
Conditions:
  CreateDLQ: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Environment, dev]]
  CreateDLQAlarm: !Condition CreateDLQ
  CreateEmailSubscription: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmEmail, '']]
Resources:
  AuditKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: 'KMS key for SQS queue encryption'
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow SQS Service
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow SNS Service
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
  AuditKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/audit-queue-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuditKey
  AuditSNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-audit-alarms
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditKey
  AuditSNSTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AuditSNSTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AuditSNSTopic
  AuditDeadLetterQueue:
    Condition: CreateDLQ
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-audit-dlq
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditKey
  AuditQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-audit-queue
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !Ref MessageRetentionPeriod
      VisibilityTimeout: !Ref VisibilityTimeout
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditKey
      RedrivePolicy:
        Fn::If:
          - CreateDLQ
          - deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt AuditDeadLetterQueue.Arn
            maxReceiveCount: 5
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
  OldMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-old-messages
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when approximate age of oldest message exceeds threshold'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref OldMessageThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AuditSNSTopic
  DLQMessagesAlarm:
    Condition: CreateDLQAlarm
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-dlq-messages
      AlarmDescription: 'Alarm when messages appear in DLQ'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditDeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref DLQMessageThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AuditSNSTopic
  EmailSubscription:
    Condition: CreateEmailSubscription
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AuditSNSTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlarmEmail
Outputs:
  AuditQueueURL:
    Description: 'URL of the audit SQS queue'
    Value: !Ref AuditQueue
  AuditQueueARN:
    Description: 'ARN of the audit SQS queue'
    Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.Arn
  AuditDLQURL:
    Condition: CreateDLQ
    Description: 'URL of the dead letter queue'
    Value: !Ref AuditDeadLetterQueue
  AuditDLQARN:
    Condition: CreateDLQ
    Description: 'ARN of the dead letter queue'
    Value: !GetAtt AuditDeadLetterQueue.Arn
  AuditSNSTopicARN:
    Description: 'ARN of the SNS topic for alarms'
    Value: !Ref AuditSNSTopic

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for Cognito user pool with groups, clients, resource server, Lambda function, and SSM parameters'
Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateGatewayPool
    Description: Name for the Cognito user pool
  MachineAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateMachineClient
    Description: Name for the machine-to-machine client
  WebAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateWebClient
    Description: Name for the web app client
Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: researchapp-api
      Name: researchapp-resource-server
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to researchapp resources
  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref WebAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - phone
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
        - !Join ['', [!Ref ResourceServer, '/read']]
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/auth/callback
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
  MachineClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref MachineAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Join ['', [!Ref ResourceServer, '/read']]
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoAddUserToGroup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.Arn
  AddToCustomerGroupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-add-to-customer-group'
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Environment:
        Variables:
          USER_POOL_ID: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import os

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = os.environ['USER_POOL_ID']
              client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
              username = event.get('userName', event.get('username'))
              if username:
                  client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      GroupName='customer'
                  )
              return event
  UserPoolIdParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/UserPoolId
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Description: Cognito User Pool ID
  WebClientIdParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/WebClientId
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebClient
      Description: Web application client ID
  MachineClientIdParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/MachineClientId
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineClient
      Description: Machine-to-machine client ID
  MachineClientSecretParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/MachineClientSecret
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt MachineClient.ClientSecret
      Description: Machine-to-machine client secret
  OAuthScopesParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/OAuthScopes
      Type: String
      Value: !Join ['', [!Ref ResourceServer, '/read']]
      Description: Custom OAuth scopes
  DiscoveryUrlParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/DiscoveryUrl
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: OIDC discovery URL
  TokenUrlParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/TokenUrl
      Type: String
      Value: !Join
        - ''
        - - 'https://'
          - !Ref UserPoolDomain
          - '.auth.'
          - !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          - '.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
      Description: OAuth token endpoint URL
  AuthorizeUrlParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/AuthorizeUrl
      Type: String
      Value: !Join
        - ''
        - - 'https://'
          - !Ref UserPoolDomain
          - '.auth.'
          - !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          - '.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'
      Description: OAuth authorize endpoint URL
  CognitoDomainParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/CognitoDomain
      Type: String
      Value: !Join
        - ''
        - - 'https://'
          - !Ref UserPoolDomain
          - '.auth.'
          - !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          - '.amazoncognito.com'
      Description: Cognito domain URL

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CryptoTickerAPI - GraphQL API for cryptocurrency ticker data using AWS AppSync with DynamoDB'

Resources:
  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: APIDataTable
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: false

  AppSyncRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn

  CryptoTickerAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: CryptoTickerAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |-
        type TickerInfo {
          ticker: String!
          price: Float!
          timestamp: AWSDateTime!
          priceHistory(limit: Int, nextToken: String): TickerInfoConnection
        }
        type TickerInfoConnection {
          items: [TickerInfo]
          nextToken: String
        }
        type Query {
          ticker(symbol: String!): TickerInfo
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
        }

  DynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  HTTPDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: HTTPDataSource
      Type: HTTP
      HttpConfig:
        Endpoint: https://api.coingecko.com

  GetCoinGeckoPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: GetCoinGeckoPriceFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt HTTPDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: 2018-05-29
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
            "version": "2018-05-29",
            "method": "GET",
            "params": {
                "query": {
                    "ids": "$ctx.args.symbol",
                    "vs_currencies": "usd"
                }
            },
            "resourcePath": "/api/v3/simple/price"
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.result.statusCode == 200)
            #set($body = $util.parseJson($ctx.result.body))
            #set($price = $body.get($ctx.args.symbol).usd)
            #if($price)
                #set($timestamp = $util.time.nowISO8601())
                $util.qr($ctx.stash.put("ticker", $ctx.args.symbol))
                $util.qr($ctx.stash.put("price", $price))
                $util.qr($ctx.stash.put("timestamp", $timestamp))
                {}
            #else
                $util.error("Price not found for symbol: $ctx.args.symbol")
            #end
        #else
            $util.error("Failed to fetch price from CoinGecko API")
        #end

  StorePriceHistoryFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: StorePriceHistoryFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: 2018-05-29
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
            "version" : "2017-02-28",
            "operation" : "PutItem",
            "key" : {
                "hk" : $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.stash.ticker),
                "sk" : $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.stash.timestamp)
            },
            "attributeValues" : {
                "price" : $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.stash.price)
            }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.stash)

  QueryTickerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ticker
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt GetCoinGeckoPriceFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt StorePriceHistoryFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
            "version": "2018-05-29",
            "payload": {}
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  QueryPriceHistoryFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: QueryPriceHistoryFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: 2018-05-29
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($limit = $ctx.args.limit)
        #if(!$limit)
            #set($limit = 25)
        #end
        {
            "version" : "2017-02-28",
            "operation" : "Query",
            "query" : {
                "expression" : "hk = :hk",
                "expressionValues" : {
                    ":hk" : $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.source.ticker)
                }
            },
            "limit": $limit,
            "scanIndexForward": false,
            "nextToken": #if($ctx.args.nextToken) "$ctx.args.nextToken" #else null #end
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #set($items = [])
        #foreach($item in $ctx.result.items)
            $util.qr($items.add({
                "ticker": $item.hk,
                "price": $item.price,
                "timestamp": $item.sk
            }))
        #end
        {
            "items": $util.toJson($items),
            "nextToken": #if($ctx.result.nextToken) "$ctx.result.nextToken" #else null #end
        }

  PriceHistoryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: TickerInfo
      FieldName: priceHistory
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt QueryPriceHistoryFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
            "version": "2018-05-29",
            "payload": {}
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  DefaultApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: ID of the CryptoTickerAPI GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: URL of the CryptoTickerAPI GraphQL API endpoint
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.GraphQLUrl
  ApiKey:
    Description: Default API key for the CryptoTickerAPI
    Value: !GetAtt DefaultApiKey.ApiKey
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table storing historical price data
    Value: !Ref APIDataTable

    Description: 'Output type for the origin endpoint(s). APPLE_HLS creates HLS endpoint, ISO_DASH creates DASH endpoint, ALL creates both.'
  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    Description: 'Segment duration in seconds for HLS endpoint.'
  HlsPlaylistWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 300
    Description: 'Startover window in seconds for HLS endpoint (max 300).'
  DashManifestWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3600
    MinValue: 0
    Description: 'Startover window in seconds for DASH endpoint.'
  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    Description: 'Manifest name for the origin endpoints.'
  LogicalNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: MyChannel
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9-]+'
    Description: 'Prefix for logical resource names.'
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: Dev
    Description: 'Environment tag value.'
Conditions:
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, '']]
  HasVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, '']]
  CreateRole: !Or [!Condition HasArchiveBucket, !Condition HasVodSourceBucket]
  CreateHlsEndpoint: !Or [!Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'APPLE_HLS'], !Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'ALL']]
  CreateDashEndpoint: !Or [!Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'ISO_DASH'], !Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'ALL']]
Resources:
  MediaPackageChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}Channel'
      Description: !Sub 'MediaPackage channel for ${LogicalNamePrefix}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}Channel'
  MediaPackageHlsEndpoint:
    Condition: CreateHlsEndpoint
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}HlsEndpoint'
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, 'DENY', 'ALLOW']
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        PlaylistWindowSeconds: !Ref HlsPlaylistWindowSeconds
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}HlsEndpoint'
  MediaPackageDashEndpoint:
    Condition: CreateDashEndpoint
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}DashEndpoint'
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, 'DENY', 'ALLOW']
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        ManifestWindowSeconds: !Ref DashManifestWindowSeconds
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}DashEndpoint'
  MediaPackageRole:
    Condition: CreateRole
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      RoleName: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}MediaPackageRole'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}MediaPackageRole'
  ArchiveBucketPolicy:
    Condition: HasArchiveBucket
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: ArchiveBucketAccess
      Roles:
        - !Ref MediaPackageRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}/*'
  VodSourceBucketPolicy:
    Condition: HasVodSourceBucket
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: VodSourceBucketAccess
      Roles:
        - !Ref MediaPackageRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}/*'
Outputs:
  ChannelId:
    Description: 'MediaPackage Channel ID'
    Value: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
  ChannelArn:
    Description: 'MediaPackage Channel ARN'
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageChannel.Arn
  HlsEndpointUrl:
    Condition: CreateHlsEndpoint
    Description: 'HLS origin endpoint URL'
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageHlsEndpoint.Url
  DashEndpointUrl:
    Condition: CreateDashEndpoint
    Description: 'DASH origin endpoint URL'
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageDashEndpoint.Url

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Creates a DynamoDB table with configurable keys, billing mode, point-in-time recovery, optional SSE, and optional CloudWatch alarms for throttling and errors."

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: "MyTable"
    Description: "Name of the DynamoDB table."
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: "id"
    Description: "Name of the partition key attribute."
  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: "S"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
    Description: "Type of the partition key attribute."
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Name of the sort key attribute. Leave empty to omit sort key."
  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: "N"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
    Description: "Type of the sort key attribute."
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: "PROVISIONED"
    AllowedValues: ["PROVISIONED", "PAY_PER_REQUEST"]
    Description: "Billing mode for the table."
  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    Description: "Read capacity units when using PROVISIONED billing."
  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    Description: "Write capacity units when using PROVISIONED billing."
  EnablePointInTimeRecovery:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: "Enable point-in-time recovery for the table."
  EnableSSE:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: "Enable server-side encryption using KMS."
  KmsMasterKeyId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional customer-managed KMS key ID or ARN for DynamoDB SSE. Only used if EnableSSE is true. Leave empty to use AWS managed key."
  EnableAlarms:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: "Enable CloudWatch alarms for throttling and user errors."
  AlarmThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: "Threshold for each alarm metric (count of events)."
  SnsTopicDisplayName:
    Type: String
    Default: "DynamoDBAlarmsTopic"
    Description: "Display name for the SNS topic created when alarms are enabled."

Conditions:
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, ""]]
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, "PROVISIONED"]
  CreatePointInTimeRecovery: !Equals [!Ref EnablePointInTimeRecovery, "true"]
  CreateSSE: !Equals [!Ref EnableSSE, "true"]
  CreateAlarms: !Equals [!Ref EnableAlarms, "true"]
  UseCustomKmsKey: !And [!Condition CreateSSE, !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsMasterKeyId, ""]]]

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: !If
        - CreatePointInTimeRecovery
        - PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      SSESpecification: !If
        - CreateSSE
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: "KMS"
          KMSMasterKeyId: !If
            - UseCustomKmsKey
            - !Ref KmsMasterKeyId
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  SnsTopicKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for encrypting SNS topic for DynamoDB alarms"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 7

  SnsTopicKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}-DynamoDBAlarmsKey"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SnsTopicKmsKey

  SnsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Ref SnsTopicDisplayName
      TopicName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DynamoDBAlarms"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SnsTopicKmsKey

  ReadThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ReadThrottle"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when DynamoDB read throttling events occur"
      Namespace: "AWS/DynamoDB"
      MetricName: "ReadThrottleEvents"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref AlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SnsTopic

  WriteThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-WriteThrottle"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when DynamoDB write throttling events occur"
      Namespace: "AWS/DynamoDB"
      MetricName: "WriteThrottleEvents"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref AlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SnsTopic

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserErrors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when DynamoDB user errors occur"
      Namespace: "AWS/DynamoDB"
      MetricName: "UserErrors"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref AlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SnsTopic

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: "Name of the DynamoDB table."
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
  TableArn:
    Description: "ARN of the DynamoDB table."
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
  SnsTopicArn:
    Description: "ARN of the SNS topic for alarms (if created)."
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Value: !Ref SnsTopic
  SnsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: "ARN of the KMS key used for SNS encryption."
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Value: !GetAtt SnsTopicKmsKey.Arn

    Properties:

      Tags:
        - Key: StackName

  PublicSubnet:

      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:

      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  ImageBuilderSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder instances

        - IpProtocol: tcp

          ToPort: 443

        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole
  InstallTestComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Join ['-', [!Ref AWS::StackName, 'install-test-component']]
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Platform: Linux
      Data: |
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: InstallDocker
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y docker docker-compose-plugin
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - systemctl start docker
                    - dnf install -y python3-pip
                    - pip3 install synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: EnableSSMUserSudo
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - echo "ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent
          - name: test
            steps:
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: TestDockerCompose
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - docker-compose --version
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: TestPythonImports
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient; import pandas; import pysftp"
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
  X86Recipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Join ['-', [!Ref AWS::StackName, 'x86-recipe']]
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref InstallTestComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      WorkingDirectory: /tmp
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
  Arm64Recipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Join ['-', [!Ref AWS::StackName, 'arm64-recipe']]
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-arm64'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref InstallTestComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      WorkingDirectory: /tmp
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Join ['-', [!Ref AWS::StackName, 'infra']]
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - t3.micro
        - t4g.nano
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      ResourceTags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Join ['-', [!Ref AWS::StackName, 'dist']]
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: '{{ imagebuilder:name }}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}-{{ imagebuilder:version }}'
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrgId}'
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
  PipelineX86:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Join ['-', [!Ref AWS::StackName, 'pipeline-x86']]
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref X86Recipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 120
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
  PipelineArm64:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Join ['-', [!Ref AWS::StackName, 'pipeline-arm64']]
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref Arm64Recipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:

Outputs:
