AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo Cognito User Pool with seeded test users"
Resources:
  AgentOpsUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentops-ecommerce-users
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      EmailVerificationMessage: "Please verify your email by clicking the link: {####}"
      EmailVerificationSubject: "Verify your email for AgentOps"
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: role
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Environment: demo
        Application: AgentOps

  AgentOpsUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentops-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - profile
        - email
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000/auth/callback
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  TeamAlphaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-alpha
      Precedence: 10
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool

  TeamBetaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-beta
      Precedence: 20
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool

  SeederFunctionExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SeederFunctionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminCreateUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !GetAtt AgentOpsUserPool.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  SeederFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: agentops-user-seeder
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt SeederFunctionExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import os

          def handler(event, context):
              physical_resource_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'seeder-' + context.log_stream_name)
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      user_pool_id = event['ResourceProperties']['UserPoolId']
                      password = 'Demo1234!'

                      client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

                      users_data = [
                          {'email': 'alice@demo.local', 'group': 'team-alpha', 'role': 'member'},
                          {'email': 'bob@demo.local', 'group': 'team-alpha', 'role': 'member'},
                          {'email': 'charlie@demo.local', 'group': 'team-alpha', 'role': 'team_admin'},
                          {'email': 'dave@demo.local', 'group': 'team-beta', 'role': 'member'},
                          {'email': 'eve@demo.local', 'group': 'team-beta', 'role': 'team_admin'},
                          {'email': 'admin@demo.local', 'group': 'admin', 'role': 'admin'},
                      ]

                      for user_data in users_data:
                          email = user_data['email']
                          group_name = user_data['group']
                          role = user_data['role']

                          # Create user if not exists
                          try:
                              client.admin_create_user(
                                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                                  Username=email,
                                  TemporaryPassword=password,
                                  MessageAction='SUPPRESS',
                                  UserAttributes=[
                                      {'Name': 'email', 'Value': email},
                                      {'Name': 'email_verified', 'Value': 'true'},
                                      {'Name': 'custom:role', 'Value': role},
                                  ]
                              )
                              # Set permanent password
                              client.admin_set_user_password(
                                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                                  Username=email,
                                  Password=password,
                                  Permanent=True
                              )
                          except client.exceptions.UsernameExistsException:
                              # Update attributes if user already exists
                              client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                                  Username=email,
                                  UserAttributes=[
                                      {'Name': 'custom:role', 'Value': role},
                                  ]
                              )
                              # Ensure password is set
                              client.admin_set_user_password(
                                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                                  Username=email,
                                  Password=password,
                                  Permanent=True
                              )

                          # Add user to group
                          try:
                              client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                                  Username=email,
                                  GroupName=group_name
                              )
                          except client.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                              # Group might not exist yet, but it should
                              pass

                  # Respond success
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_resource_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  print('Error: ' + str(e))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)}, physical_resource_id)

  SeederCustomResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    DependsOn:
      - TeamAlphaGroup
      - TeamBetaGroup
      - AdminGroup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SeederFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool
      Groups:
        - team-alpha
        - team-beta
        - admin

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: "Cognito User Pool ID"
    Value: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: "Cognito User Pool ARN"
    Value: !GetAtt AgentOpsUserPool.Arn
  ClientId:
    Description: "Cognito User Pool Client ID"
    Value: !Ref AgentOpsUserPoolClient
  Region:
    Description: "AWS Region"
    Value: !Ref "AWS::Region"
  SeederFunctionArn:
    Description: "Lambda function ARN for seeding users"
    Value: !GetAtt SeederFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template to create CloudWatch Logs Insights queries and a dashboard for AWS Client VPN usage reporting."
Parameters:
  FolderPath:
    Type: String
    Default: "aws-client-vpn"
    Description: "Folder path to organize the saved queries (e.g., folder name prefix)."
  ClientVpnLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: "aws/aws-client-vpn/prod"
    Description: "CloudWatch Log Group name where Client VPN logs are stored."
Resources:
  TotalUsagePerEndpointQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${FolderPath}/TotalUsagePerEndpoint"
      QueryString: "fields @timestamp, endpoint | stats count(*) as total_connections by endpoint | sort total_connections desc"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
  UsagePerAuthTypeQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${FolderPath}/UsagePerAuthType"
      QueryString: "fields @timestamp, authentication_type | stats count(*) as total_connections by authentication_type | sort total_connections desc"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
  DistinctUsersQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${FolderPath}/DistinctUsers"
      QueryString: "fields @timestamp, username | stats count(*) as connections by username | sort connections desc"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
  ConnectionDurationsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${FolderPath}/ConnectionDurations"
      QueryString: "fields @timestamp, connection_duration, endpoint | stats avg(connection_duration) as avg_duration, max(connection_duration) as max_duration, min(connection_duration) as min_duration by endpoint | sort avg_duration desc"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
  ClientVpnDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ClientVpnDashboard"
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Total Usage Per Endpoint",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "query": "fields @timestamp, endpoint | stats count(*) as total_connections by endpoint | sort total_connections desc",
                "logGroupNames": ["${ClientVpnLogGroupName}"],
                "view": "table",
                "timezone": "UTC"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Usage Per Authentication Type",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "query": "fields @timestamp, authentication_type | stats count(*) as total_connections by authentication_type | sort total_connections desc",
                "logGroupNames": ["${ClientVpnLogGroupName}"],
                "view": "table",
                "timezone": "UTC"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Distinct Users",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "query": "fields @timestamp, username | stats count(*) as connections by username | sort connections desc",
                "logGroupNames": ["${ClientVpnLogGroupName}"],
                "view": "table",
                "timezone": "UTC"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Connection Durations by Endpoint",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "query": "fields @timestamp, connection_duration, endpoint | stats avg(connection_duration) as avg_duration, max(connection_duration) as max_duration, min(connection_duration) as min_duration by endpoint | sort avg_duration desc",
                "logGroupNames": ["${ClientVpnLogGroupName}"],
                "view": "table",
                "timezone": "UTC"
              }
            }
          ]
        }
Outputs:
  DashboardName:
    Description: "Name of the created CloudWatch dashboard."
    Value: !Ref ClientVpnDashboard
  QueryDefinitionNames:
    Description: "Names of the saved CloudWatch Logs Insights queries."
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref TotalUsagePerEndpointQuery, !Ref UsagePerAuthTypeQuery, !Ref DistinctUsersQuery, !Ref ConnectionDurationsQuery]]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for Hospitality Insights Cognito user pool (prod) with SSO, custom domain, groups, and post-auth Lambda"

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Environment name (e.g., dev, prod)
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: HospitalityInsights
    Description: Application name
  LoginURL:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "SSO login URL (metadata URL for SAML). Leave empty to disable SSO."
  SSOProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Federated identity provider name. Leave empty to disable SSO."
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Custom domain prefix for Cognito hosted UI. Leave empty to skip custom domain."

Conditions:
  CreateSSOProvider: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref LoginURL, ""]]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOProviderName, ""]]
  CreateCustomDomain: !Not [!Equals [!Ref DomainPrefix, ""]]

Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoUpdateAttributes
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: "arn:aws:cognito-idp:*:*:userpool/*"

  PostAuthLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-PostAuth"
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import time

          def handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event['userPoolId']
              username = event['userName']
              client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
              timestamp = str(int(time.time()))
              try:
                  client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      UserAttributes=[
                          {
                              'Name': 'custom:last_login',
                              'Value': timestamp
                          }
                      ]
                  )
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error updating last_login for {username}: {e}")
              return event

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-UserPool"
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthLambda.Arn
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_LINK

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-Client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:last_login
      WriteAttributes:
        - custom:last_login
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 1440
      IdTokenValidity: 1440
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - https://localhost:3000
      LogoutURLs:
        - https://localhost:3000
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - !If [CreateSSOProvider, !Ref SSOProviderName, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

  UserPoolGroupAdmin:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolGroupRegularUser:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolGroupPowerUser:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      Precedence: 3
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Condition: CreateCustomDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: CreateSSOProvider
    Properties:
      ProviderName: !Ref SSOProviderName
      ProviderType: SAML
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
      ProviderDetails:
        MetadataURL: !Ref LoginURL

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool Client
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  UserPoolDomain:
    Condition: CreateCustomDomain
    Description: Custom domain for hosted UI
    Value: !Sub "https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
  IdentityProviderName:
    Condition: CreateSSOProvider
    Description: Name of the federated identity provider
    Value: !Ref SSOProviderName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for a WebSocket API with session management using DynamoDB and Lambda'

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    Description: 'Name of the API Gateway stage (default: api)'
  SessionTTLSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3600
    Description: 'TTL for session entries in DynamoDB (in seconds)'

Resources:
  # DynamoDB Table for session state
  SessionTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'WebSocketSessions-${AWS::StackName}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true

  # IAM Role for Lambda function
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WebSocketSessionDynamoDB
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/*'

  # IAM Role for API Gateway to invoke Lambda
  ApiGatewayExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaInvoke
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt WebSocketHandlerFunction.Arn

  # Lambda function
  WebSocketHandlerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'WebSocketHandler-${AWS::StackName}'
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionTable
          TTL_SECONDS: !Ref SessionTTLSeconds
          API_GATEWAY_ENDPOINT: !Sub 'https://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os
          import time
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          ttl_seconds = int(os.environ['TTL_SECONDS'])
          endpoint_url = os.environ['API_GATEWAY_ENDPOINT']

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)
          apigw_management = boto3.client('apigatewaymanagementapi', endpoint_url=endpoint_url)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              route_key = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('routeKey')
              connection_id = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('connectionId')

              if route_key == '$connect':
                  # Store connection with TTL
                  ttl = int(time.time()) + ttl_seconds
                  try:
                      table.put_item(Item={'connectionId': connection_id, 'ttl': ttl})
                  except ClientError as e:
                      print(f"Error putting item: {e}")
                      return {'statusCode': 500}
                  return {'statusCode': 200}

              elif route_key == '$disconnect':
                  # Remove connection
                  try:
                      table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
                  except ClientError as e:
                      print(f"Error deleting item: {e}")
                  return {'statusCode': 200}

              elif route_key == '$default':
                  # Echo the message back
                  body = event.get('body', '')
                  if body:
                      try:
                          apigw_management.post_to_connection(Data=body, ConnectionId=connection_id)
                      except ClientError as e:
                          if e.response['Error']['Code'] == 'GoneException':
                              # Connection already closed, clean up
                              table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
                          else:
                              print(f"Error posting to connection: {e}")
                  return {'statusCode': 200}

              else:
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': 'Unknown route'}

  # Permission for API Gateway to invoke Lambda (with source ARN)
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/*'

  # WebSocket API
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'WebSocketApi-${AWS::StackName}'
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: '$request.body.action' # default expression

  # Integrations for each route (all using Lambda proxy)
  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${WebSocketHandlerFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayExecutionRole.Arn

  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${WebSocketHandlerFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayExecutionRole.Arn

  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${WebSocketHandlerFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayExecutionRole.Arn

  # Routes
  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      Target: !Join ['/', ['integrations', !Ref ConnectIntegration]]

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      Target: !Join ['/', ['integrations', !Ref DefaultIntegration]]

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      Target: !Join ['/', ['integrations', !Ref DisconnectIntegration]]

  # Deployment (must depend on all routes to include them)
  ApiGatewayDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: 'Deployment with WebSocket routes'

  # Stage
  ApiGatewayStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiGatewayDeployment
      AutoDeploy: false

Outputs:
  WebSocketURL:
    Description: 'WebSocket API endpoint URL'
    Value: !Sub 'wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}'
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: 'DynamoDB session table name'
    Value: !Ref SessionTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Basic VPC with public subnet, IGW, route table, and NACL for testing."

Parameters:

    Type: String
    Description: "Select the VPC CIDR block (must be /16)."
    Default: "172.18.0.0/16"
    AllowedValues:
      - "172.18.0.0/16"
      - "172.19.0.0/16"
      - "172.20.0.0/16"
      - "172.21.0.0/16"
      - "172.22.0.0/16"
      - "172.23.0.0/16"

Conditions:
  Is17218: !Equals [!Ref VpcCidr, "172.18.0.0/16"]
  Is17219: !Equals [!Ref VpcCidr, "172.19.0.0/16"]
  Is17220: !Equals [!Ref VpcCidr, "172.20.0.0/16"]
  Is17221: !Equals [!Ref VpcCidr, "172.21.0.0/16"]
  Is17222: !Equals [!Ref VpcCidr, "172.22.0.0/16"]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "TestVPC"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "TestIGW"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !If
        - Is17218
        - "172.18.0.0/22"
        - !If
          - Is17219
          - "172.19.0.0/22"
          - !If
            - Is17220
            - "172.20.0.0/22"
            - !If
              - Is17221
              - "172.21.0.0/22"
              - !If
                - Is17222
                - "172.22.0.0/22"
                - "172.23.0.0/22"
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "PublicSubnet"

  PublicRouteTable:

    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "PublicRouteTable"

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:

    Properties:

      PortRange:

    Properties:

      Protocol: 17

      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl

      Protocol: 6

      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow

      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'AWS FIS Experiment Template for Chaos Engineering - Block cross-region traffic and pause replication'
Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Description: The target region to block network traffic to
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-[0-9]{1}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region code (e.g., us-west-2)

Resources:

          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Enabled: true
  FISLogsKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/fis-experiment-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FISLogsKMSKey
  FISExperimentLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/fis/experiments
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FISLogsKMSKey.Arn
  FISRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: AWSFISExperimentRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref FISPolicy
  FISPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: AWSFISExperimentPolicy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2Actions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3Actions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
              - s3:PutReplicationConfiguration
              - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowLogging
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
            Resource: !GetAtt FISExperimentLogGroup.Arn
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarms
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
            Resource: '*'
  FISExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Block network traffic to ${TargetRegion} and pause cross-region replication for chaos engineering'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FISRole.Arn
      StopConditions:
        - Source: none
      LogConfiguration:
        LogSchemaVersion: 1
        CloudWatchLogsConfiguration:
          LogGroupArn: !GetAtt FISExperimentLogGroup.Arn
      Targets:
        Subnets:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:subnet
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
          SelectionMode: ALL
        S3Buckets:
          ResourceType: aws:s3:bucket
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
          SelectionMode: ALL
      Actions:
        blockSubnetTraffic:
          ActionId: aws:ec2:disassociate-route-table
          Description: 'Disassociate route tables from subnets tagged with ChaosAllowed to block traffic to target region'
          Targets:

        pauseS3Replication:

          Description: 'Pause S3 cross-region replication on buckets tagged with ChaosAllowed'
          Parameters:

          Targets:

Outputs:
  ExperimentTemplateId:
    Description: ID of the created FIS experiment template
    Value: !Ref FISExperimentTemplate
  FISRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by FIS
    Value: !GetAtt FISRole.Arn
  LogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Log Group name for experiment logs

    Description: First availability zone (e.g., us-east-1a). Leave empty to auto-select.
  AvailabilityZone2:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Second availability zone (e.g., us-east-1b). Leave empty to auto-select.
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name for tagging resources.
Conditions:
  UseAZ1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AvailabilityZone1, '']]
  UseAZ2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AvailabilityZone2, '']]
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !If [UseAZ1, !Ref AvailabilityZone1, !Select [0, !GetAZs '']]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !If [UseAZ2, !Ref AvailabilityZone2, !Select [1, !GetAZs '']]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !If [UseAZ1, !Ref AvailabilityZone1, !Select [0, !GetAZs '']]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !If [UseAZ2, !Ref AvailabilityZone2, !Select [1, !GetAZs '']]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
  FlowLogKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting VPC flow logs
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: flow-log-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow VPC Flow Logs and CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
                - logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Enabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-log-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  FlowLogKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-flow-log-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKMSKey
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogKMSKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-log-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  FlowLogLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKMSKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-log-group'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: List of public subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: List of private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Description: Elastic IP for NAT Gateway in AZ1
    Value: !Ref NatGateway1EIP
  NatGateway2EIP:
    Description: Elastic IP for NAT Gateway in AZ2
    Value: !Ref NatGateway2EIP
  FlowLogKMSKeyId:
    Description: KMS Key ID for flow log encryption
    Value: !Ref FlowLogKMSKey
  FlowLogLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Log Group for VPC flow logs
    Value: !Ref FlowLogLogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Parameters:
  ParentImageId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id
    Description: AMI ID for the parent image (Amazon Linux 2 ECS optimized)
Resources:
  ImageBuilderComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: sample-component
      Version: 1.0.0
      Platform: Linux
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2
      Data: |
        name: ChefClientInstall
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - action: WebDownload
                name: DownloadChefClient
                inputs:
                  - source: https://packages.chef.io/files/stable/chef/18.2.7/el/7/chef-18.2.7-1.el7.x86_64.rpm
                    destination: /tmp/chef.rpm
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: InstallChefClient
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo rpm -Uvh /tmp/chef.rpm
      Description: Installs Chef Client via WebDownload

  ImageBuilderWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: sample-workflow
      Version: 1.0.0
      Type: BUILD
      Data: |
        name: sample-workflow
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        description: Updates SSM agent and builds AMI
        steps:
          - action: RunCommand
            name: UpdateSSMAgent
            inputs:
              instanceId: "{{ build.InstanceId }}"
              documentName: AWS-RunShellScript
              parameters:
                commands:
                  - sudo yum update -y amazon-ssm-agent
          - action: CreateImage
            name: BuildAMIImage
            inputs:
              instanceId: "{{ build.InstanceId }}"
      Description: Updates SSM agent and builds AMI

  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: sample-recipe
      Version: 1.0.0
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageId
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ImageBuilderComponent
        - ComponentArn: arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:component/chrony-config/1.0.0
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 30
            VolumeType: gp2

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-infrastructure
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Sub "imagebuilder-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
          S3KeyPrefix: logs

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-distribution
      Distributions:
        - Region: us-east-1
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: "sample-ami-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}"
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
            TargetAccountIds:
              - !Ref "AWS::AccountId"

  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: sample-image-pipeline
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: cron(0 9 * * ? *)
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE
      Status: ENABLED

  LifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: sample-lifecycle-policy
      Description: Deprecates AMIs older than 6 months for Dev environment
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecycleExecutionRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 180
            Unit: DAYS
          ExclusionRules:
            TagMap:
              Environment: Dev
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:
          Environment: Dev

  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
      Path: "/"

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  LifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
      Path: "/"

  LogBucketKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for ImageBuilder logs bucket encryption"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow S3 to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "aws:SourceAccount": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      Enabled: true

  LogBucketKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/imagebuilder-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LogBucketKmsKey

  LogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "imagebuilder-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireLogs
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 90
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref LogBucketKmsKey

  LogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub "${LogBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "aws:SourceAccount": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for Cognito authentication layer with Lex chatbot access"
Parameters:
  IdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: "identity pool"
  LexV1BotName:
    Type: String
    Default: "OrderFlowers"
  LexV2BotId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
  LexV2BotAliasId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
  ForceCognitoLogin:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Default: "false"
  ShouldEnableLiveChat:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Default: "false"
  LiveChatApiEndpointArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
Conditions:
  IsLexV2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LexV2BotId, ""]]
  IsLexV1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LexV1BotName, ""]]
  UseLexV1: !And [!Condition IsLexV1, !Equals [!Ref LexV2BotId, ""]]
  UseLexV2: !Condition IsLexV2
  ForceCognitoLoginTrue: !Equals [!Ref ForceCognitoLogin, "true"]
  NotForceCognitoLoginTrue: !Equals [!Ref ForceCognitoLogin, "false"]
  ShouldEnableLiveChatTrue: !Equals [!Ref ShouldEnableLiveChat, "true"]
  LiveChatApiProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LiveChatApiEndpointArn, ""]]
  AuthLexV1PolicyCondition: !Condition UseLexV1
  AuthLexV2PolicyCondition: !Condition UseLexV2
  AuthLiveChatPolicyCondition: !And [!Condition ShouldEnableLiveChatTrue, !Condition LiveChatApiProvided]
  UnauthLexV1AllowCondition: !And [!Condition UseLexV1, !Condition NotForceCognitoLoginTrue]
  UnauthLexV2AllowCondition: !And [!Condition UseLexV2, !Condition NotForceCognitoLoginTrue]
  UnauthLiveChatAllowCondition: !And [!Condition ShouldEnableLiveChatTrue, !Condition LiveChatApiProvided, !Condition NotForceCognitoLoginTrue]
  DenyLexV1Condition: !And [!Condition ForceCognitoLoginTrue, !Condition UseLexV1]
  DenyLexV2Condition: !And [!Condition ForceCognitoLoginTrue, !Condition UseLexV2]
  DenyLiveChatCondition: !And [!Condition ForceCognitoLoginTrue, !Condition ShouldEnableLiveChatTrue, !Condition LiveChatApiProvided]
Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-userpool"
      UsernameAttributes: ["email"]
      AutoVerifiedAttributes: ["email"]
      Schema:
        - Name: given_name
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: preferred_username
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-client"
      GenerateSecret: false
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_CUSTOM_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
  CognitoIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref IdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.ProviderName
  CognitoAuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": authenticated
      Policies: []
  CognitoUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": unauthenticated
      Policies: []
  AuthPollyPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AuthPollyPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoAuthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: polly:SynthesizeSpeech
            Resource: "*"
  AuthLexV1Policy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: AuthLexV1PolicyCondition
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AuthLexV1Policy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoAuthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lex:PostContent
              - lex:PostText
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}:*"
  AuthLexV2Policy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: AuthLexV2PolicyCondition
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AuthLexV2Policy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoAuthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lex:RecognizeText
              - lex:RecognizeUtterance
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias:${LexV2BotId}:${LexV2BotAliasId}"
  AuthLiveChatPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: AuthLiveChatPolicyCondition
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AuthLiveChatPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoAuthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: execute-api:Invoke
            Resource: !Ref LiveChatApiEndpointArn
  UnauthLexV1AllowPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: UnauthLexV1AllowCondition
    Properties:
      PolicyName: UnauthLexV1AllowPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoUnauthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lex:PostContent
              - lex:PostText
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}:*"
  UnauthLexV2AllowPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: UnauthLexV2AllowCondition
    Properties:
      PolicyName: UnauthLexV2AllowPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoUnauthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lex:RecognizeText
              - lex:RecognizeUtterance
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias:${LexV2BotId}:${LexV2BotAliasId}"
  UnauthLiveChatAllowPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: UnauthLiveChatAllowCondition
    Properties:
      PolicyName: UnauthLiveChatAllowPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoUnauthRole

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Customer Support Authentication Infrastructure using Amazon Cognito'
Parameters:
  CallbackURL:
    Type: String
    Default: 'http://localhost:3000/callback'
    Description: Callback URL for the web application client
  LogoutURL:
    Type: String
    Default: 'http://localhost:3000/logout'
    Description: Logout URL for the web application client
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: customersupport-auth
    Description: Prefix for the Cognito domain (must be globally unique)
  CustomScopeName:
    Type: String
    Default: read
    Description: Name of the custom OAuth scope to define on the resource server
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: cognito-auto-add-customer-group
    Description: Name for the Lambda function that auto-adds users to the customer group
Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: CustomerSupportUserPool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_LINK
        EmailSubjectByLink: 'Please verify your email for Customer Support'
        EmailMessageByLink: 'Click the link below to verify your email address. {##Verify Email##}'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      UserAttributeUpdateSettings:
        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:
          - email
      LambdaConfig:
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
  CognitoUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
  CognitoUserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Identifier: agentcore
      Name: AgentCoreResourceServer
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: !Ref CustomScopeName
          ScopeDescription: Read access to customer support data
  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      ClientName: web-app-client
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Join
          - '/'
          - - !Ref CognitoUserPoolResourceServer
            - !Ref CustomScopeName
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref CallbackURL
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref LogoutURL
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
  M2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      ClientName: m2m-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Join
          - '/'
          - - !Ref CognitoUserPoolResourceServer
            - !Ref CustomScopeName
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GroupName: admin
      Description: Administrators with elevated privileges
      Precedence: 10
  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GroupName: customer
      Description: Regular customer support users
      Precedence: 5
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: cognito-auto-add-customer-group-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoGroupMembershipPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: LambdaBasicExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunctionName
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.14
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME: customer
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import os

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event['userPoolId']
              username = event['userName']
              group_name = os.environ['CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME']
              client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
              try:
                  client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      GroupName=group_name
                  )
                  print(f'Added user {username} to group {group_name}')
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f'Error adding user {username} to group {group_name}: {str(e)}')
              return event
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.Arn
  SSMParamUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/userPoolId
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Description: Cognito User Pool ID
  SSMParamWebClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/webClientId
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient
      Description: Web application client ID
  SSMParamM2MClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/m2mClientId
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref M2MClient
      Description: Machine-to-machine client ID
  SSMParamOAuthScope:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/oauthScope
      Type: String
      Value: !Join
        - '/'
        - - !Ref CognitoUserPoolResourceServer
          - !Ref CustomScopeName
      Description: OAuth scope for API access
  SSMParamDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/discoveryUrl
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL
  SSMParamTokenEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/tokenEndpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
      Description: Token endpoint URL
  SSMParamAuthorizeEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/authorizeEndpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'
      Description: Authorization endpoint URL
  SSMParamDomain:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub '${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Description: Cognito domain for hosted UI

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC with public and private subnets across two AZs, NAT Gateways, and route tables"
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: "10.10.0.0/16"
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPC"
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.10.0.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1"
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.10.1.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2"
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.10.10.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1"
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.10.11.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2"
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IGW"
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  EIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NATGW1"
  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NATGW2"
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicRT"
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRT1"
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRT2"
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2
  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC
  VpcCidr:
    Description: "VPC CIDR block"
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
  AvailabilityZones:
    Description: "List of availability zones used"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Select [0, !GetAZs ""], !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]]]
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: "List of public subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: "List of private subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Route53 hosted zone for prxu.org with Google Workspace records, CloudFront alias records, legacy CNAMEs, feed proxy, router, and ACM validation records."
Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: prxu.org
    Description: The domain name for the hosted zone (without trailing dot).
  GoogleWorkspaceVerificationTXTValue:
    Type: String
    Default: google-site-verification=example
    Description: The TXT record value for Google Workspace domain verification (without surrounding quotes).
  CloudFrontDNSDovetailCdn:
    Type: String
    Default: d123.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution DNS name for dovetail-cdn subdomain.
  CloudFrontDNSDovetailCdnStaging:
    Type: String
    Default: d456.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution DNS name for dovetail-cdn-staging subdomain.
  CloudFrontDNSF:
    Type: String
    Default: d789.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution DNS name for f subdomain.
  CloudFrontDNSFStaging:
    Type: String
    Default: d012.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution DNS name for f-staging subdomain.
  CloudFrontDNSFDevelopment:
    Type: String
    Default: d345.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution DNS name for f.development subdomain.
  CloudFrontDNSA:
    Type: String
    Default: d678.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution DNS name for a subdomain.
  CloudFrontDNSRyanCdn:
    Type: String
    Default: d901.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution DNS name for ryan-cdn subdomain.
  LegacyCNAME1Name:
    Type: String
    Default: legacy
    Description: First legacy CNAME record name (e.g., legacy).
  LegacyCNAME1Target:
    Type: String
    Default: dovetail-cdn
    Description: First legacy CNAME target subdomain (e.g., dovetail-cdn).
  LegacyCNAME2Name:
    Type: String
    Default: legacy-staging
    Description: Second legacy CNAME record name (e.g., legacy-staging).
  LegacyCNAME2Target:
    Type: String
    Default: dovetail-cdn-staging
    Description: Second legacy CNAME target subdomain (e.g., dovetail-cdn-staging).
  FeedProxyProductionTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: feedproxy-production.example.com
    Description: Target DNS name for the feed proxy production subdomain.
  FeedProxyStagingTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: feedproxy-staging.example.com
    Description: Target DNS name for the feed proxy staging subdomain.
  RouterProductionTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: router-production.example.com
    Description: Target DNS name for the router production subdomain.
  RouterStagingTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: router-staging.example.com
    Description: Target DNS name for the router staging subdomain.
  ACMValidationWildcardName:
    Type: String
    Default: _abc123.prxu.org
    Description: CNAME record name for ACM validation of wildcard certificate.
  ACMValidationWildcardValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _def456.acm-validations.aws
    Description: CNAME record value for ACM validation of wildcard certificate.
  ACMValidationApexName:
    Type: String
    Default: _ghi789.prxu.org
    Description: CNAME record name for ACM validation of apex certificate.
  ACMValidationApexValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _jkl012.acm-validations.aws
    Description: CNAME record value for ACM validation of apex certificate.
Resources:
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Hosted zone for prxu.org
  GoogleWorkspaceTXTRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${GoogleWorkspaceVerificationTXTValue}"'
  GoogleWorkspaceMXRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: MX
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - "1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM"
        - "5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM"
        - "5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM"
        - "10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM"
        - "10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM"
  ARecordDovetailCdn:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "dovetail-cdn.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontDNSDovetailCdn
  AAAARecordDovetailCdn:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "dovetail-cdn.${DomainName}"
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontDNSDovetailCdn
  ARecordDovetailCdnStaging:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "dovetail-cdn-staging.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontDNSDovetailCdnStaging
  AAAARecordDovetailCdnStaging:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "dovetail-cdn-staging.${DomainName}"
      Type: AAAA
