AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Simple VPC setup for learning purposes with optional components."
Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "SimpleApp1"
    Description: "Prefix for naming resources."
  VPCCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC."
  PublicSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for the public subnet."
  SourceIPRange:
    Type: String
    Default: "0.0.0.0/0"
    Description: "Allowed source IP range for HTTP and HTTPS traffic."
  CreateInternetGateway:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: "Set to 'true' to create an Internet Gateway."
  CreatePublicSubnet:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: "Set to 'true' to create a public subnet."
  CreateRouteTable:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: "Set to 'true' to create a route table."
  CreateSecurityGroup:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: "Set to 'true' to create a security group."
Conditions:
  HasInternetGateway: !Equals [!Ref CreateInternetGateway, "true"]
  HasPublicSubnet: !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnet, "true"]
  HasRouteTable: !Equals [!Ref CreateRouteTable, "true"]
  HasSecurityGroup: !Equals [!Ref CreateSecurityGroup, "true"]
  HasInternetAndRouteTable: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateInternetGateway, "true"]
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateRouteTable, "true"]
  HasPublicSubnetAndRouteTable: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnet, "true"]
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateRouteTable, "true"]
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VPCCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-vpc"
  InternetGateway:
    Condition: HasInternetGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-igw"
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Condition: HasInternetGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnet
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-public-subnet"
  RouteTable:
    Condition: HasRouteTable
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-route-table"
  Route:
    Condition: HasInternetAndRouteTable
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnetAndRouteTable
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
  SecurityGroup:
    Condition: HasSecurityGroup
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for HTTP and HTTPS traffic"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !Ref SourceIPRange
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref SourceIPRange
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-security-group"
Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: "The ID of the created VPC."
    Value: !Ref VPC

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: "Landing Zone Hub VPC with Transit Gateway, NAT Gateways, VPC Endpoints, and Flow Logs"
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    Description: "Environment name prefix for resource naming and tagging"
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}'
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC"
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}'
    Description: "CIDR for the first public subnet"
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}'
    Description: "CIDR for the second public subnet"
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}'
    Description: "CIDR for the first private subnet"
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}'
    Description: "CIDR for the second private subnet"
  TransitGatewayAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    Description: "Private ASN for the Transit Gateway"
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-igw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private
  EIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-eip-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-eip-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-rtb"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  PublicRouteDefault:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rtb"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  PrivateRouteDefault:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayAsn
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-tgw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  TransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-tgw-attachment"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  PrivateRouteToTGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachment
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: flow-logs-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-flow-log-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  FlowLogLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}"
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-flow-log-group"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-flow-log"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc-endpoint-sg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  VpcEndpointS3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "*"
            Resource: "*"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-s3-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  VpcEndpointSSM:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Student Services Agent Infrastructure with Cognito OAuth2 and IAM Execution Roles"
Resources:
  BaseManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: student-services-base-policy
      Description: "Shared base policy granting Bedrock invocation, CloudWatch, X-Ray, and SSM access"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:InvokeModel
              - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - xray:PutTraceSegments
              - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource:
              Fn::Sub: arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services/*
  StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: student-services-agent-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount:
                  Ref: AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn:
                  Fn::Sub: arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agent/*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - Ref: BaseManagedPolicy
  StudentServicesGatewayUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: student-services-gateway-user-pool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 6
          RequireUppercase: false

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark Section 3 - Log Monitoring Controls"
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CIS-Monitoring"
    Description: "Environment name for resource naming"
  LogGroupRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3653
    Description: "Retention period for CloudWatch Logs log group (default 10 years)"
Resources:
  CISMetricFilterKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for encrypting SNS topic and CloudWatch Logs log group"
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                "kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn": !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailLogs"
          - Sid: "Allow SNS to use the key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
            Resource: "*"
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      MultiRegion: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-KMSKey"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  CISMetricFilterKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${EnvironmentName}-CISMonitorKey"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CISMetricFilterKey
  CISCloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailLogs"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogGroupRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CISMetricFilterKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-LogGroup"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  CISAlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CISAlarmTopic"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref CISMetricFilterKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-SNS"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  CISAlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref CISAlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Allow CloudWatch Alarms to publish"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "cloudwatch.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sns:Publish"
            Resource: !Ref CISAlarmTopic
  CIS31MetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CISCloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3.1-UnauthorizedAPICalls"
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.errorCode = "*UnauthorizedOperation") || ($.errorCode = "AccessDenied*") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "1"
          MetricNamespace: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}/CISMetrics"
          MetricName: "UnauthorizedAPICalls"
  CIS31Alarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3.1-UnauthorizedAPICalls"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm for unauthorized API calls"
      MetricName: "UnauthorizedAPICalls"
      Namespace: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}/CISMetrics"
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CISAlarmTopic
  CIS31QueryDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3.1-UnauthorizedAPICalls"
      QueryString: "fields @timestamp, @message\n| filter (errorCode = \"*UnauthorizedOperation\") or (errorCode like \"AccessDenied\")\n| sort @timestamp desc\n| limit 20"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CISCloudTrailLogGroup
  CIS32MetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CISCloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3.2-ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA"
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "1"
          MetricNamespace: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}/CISMetrics"
          MetricName: "ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA"
  CIS32Alarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3.2-ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm for console sign-in without MFA"
      MetricName: "ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA"
      Namespace: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}/CISMetrics"
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CISAlarmTopic
  CIS32QueryDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3.2-ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA"
      QueryString: "fields @timestamp, @message\n| filter eventName = \"ConsoleLogin\" and additionalEventData.MFAUsed != \"Yes\"\n| sort @timestamp desc\n| limit 20"
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CISCloudTrailLogGroup
  CIS33MetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CISCloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3.3-UseOfRootAccount"
      FilterPattern: '{ $.userIdentity.type = "Root" && $.userIdentity.invokedBy NOT EXISTS && $.eventType != "AwsServiceEvent" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "1"
          MetricNamespace: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}/CISMetrics"
          MetricName: "UseOfRootAccount"
  CIS33Alarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-CIS3.3-UseOfRootAccount"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm for use of root account"
      MetricName: "UseOfRootAccount"
      Namespace: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}/CISMetrics"
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CISAlarmTopic
  CIS33QueryDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Security Hub automation across AWS Organization using Control Tower lifecycle events

Resources:
  AutomationAssumeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SecurityHubAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: 'arn:aws:iam::*:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:GetParameter
                Resource: 'arn:aws:ssm:*:*:parameter/superwerker/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: organizations:RegisterDelegatedAdministrator
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: securityhub:ListInvitations
                Resource: '*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonSSMAutomationRole'

  SecurityHubInitialSetupDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'Initial Security Hub setup: enable in audit, register delegated admin, enable in log archive, create member and invite'
        mainSteps:
          - name: GetAuditAccountId
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: GetParameter
              Name: '/superwerker/audit_account_id'
            outputs:
              - Name: AuditAccountId
                Selector: '$.Parameter.Value'
                Type: String
          - name: GetLogArchiveAccountId
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: GetParameter
              Name: '/superwerker/log_archive_account_id'
            outputs:
              - Name: LogArchiveAccountId
                Selector: '$.Parameter.Value'
                Type: String
          - name: EnableSecurityHubInAuditAndRegisterDelegatedAdmin
            action: 'aws:executeScript'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                AuditAccountId: '{{ GetAuditAccountId.AuditAccountId }}'
                RoleName: AWSControlTowerExecution
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def handler(events, context):
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    audit_id = events['AuditAccountId']
                    role_arn = f'arn:aws:iam::{audit_id}:role/{events["RoleName"]}'
                    assumed = sts.assume_role(RoleArn=role_arn, RoleSessionName='SecurityHubAudit')
                    creds = assumed['Credentials']
                    sh = boto3.client('securityhub',
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken'],
                        region_name='us-east-1')
                    sh.enable_security_hub()
                    org = boto3.client('organizations',
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken'])
                    org.register_delegated_administrator(
                        AccountId=audit_id,
                        ServicePrincipal='securityhub.amazonaws.com'
                    )
                    return {'Status': 'Success'}
            onFailure: Abort
          - name: EnableSecurityHubInLogArchive
            action: 'aws:executeScript'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                LogArchiveAccountId: '{{ GetLogArchiveAccountId.LogArchiveAccountId }}'
                RoleName: AWSControlTowerExecution
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def handler(events, context):
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    log_archive_id = events['LogArchiveAccountId']
                    role_arn = f'arn:aws:iam::{log_archive_id}:role/{events["RoleName"]}'
                    assumed = sts.assume_role(RoleArn=role_arn, RoleSessionName='SecurityHubLogArchive')
                    creds = assumed['Credentials']
                    sh = boto3.client('securityhub',
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken'],
                        region_name='us-east-1')
                    sh.enable_security_hub()
                    return {'Status': 'Success'}
            onFailure: Abort
          - name: CreateMemberAndInvite
            action: 'aws:executeScript'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                AuditAccountId: '{{ GetAuditAccountId.AuditAccountId }}'
                LogArchiveAccountId: '{{ GetLogArchiveAccountId.LogArchiveAccountId }}'
                RoleName: AWSControlTowerExecution
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def handler(events, context):
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    audit_id = events['AuditAccountId']
                    log_archive_id = events['LogArchiveAccountId']
                    role_arn = f'arn:aws:iam::{audit_id}:role/{events["RoleName"]}'
                    assumed = sts.assume_role(RoleArn=role_arn, RoleSessionName='SecurityHubAuditMembers')
                    creds = assumed['Credentials']
                    sh = boto3.client('securityhub',
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken'],
                        region_name='us-east-1')
                    sh.create_members(AccountDetails=[{'AccountId': log_archive_id}])
                    sh.invite_members(AccountIds=[log_archive_id])
                    return {'Status': 'Success'}
            onFailure: Abort

  SecurityHubNewAccountSetupDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'Enable Security Hub in a new account and accept invitation'
        parameters:
          AccountId:
            type: String
            description: 'The AWS account ID of the new account'
        mainSteps:
          - name: GetAuditAccountId
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'

              Service: ssm
              Api: GetParameter

            outputs:
              - Name: AuditAccountId
                Selector: '$.Parameter.Value'
                Type: String
          - name: EnableSecurityHubAndAcceptInvitation
            action: 'aws:executeScript'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                AccountId: '{{ AccountId }}'
                AuditAccountId: '{{ GetAuditAccountId.AuditAccountId }}'
                RoleName: AWSControlTowerExecution
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def handler(events, context):
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    new_account_id = events['AccountId']
                    audit_id = events['AuditAccountId']
                    role_arn = f'arn:aws:iam::{new_account_id}:role/{events["RoleName"]}'
                    assumed = sts.assume_role(RoleArn=role_arn, RoleSessionName='SecurityHubNewAccount')
                    creds = assumed['Credentials']
                    sh = boto3.client('securityhub',
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken'],
                        region_name='us-east-1')
                    sh.enable_security_hub()
                    invitations = sh.list_invitations()['Invitations']
                    for inv in invitations:
                        if inv['AdministratorAccountId'] == audit_id:
                            sh.accept_invitation(
                                AdministratorId=audit_id,
                                InvitationId=inv['InvitationId']
                            )
                            break
                    return {'Status': 'Success'}
            onFailure: Abort

  EventBridgeRuleNewAccount:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: 'Trigger Security Hub setup for new Control Tower accounts'
      EventPattern:
        source:

        detail-type:
          - AWS Control Tower Lifecycle Event
        detail:
          eventType:
            - CreateManagedAccount
          status:
            - SUCCEEDED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${SecurityHubNewAccountSetupDocument}'
          Id: SSMAutomationTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt AutomationAssumeRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:

            InputTemplate: '{"AccountId": "<accountId>"}'

  EventBridgeRuleLandingZoneUpdate:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: 'Trigger initial Security Hub setup after landing zone update'
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.controltower
        detail-type:
          - AWS Control Tower Lifecycle Event
        detail:
          eventType:
            - UpdateLandingZone
          status:
            - SUCCEEDED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${SecurityHubInitialSetupDocument}'
          Id: SSMAutomationTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt AutomationAssumeRole.Arn

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMStartAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SecurityHubInitialSetupDocument}:$DEFAULT'

  TriggerInitialSetupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: nodejs24.x
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          const cfnResponse = require('cfn-response');
          const AWS = require('aws-sdk');
          const ssm = new AWS.SSM();
          exports.handler = (event, context) => {
            if (event.RequestType === 'Create') {
              const params = {
                DocumentName: process.env.DOCUMENT_NAME,
                DocumentVersion: '$DEFAULT'
              };
              ssm.startAutomationExecution(params).promise()
                .then(() => {
                  cfnResponse.send(event, context, cfnResponse.SUCCESS, {});
                })
                .catch((err) => {
                  console.error(err);
                  cfnResponse.send(event, context, cfnResponse.FAILED, { Error: err.message });
                });
            } else {
              cfnResponse.send(event, context, cfnResponse.SUCCESS, {});
            }
          };
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DOCUMENT_NAME: !Ref SecurityHubInitialSetupDocument
      Timeout: 300

  InitialSetupCustomResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt TriggerInitialSetupFunction.Arn
    DependsOn:
      - SecurityHubInitialSetupDocument
      - AutomationAssumeRole

Outputs:
  AutomationAssumeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the SSM Automation execution role
    Value: !GetAtt AutomationAssumeRole.Arn
  InitialSetupDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM document for initial setup
    Value: !Ref SecurityHubInitialSetupDocument
  NewAccountSetupDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM document for new account setup
    Value: !Ref SecurityHubNewAccountSetupDocument

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Resources:

        Statement:

            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"

            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow SQS to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:

            Resource: "*"
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT

      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  FIFOQueueNoDLQ:

    Properties:
      QueueName: FifoQueueNoDLQ.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

    Properties:
      QueueName: FifoQueueWithDLQ.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FIFODLQForQueueWithDLQ.Arn

      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1000000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Networking infrastructure for private ROSA cluster with PrivateLink and egress VPC"
Parameters:
  RosaVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.1.0.0/16"
    Description: "CIDR for the ROSA VPC"
  EgressVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: "CIDR for the egress VPC"
  NumberOfAzs:
    Type: String
    Default: "3"
    AllowedValues:
      - "1"
      - "3"
    Description: "Number of Availability Zones for ROSA subnets (1 or 3)"
  RosaSubnetCidr1:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.1.0.0/20"
    Description: "CIDR for ROSA subnet in first AZ"
  RosaSubnetCidr2:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.1.16.0/20"
    Description: "CIDR for ROSA subnet in second AZ (only used if 3 AZs)"
  RosaSubnetCidr3:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.1.32.0/20"
    Description: "CIDR for ROSA subnet in third AZ (only used if 3 AZs)"
  EgressPublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR for egress VPC public subnet"
  EgressPrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR for egress VPC private subnet"
  CreateElbServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: "Optionally create the AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing service-linked role"
  EnableVpcFlowLogs:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: "Optionally enable VPC Flow Logs for both VPCs"
Conditions:
  IsThreeAz: !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAzs, "3"]
  CreateFlowLogs: !Equals [!Ref EnableVpcFlowLogs, "true"]
  CreateElbRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateElbServiceLinkedRole, "true"]
Resources:
  # Egress VPC
  EgressVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "egress-vpc"
  EgressInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "egress-igw"
  EgressVpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressInternetGateway
  EgressPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPublicSubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "egress-public-subnet"
  EgressPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "egress-private-subnet"
  EgressNatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  EgressNatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EgressNatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "egress-nat-gw"
  EgressPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "egress-public-rt"
  EgressPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: EgressVpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref EgressInternetGateway
  EgressPublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
  EgressPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "egress-private-rt"
  EgressPrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref EgressNatGateway
  EgressPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable

  # ROSA VPC
  RosaVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "rosa-vpc"
  RosaSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnetCidr1
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "rosa-private-subnet-1"
  RosaSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsThreeAz
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnetCidr2
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "rosa-private-subnet-2"
  RosaSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsThreeAz
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnetCidr3
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "rosa-private-subnet-3"
  RosaPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "rosa-private-rt"
  RosaSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable
  RosaSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Condition: IsThreeAz
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable
  RosaSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Condition: IsThreeAz
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable

  # Transit Gateway
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "rosa-egress-tgw"
  # IAM role for Lambda
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DescribeTransitGateway
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTables
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: Logging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
  TgwReadyCheckFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.14
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import time
          def handler(event, context):
              if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
                  return
              ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
              resource_id = event['ResourceProperties'].get('TransitGatewayId') or event['ResourceProperties'].get('TransitGatewayRouteTableId')
              is_route_table = 'TransitGatewayRouteTableId' in event['ResourceProperties']
              max_attempts = 30
              for i in range(max_attempts):
                  if is_route_table:
                      response = ec2.describe_transit_gateway_route_tables(TransitGatewayRouteTableIds=[resource_id])
                      state = response['TransitGatewayRouteTables'][0]['State']
                  else:
                      response = ec2.describe_transit_gateways(TransitGatewayIds=[resource_id])
                      state = response['TransitGateways'][0]['State']
                  if state == 'available':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
                      return
                  time.sleep(5)
              cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': 'Timeout waiting for resource available'})
      Timeout: 300
  TgwReadyCheck:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt TgwReadyCheckFunction.Arn
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
  TgwRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    DependsOn: TgwReadyCheck
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "tgw-route-table"
  TgwRouteTableReadyCheck:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt TgwReadyCheckFunction.Arn
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TgwRouteTable
  TgwAttachmentEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    DependsOn: TgwReadyCheck
    Properties:
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "tgw-attach-egress"
  TgwAttachmentRosa:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    DependsOn: TgwReadyCheck
    Properties:
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref RosaSubnet1
        - !If [IsThreeAz, !Ref RosaSubnet2, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
        - !If [IsThreeAz, !Ref RosaSubnet3, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "tgw-attach-rosa"
  TgwRouteToEgressPrivate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TgwRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TgwAttachmentEgress
  TgwRouteToRosaVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TgwRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TgwAttachmentRosa
  RosaRouteToInternetViaTgw:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn:
      - TgwReadyCheck
      - TgwAttachmentRosa
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
  EgressPrivateRouteToRosaVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn:
      - TgwReadyCheck
      - TgwAttachmentEgress
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  # VPC Flow Logs (conditional)
  FlowLogRole:
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchLogsFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "flow-logs-role"
  FlowLogKmsKey:
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
      Description: "KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption"
      Enabled: true
  FlowLogGroup:
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "vpc-flow-logs"
  RosaVpcFlowLog:
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref RosaVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
  EgressVpcFlowLog:
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref EgressVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn

  # Optional ELB Service-Linked Role
  ElbServiceLinkedRole:
    Condition: CreateElbRole
    Type: AWS::IAM::ServiceLinkedRole
    Properties:
      AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
      Description: "Service-linked role for Elastic Load Balancing"

Outputs:
  RosaVpcId:
    Description: "ID of the ROSA VPC"
    Value: !Ref RosaVpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RosaVpcId"
  EgressVpcId:
    Description: "ID of the egress VPC"
    Value: !Ref EgressVpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EgressVpcId"
  RosaSubnet1Id:
    Description: "ID of ROSA subnet 1"
    Value: !Ref RosaSubnet1
  RosaSubnet2Id:
    Condition: IsThreeAz
    Description: "ID of ROSA subnet 2"
    Value: !Ref RosaSubnet2
  RosaSubnet3Id:
    Condition: IsThreeAz
    Description: "ID of ROSA subnet 3"
    Value: !Ref RosaSubnet3
  EgressPublicSubnetId:
    Description: "ID of egress public subnet"
    Value: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
  EgressPrivateSubnetId:
    Description: "ID of egress private subnet"
    Value: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: "ID of the Transit Gateway"
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
  NatGatewayId:
    Description: "ID of the NAT Gateway"
    Value: !Ref EgressNatGateway
  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: "ID of the Internet Gateway"
    Value: !Ref EgressInternetGateway
  FlowLogGroupName:
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Description: "CloudWatch Log Group for VPC Flow Logs"
    Value: !Ref FlowLogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: Prerequisite resources and SSM Automation documents for PCI DSS remediation
Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: CloudTrail/DefaultLogGroup
    Description: Name for the CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs log group
  KMSKeyAliasName:
    Type: String
    Default: alias/CloudTrailEncryptionKey
    Description: Alias for the KMS customer master key
  SSMAutomationRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: SSMAutomationRemediationRole
    Description: IAM role name for SSM automations
  CloudTrailCloudWatchRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRole
    Description: IAM role name for CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs integration
  DocumentNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: PCI-DSS-
    Description: Prefix for SSM automation document names
Resources:
  CloudTrailCloudWatchLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 1827
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer master key for CloudTrail encryption with automatic rotation
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      MultiRegion: false
  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Ref KMSKeyAliasName
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref SSMAutomationRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
  CloudTrailCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref CloudTrailCloudWatchRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
  CloudTrailCloudWatchPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CloudTrailCloudWatchRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
              - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
            Resource: '*'
  EncryptCloudTrailWithKMSAndCloudWatch:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${DocumentNamePrefix}EncryptCloudTrailWithKMSAndCloudWatch
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Encrypt a CloudTrail trail with a KMS key and integrate with CloudWatch Logs
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail
          KMSKeyId:
            type: String
            description: KMS key ID or ARN
          LogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group
          RoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role for CloudWatch Logs
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrail
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: lambda_handler
              InputPayload:
                TrailName: '{{ TrailName }}'
                KMSKeyId: '{{ KMSKeyId }}'
                LogGroupArn: '{{ LogGroupArn }}'
                RoleArn: '{{ RoleArn }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def lambda_handler(event, context):
                    client = boto3.client('cloudtrail')
                    response = client.update_trail(
                        Name=event['TrailName'],
                        KmsKeyId=event['KMSKeyId'],
                        CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn=event['LogGroupArn'],
                        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn=event['RoleArn']
                    )
                    return {'Success': True, 'TrailARN': response['TrailARN']}
            outputs:
              - Name: Success
                Selector: $.Payload.Success
                Type: Boolean
              - Name: TrailARN
                Selector: $.Payload.TrailARN
                Type: String
  EnableKMSKeyRotation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${DocumentNamePrefix}EnableKMSKeyRotation
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enable key rotation for a specified KMS key
        parameters:
          KeyId:
            type: String
            description: KMS key ID or ARN
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableRotation
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: lambda_handler
              InputPayload:
                KeyId: '{{ KeyId }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def lambda_handler(event, context):
                    client = boto3.client('kms')
                    client.enable_key_rotation(KeyId=event['KeyId'])
                    return {'Success': True, 'KeyId': event['KeyId']}
            outputs:
              - Name: Success
                Selector: $.Payload.Success
                Type: Boolean
  IntegrateCloudTrailWithCloudWatch:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${DocumentNamePrefix}IntegrateCloudTrailWithCloudWatch
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Integrate a CloudTrail trail with CloudWatch Logs
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail
          LogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group
          RoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role for CloudWatch Logs
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrail
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: lambda_handler
              InputPayload:
                TrailName: '{{ TrailName }}'
                LogGroupArn: '{{ LogGroupArn }}'
                RoleArn: '{{ RoleArn }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def lambda_handler(event, context):
                    client = boto3.client('cloudtrail')
                    response = client.update_trail(
                        Name=event['TrailName'],
                        CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn=event['LogGroupArn'],
                        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn=event['RoleArn']
                    )
                    return {'Success': True, 'TrailARN': response['TrailARN']}
            outputs:
              - Name: Success
                Selector: $.Payload.Success
                Type: Boolean
              - Name: TrailARN
                Selector: $.Payload.TrailARN
                Type: String
  UpdateIAMPasswordPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${DocumentNamePrefix}UpdateIAMPasswordPolicy
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Update the account IAM password policy to enforce PCI DSS requirements
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdatePasswordPolicy
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: lambda_handler
              InputPayload: {}
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def lambda_handler(event, context):
                    client = boto3.client('iam')
                    client.update_account_password_policy(
                        MinimumPasswordLength=14,
                        RequireUppercaseCharacters=True,
                        RequireLowercaseCharacters=True,
                        RequireNumbers=True,
                        RequireSymbols=True,
                        AllowUsersToChangePassword=True,
                        HardExpiry=True,
                        MaxPasswordAge=90,
                        PasswordReusePrevention=24
                    )
                    return {'Success': True}
            outputs:
              - Name: Success
                Selector: $.Payload.Success
                Type: Boolean
  EnableCloudTrailLogFileValidation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${DocumentNamePrefix}EnableCloudTrailLogFileValidation
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enable log file validation for a CloudTrail trail with multi-region and CloudWatch integration
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail
          LogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group
          RoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role for CloudWatch Logs
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrail
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: lambda_handler
              InputPayload:
                TrailName: '{{ TrailName }}'
                LogGroupArn: '{{ LogGroupArn }}'
                RoleArn: '{{ RoleArn }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def lambda_handler(event, context):
                    client = boto3.client('cloudtrail')
                    response = client.update_trail(
                        Name=event['TrailName'],
                        EnableLogFileValidation=True,
                        IsMultiRegionTrail=True,
                        CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn=event['LogGroupArn'],
                        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn=event['RoleArn']
                    )
                    return {'Success': True, 'TrailARN': response['TrailARN']}
            outputs:
              - Name: Success
                Selector: $.Payload.Success
                Type: Boolean
              - Name: TrailARN
                Selector: $.Payload.TrailARN
                Type: String
  RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${DocumentNamePrefix}RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Revoke all inbound and outbound rules on a default security group
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the default security group
        mainSteps:
          - name: DescribeAndRevokeRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: lambda_handler
              InputPayload:
                SecurityGroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def lambda_handler(event, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    sg_id = event['SecurityGroupId']
                    response = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[sg_id])
                    sg = response['SecurityGroups'][0]
                    ip_permissions = sg.get('IpPermissions', [])
                    ip_permissions_egress = sg.get('IpPermissionsEgress', [])
                    if ip_permissions:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(
                            GroupId=sg_id,
                            IpPermissions=ip_permissions
                        )
                    if ip_permissions_egress:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(
                            GroupId=sg_id,
                            IpPermissions=ip_permissions_egress
                        )
                    return {'Success': True, 'SecurityGroupId': sg_id}
            outputs:
              - Name: Success
                Selector: $.Payload.Success
                Type: Boolean
  DeleteSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${DocumentNamePrefix}DeleteSecurityGroup
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Delete a specified security group
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the security group to delete
        mainSteps:
          - name: DeleteSG
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: lambda_handler
              InputPayload:
                SecurityGroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def lambda_handler(event, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    ec2.delete_security_group(GroupId=event['SecurityGroupId'])
                    return {'Success': True, 'SecurityGroupId': event['SecurityGroupId']}
            outputs:
              - Name: Success
                Selector: $.Payload.Success
                Type: Boolean
  ReleaseElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${DocumentNamePrefix}ReleaseElasticIP
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Release an unused Elastic IP address
        parameters:
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: Allocation ID of the Elastic IP to release
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReleaseAddress
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: lambda_handler
              InputPayload:
                AllocationId: '{{ AllocationId }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def lambda_handler(event, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    ec2.release_address(AllocationId=event['AllocationId'])
                    return {'Success': True, 'AllocationId': event['AllocationId']}
            outputs:
              - Name: Success
                Selector: $.Payload.Success
                Type: Boolean
  RemoveCodeBuildEnvVars:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${DocumentNamePrefix}RemoveCodeBuildEnvVars
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Update a CodeBuild project to remove AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY environment variables
        parameters:
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CodeBuild project
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateCodeBuildProject
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: lambda_handler
              InputPayload:
                ProjectName: '{{ ProjectName }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def lambda_handler(event, context):
                    cb = boto3.client('codebuild')
                    project_name = event['ProjectName']
                    response = cb.batch_get_projects(names=[project_name])
                    project = response['projects'][0]
                    env_vars = project['environment']['environmentVariables']
                    filtered_vars = [
                        var for var in env_vars
                        if var['name'] not in ['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY']
                    ]
                    project['environment']['environmentVariables'] = filtered_vars
                    cb.update_project(
                        name=project_name,
                        description=project.get('description', ''),
                        source=project['source'],
                        artifacts=project['artifacts'],
                        environment=project['environment'],
                        serviceRole=project['serviceRole'],
                        encryptionKey=project.get('encryptionKey', ''),
                        tags=project.get('tags', [])
                    )
                    return {'Success': True, 'ProjectName': project_name}
            outputs:
              - Name: Success
                Selector: $.Payload.Success
                Type: Boolean

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for Claude Desktop (CoWork) telemetry monitoring - creates CloudWatch Logs log group, metric filters, and dashboard"

Parameters:
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: "ClaudeDesktopCoWorkTelemetry"
    Description: "Name of the CloudWatch dashboard"
  MetricsRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: "us-east-1"
    Description: "AWS region for metrics and dashboard"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-[0-9]{1}$"
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: "/claude-desktop/cowork-telemetry"
    Description: "Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group for CoWork events"
  LogGroupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    Description: "Retention period in days for the log group"
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]

Resources:
  # CloudWatch Logs Log Group
  CoWorkLogGroup:
    Type: "AWS::Logs::LogGroup"
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogGroupRetentionDays

  # ============================================================
  # Metric Filters - Local Agent Mode Schema (event="cowork_usage")
  # ============================================================

  InputTokensFilterSchemaA:
    Type: "AWS::Logs::MetricFilter"
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event = "cowork_usage" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.input_tokens"
          MetricNamespace: "ClaudeDesktop/CoWork"
          MetricName: "InputTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0

  OutputTokensFilterSchemaA:
    Type: "AWS::Logs::MetricFilter"
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event = "cowork_usage" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.output_tokens"
          MetricNamespace: "ClaudeDesktop/CoWork"
          MetricName: "OutputTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0

  CacheReadTokensFilterSchemaA:
    Type: "AWS::Logs::MetricFilter"
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event = "cowork_usage" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.cache_read_tokens"
          MetricNamespace: "ClaudeDesktop/CoWork"
          MetricName: "CacheReadTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0

  CacheCreationTokensFilterSchemaA:
    Type: "AWS::Logs::MetricFilter"
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event = "cowork_usage" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.cache_creation_tokens"
          MetricNamespace: "ClaudeDesktop/CoWork"
          MetricName: "CacheCreationTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0

  EstimatedCostFilterSchemaA:
    Type: "AWS::Logs::MetricFilter"
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event = "cowork_usage" }'
      MetricTransformations:

      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event = "cowork_usage" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.session_turn"
          MetricNamespace: "ClaudeDesktop/CoWork"
          MetricName: "SessionTurnCount"
          DefaultValue: 0

  # ============================================================
  # Metric Filters - Claude Code for Desktop Schema (event_type="cowork_metrics")
  # ============================================================

  InputTokensFilterSchemaB:
    Type: "AWS::Logs::MetricFilter"
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "cowork_metrics" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.input_tokens"

          MetricName: "InputTokens"

  OutputTokensFilterSchemaB:
    Type: "AWS::Logs::MetricFilter"
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "cowork_metrics" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.output_tokens"
          MetricNamespace: "ClaudeDesktop/CoWork"
          MetricName: "OutputTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0

  CacheReadTokensFilterSchemaB:
    Type: "AWS::Logs::MetricFilter"
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "cowork_metrics" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.cache_read_tokens"
          MetricNamespace: "ClaudeDesktop/CoWork"
          MetricName: "CacheReadTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0

  CacheCreationTokensFilterSchemaB:
    Type: "AWS::Logs::MetricFilter"
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "cowork_metrics" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.cache_creation_tokens"

  EstimatedCostFilterSchemaB:

    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:

      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "cowork_metrics" }'

    Properties:

      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "cowork_metrics" }'
      MetricTransformations:

  # ============================================================

    Type: "AWS::Logs::MetricFilter"
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event = "cowork_usage" && $.user = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:

          MetricName: "InputTokensPerUser"

      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.output_tokens"
          MetricNamespace: "ClaudeDesktop/CoWork"
          MetricName: "OutputTokensPerUser"
          Dimensions:
            - Key: "User"
              Value: "$.user"

  EstimatedCostPerUserFilterSchemaA:
    Type: "AWS::Logs::MetricFilter"
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event = "cowork_usage" && $.user = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.cost"
          MetricNamespace: "ClaudeDesktop/CoWork"
          MetricName: "EstimatedCostPerUser"
          Dimensions:
            - Key: "User"
              Value: "$.user"

  SessionTurnCountPerUserFilterSchemaA:
    Type: "AWS::Logs::MetricFilter"
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event = "cowork_usage" && $.user = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.session_turn"
          MetricNamespace: "ClaudeDesktop/CoWork"
          MetricName: "SessionTurnCountPerUser"
          Dimensions:
            - Key: "User"
              Value: "$.user"

  # ============================================================
  # Per-User Metric Filters - Schema B (with user dimension)
  # ============================================================

  InputTokensPerUserFilterSchemaB:
    Type: "AWS::Logs::MetricFilter"
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "cowork_metrics" && $.user_id = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.input_tokens"
          MetricNamespace: "ClaudeDesktop/CoWork"
          MetricName: "InputTokensPerUser"

  OutputTokensPerUserFilterSchemaB:
    Type: "AWS::Logs::MetricFilter"
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:

      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "cowork_metrics" && $.user_id = "*" }'
      MetricTransformations:

          MetricNamespace: "ClaudeDesktop/CoWork"
          MetricName: "OutputTokensPerUser"

  EstimatedCostPerUserFilterSchemaB:

          MetricNamespace: "ClaudeDesktop/CoWork"
          MetricName: "ActiveUserEvents"
          Dimensions:
            - Key: "User"
