AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Self-contained bootstrap environment for deploying AWS CDK applications"
Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Default: cdk
    AllowedPattern: "[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+"
    Description: Short string to uniquely identify stack components
  BootstrapVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: "1"
    Description: Version of the bootstrap configuration (stored in SSM)
  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Comma-separated list of AWS account IDs that can assume the IAM roles (leave empty to allow only the current account)
  CustomAssetBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional custom name for the S3 asset bucket
  ExistingKmsKeyId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional existing KMS key ID or ARN for bucket encryption
Conditions:
  CreateBucket: !Equals [!Ref CustomAssetBucketName, ""]
  UseExistingKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExistingKmsKeyId, ""]]
  CreateKey: !Equals [!Ref ExistingKmsKeyId, ""]
  IsTrustedAccountsProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TrustedAccounts, ""]]
Resources:
  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - IsTrustedAccountsProvided
                - !Split [",", !Ref TrustedAccounts]
                - !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "s3:PutObject"
                  - "s3:PutObjectAcl"
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "kms:Decrypt"
                  - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
                Resource: !If
                  - UseExistingKey
                  - !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: "cdk-bootstrap:qualifier"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier
  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - IsTrustedAccountsProvided
                - !Split [",", !Ref TrustedAccounts]
                - !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryPowerUser"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "ecr:PutImage"
                  - "ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability"
                  - "ecr:InitiateLayerUpload"
                  - "ecr:UploadLayerPart"
                  - "ecr:CompleteLayerUpload"
                  - "ecr:GetAuthorizationToken"
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: "cdk-bootstrap:qualifier"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier
  LookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - IsTrustedAccountsProvided
                - !Split [",", !Ref TrustedAccounts]
                - !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess"
      Tags:
        - Key: "cdk-bootstrap:qualifier"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier
  DeployRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - IsTrustedAccountsProvided
                - !Split [",", !Ref TrustedAccounts]
                - !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "cloudformation:*"
                  - "iam:PassRole"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "s3:GetObject"
                  - "s3:GetObjectVersion"
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "kms:Decrypt"
                  - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
                Resource: !If
                  - UseExistingKey
                  - !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: "cdk-bootstrap:qualifier"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier
  CfnExecRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "cloudformation.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess"
      Tags:
        - Key: "cdk-bootstrap:qualifier"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier
  CdkBootstrapKey:
    Condition: CreateKey
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "KMS key for CDK bootstrap environment (qualifier: ${Qualifier})"
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow use of the key by the file publishing role
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt FilePublishingRole.Arn
            Action:
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow use of the key by the deploy role
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt DeployRole.Arn
            Action:
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
            Resource: "*"
  CdkBootstrapKeyAlias:
    Condition: CreateKey
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/cdk-${Qualifier}-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CdkBootstrapKey
  AssetBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - CreateBucket
        - !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
        - !Ref CustomAssetBucketName
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If [UseExistingKey, !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId, !GetAtt CdkBootstrapKey.Arn]
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: "cdk-bootstrap:qualifier"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier
  AssetBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AssetBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyHTTP
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !Sub "${AssetBucket.Arn}/*"
              - !GetAtt AssetBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:SecureTransport": "false"
  ContainerRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-container-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      Tags:
        - Key: "cdk-bootstrap:qualifier"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier
  BootstrapVersionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version"
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion
      Description: "CDK bootstrap version"
Outputs:
  AssetBucketName:
    Description: "Name of the S3 bucket for file assets"
    Value: !Ref AssetBucket
  ContainerRepositoryUri:
    Description: "URI of the ECR repository for container assets"
    Value: !GetAtt ContainerRepository.RepositoryUri
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: "ARN of the KMS key used for bucket encryption"
    Value: !If [UseExistingKey, !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId, !GetAtt CdkBootstrapKey.Arn]
  FilePublishingRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the file publishing role"
    Value: !GetAtt FilePublishingRole.Arn
  ImagePublishingRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the image publishing role"
    Value: !GetAtt ImagePublishingRole.Arn
  LookupRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the lookup role"
    Value: !GetAtt LookupRole.Arn
  DeployRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the deploy role"
    Value: !GetAtt DeployRole.Arn
  CfnExecRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the CloudFormation execution role"
    Value: !GetAtt CfnExecRole.Arn
  BootstrapVersionParameterName:
    Description: "SSM parameter name storing the bootstrap version"
    Value: !Ref BootstrapVersionParameter

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: Elastic Beanstalk environment with Blue-Green deployment support. Creates or references an application and blue environment, with ability to create a temporary green environment for traffic routing during updates.
Parameters:
  CreateNewResources:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
    Default: true
    Description: Set to true to create a new application and blue environment. Set to false to reference existing ones.
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyApplication
    Description: Name of the Elastic Beanstalk application. Used as the application name when creating new resources, or must match the existing application name when referencing existing resources.
  BlueEnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyApp-blue
    Description: Name of the blue Elastic Beanstalk environment.
  GreenEnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyApp-green
    Description: Name of the green Elastic Beanstalk environment created temporarily during deployments.
  CustomSolutionStackName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional custom solution stack name. Leave empty to automatically use the latest Python 3.11 solution stack for the current region.
  DeployGreenEnv:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
    Default: false
    Description: Set to true to create the green environment. Set to false to delete the green environment after traffic has been routed back to blue.
  SwapEnvironments:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
    Default: false
    Description: Set to true to swap the CNAMEs (traffic) between the blue and green environments. Set back to false after the swap completes.
  S3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: S3 bucket containing the application source bundle. Leave empty to use the default Elastic Beanstalk sample application bucket (elasticbeanstalk-samples-<region>).
  S3Key:
    Type: String
    Default: python-sample.zip
    Description: S3 key (path) of the application source bundle within the S3 bucket.
Conditions:
  CreateNewApp: !Equals
    - !Ref CreateNewResources
    - "true"
  ShouldCreateGreen: !Equals
    - !Ref DeployGreenEnv
    - "true"
  ShouldSwap: !Equals
    - !Ref SwapEnvironments
    - "true"
  UseDefaultBucket: !Equals
    - !Ref S3Bucket
    - ""
  UseCustomSolutionStack: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref CustomSolutionStackName
      - ""
Resources:
  SolutionStackFetcherRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ElasticBeanstalkListStacksPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticbeanstalk:ListAvailableSolutionStacks
                Resource: "*"
  SolutionStackFetcherFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt SolutionStackFetcherRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.11
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import re

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  request_type = event.get('RequestType')
                  if request_type in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      eb = boto3.client('elasticbeanstalk')
                      response = eb.list_available_solution_stacks()
                      stacks = response.get('SolutionStacks', [])
                      # Filter for Python 3.11 on Amazon Linux 2, prefer the latest version
                      python311_stacks = [s for s in stacks if 'Python 3.11' in s and 'Amazon Linux 2' in s]
                      if not python311_stacks:
                          # Fallback: any Python 3.11 stack
                          python311_stacks = [s for s in stacks if 'Python 3.11' in s]
                      if not python311_stacks:
                          raise Exception("No Python 3.11 solution stack found")
                      # Sort by version to get the latest (assumes version numbers at end)
                      python311_stacks.sort(reverse=True)
                      latest_stack = python311_stacks[0]
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {
                          'SolutionStackName': latest_stack
                      })
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Message': str(e)})
      Description: Fetches the latest Python 3.11 Elastic Beanstalk solution stack
  LatestSolutionStack:
    Type: Custom::SolutionStackFetcher
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SolutionStackFetcherFunction.Arn
  EBApplication:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Application
    Condition: CreateNewApp
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Application supporting blue-green deployments
  SampleApplicationVersion:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion
    Condition: CreateNewApp
    DependsOn:
      - EBApplication
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Sample application version for initial deployment
      SourceBundle:
        S3Bucket: !If
          - UseDefaultBucket
          - !Sub elasticbeanstalk-samples-${AWS::Region}
          - !Ref S3Bucket
        S3Key: !Ref S3Key
  BlueEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Condition: CreateNewApp
    DependsOn:
      - SampleApplicationVersion
      - LatestSolutionStack
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      EnvironmentName: !Ref BlueEnvironmentName
      SolutionStackName: !If
        - UseCustomSolutionStack
        - !Ref CustomSolutionStackName
        - !GetAtt LatestSolutionStack.SolutionStackName
      VersionLabel: !Ref SampleApplicationVersion
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: EnvironmentType
          Value: LoadBalanced
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: aws-elasticbeanstalk-service-role
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Blue
  GreenEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Condition: ShouldCreateGreen
    DependsOn:
      - LatestSolutionStack
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      EnvironmentName: !Ref GreenEnvironmentName
      SolutionStackName: !If
        - UseCustomSolutionStack
        - !Ref CustomSolutionStackName
        - !GetAtt LatestSolutionStack.SolutionStackName
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: EnvironmentType
          Value: LoadBalanced
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: aws-elasticbeanstalk-service-role
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Green
  SwapEnvironmentLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: ShouldSwap
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ElasticBeanstalkSwapPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticbeanstalk:SwapEnvironmentCNAMEs
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticbeanstalk:DescribeEnvironments
                Resource: "*"
  SwapEnvironmentLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: ShouldSwap
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt SwapEnvironmentLambdaRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.11
      Timeout: 300
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import logging
          import time

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f"Received event: {event}")
              try:
                  request_type = event.get('RequestType', '')
                  if request_type in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      eb = boto3.client('elasticbeanstalk')
                      props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
                      blue_env_name = props.get('BlueEnvironmentName', '')
                      green_env_name = props.get('GreenEnvironmentName', '')
                      logger.info(f"Swapping CNAMEs between {blue_env_name} and {green_env_name}")
                      response = eb.swap_environment_cnam_es(
                          SourceEnvironmentName=blue_env_name,
                          DestinationEnvironmentName=green_env_name
                      )
                      logger.info(f"Swap initiated: {response}")
                      time.sleep(10)
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {
                          'Message': f'Successfully swapped CNAMEs between {blue_env_name} and {green_env_name}',
                          'SwapInitiated': 'true'
                      })
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      logger.info("Delete event - no action needed for swap")
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {
                          'Message': 'Delete completed successfully'
                      })
                  else:
                      logger.warning(f"Unknown request type: {request_type}")
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {
                          'Message': f'Unknown request type: {request_type}'
                      })
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Error processing event: {e}")
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {
                      'Message': str(e)
                  })
      Description: Lambda function to swap Elastic Beanstalk environment CNAMEs for blue-green deployment
  SwapCNAMEs:
    Type: Custom::SwapCNAMEs
    Condition: ShouldSwap
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SwapEnvironmentLambdaFunction.Arn
      BlueEnvironmentName: !Ref BlueEnvironmentName
      GreenEnvironmentName: !Ref GreenEnvironmentName
Outputs:
  ApplicationName:
    Description: Name of the Elastic Beanstalk application
    Value: !Ref ApplicationName
  BlueEnvironmentEndpoint:
    Description: URL endpoint of the blue Elastic Beanstalk environment
    Value: !If
      - CreateNewApp
      - !GetAtt BlueEnvironment.EndpointURL
      - !Sub "Referencing existing environment: ${BlueEnvironmentName}"
  GreenEnvironmentEndpoint:
    Description: URL endpoint of the green Elastic Beanstalk environment (if created)
    Value: !If
      - ShouldCreateGreen
      - !GetAtt GreenEnvironment.EndpointURL
      - "Green environment not created"
  SwapStatus:
    Description: Status of the last CNAME swap operation
    Value: !If
      - ShouldSwap
      - "Swap completed"
      - "No swap requested"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Dual-stack VPC with public and private subnets, NAT Gateway option, network ACLs, DHCP options, and placement group'
Parameters:
  EnvironmentType:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Default: staging
    Description: Environment type for which to provision the network
  DeployNATGateway:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - Yes
      - No
    Default: Yes
    Description: Whether to deploy a NAT Gateway for private subnet IPv4 outbound access
Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    staging:
      VpcCIDR: 10.0.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1CIDR: 10.0.1.0/24
      PublicSubnet2CIDR: 10.0.2.0/24
      PublicSubnet3CIDR: 10.0.3.0/24
      PrivateAppSubnetCIDR: 10.0.4.0/24
      PrivateDataSubnetCIDR: 10.0.5.0/24
      DomainName: staging.example.internal
    production:
      VpcCIDR: 10.1.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1CIDR: 10.1.1.0/24
      PublicSubnet2CIDR: 10.1.2.0/24
      PublicSubnet3CIDR: 10.1.3.0/24
      PrivateAppSubnetCIDR: 10.1.4.0/24
      PrivateDataSubnetCIDR: 10.1.5.0/24
      DomainName: production.example.internal
Conditions:
  CreateNATGateway: !Equals [!Ref DeployNATGateway, 'Yes']
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, VpcCIDR]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
  VPCIPv6Cidr:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true
  DHCPOptions:
    Type: AWS::EC2::DHCPOptions
    Properties:
      DomainName: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, DomainName]
      DomainNameServers:
        - AmazonProvidedDNS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-dhcp-options'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
  DHCPOptionsAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      DhcpOptionsId: !Ref DHCPOptions
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-eigw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PublicSubnet1CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PublicSubnet2CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public
  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PublicSubnet3CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-public-subnet-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public
  PrivateAppSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PrivateAppSubnetCIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-private-app-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private
  PrivateDataSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PrivateDataSubnetCIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-private-data-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-public-rtb'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public
  PublicRouteIPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicRouteIPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-private-rtb'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private
  PrivateRouteIPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      EgressOnlyInternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressOnlyInternetGateway
  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNATGateway
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNATGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-nat-gateway'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
  PrivateRouteIPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNATGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
  PrivateAppSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet
  PrivateDataSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDataSubnet
  PublicNetworkACL:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-public-nacl'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public
  PublicNACLInboundHTTPIPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:

        From: 80

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless Movies API with DynamoDB, Lambda, and API Gateway
Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment environment name
Resources:
  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub MoviesTable-${Environment}
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBCRUD
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn
  CreateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/CreateMovieFunction-${Environment}
      RetentionInDays: 1
  ReadMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/ReadMovieFunction-${Environment}
      RetentionInDays: 1
  UpdateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/UpdateMovieFunction-${Environment}
      RetentionInDays: 1
  DeleteMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/DeleteMovieFunction-${Environment}
      RetentionInDays: 1
  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - CreateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub CreateMovieFunction-${Environment}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              body = json.loads(event['body'])
              title = body.get('title')
              if not title:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 400,
                      'headers': {
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'OPTIONS,POST'
                      },
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': 'title is required'})
                  }
              item = {'title': title}
              for key, value in body.items():
                  if key != 'title':
                      item[key] = value
              table.put_item(Item=item)
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'headers': {
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'OPTIONS,POST'
                  },
                  'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie created successfully'})
              }
  ReadMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - ReadMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ReadMovieFunction-${Environment}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              title = event['pathParameters']['title']
              response = table.get_item(Key={'title': title})
              item = response.get('Item', {})
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'headers': {
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'OPTIONS,GET'
                  },
                  'body': json.dumps(item)
              }
  UpdateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - UpdateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub UpdateMovieFunction-${Environment}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              body = json.loads(event['body'])
              title = body.get('title')
              if not title:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 400,
                      'headers': {
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'OPTIONS,PUT'
                      },
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': 'title is required'})
                  }
              update_expression = 'SET '
              expression_attribute_values = {}
              for key, value in body.items():
                  if key != 'title':
                      update_expression += f'#{key} = :{key}, '
                      expression_attribute_values[f':{key}'] = value
              if not expression_attribute_values:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 400,
                      'headers': {
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'OPTIONS,PUT'
                      },
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': 'no fields to update'})
                  }
              update_expression = update_expression.rstrip(', ')
              table.update_item(
                  Key={'title': title},
                  UpdateExpression=update_expression,
                  ExpressionAttributeValues=expression_attribute_values
              )
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'headers': {
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'OPTIONS,PUT'
                  },
                  'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie updated successfully'})
              }
  DeleteMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - DeleteMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub DeleteMovieFunction-${Environment}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              body = json.loads(event['body'])
              title = body.get('title')
              if not title:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 400,
                      'headers': {
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'OPTIONS,DELETE'
                      },
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': 'title is required'})
                  }
              table.delete_item(Key={'title': title})
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'headers': {
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'OPTIONS,DELETE'
                  },
                  'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie deleted successfully'})
              }
  MoviesAPI:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub MoviesAPI-${Environment}
      Description: REST API for Movies CRUD operations
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
  MoviesResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesAPI
      ParentId: !GetAtt MoviesAPI.RootResourceId
      PathPart: Movies
  MoviesTitleResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesAPI
      ParentId: !Ref MoviesResource
      PathPart: '{title}'
  CreateMovieMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesAPI
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CreateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations
  UpdateMovieMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesAPI
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: PUT
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${UpdateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations
  DeleteMovieMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesAPI
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: DELETE
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DeleteMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations
  ReadMovieMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesAPI
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesTitleResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ReadMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations
  OptionsMoviesMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesAPI
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'OPTIONS,POST,PUT,DELETE'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: "'true'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
  OptionsMoviesTitleMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesAPI
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesTitleResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'OPTIONS,GET'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: "'true'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
  CreateMoviePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref CreateMovieFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MoviesAPI}/*/POST/Movies
  ReadMoviePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref ReadMovieFunction

      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MoviesAPI}/*/GET/Movies/*

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'AppSync GraphQL API with DynamoDB and JavaScript resolvers - TodoAPIwithJs'
Parameters:
  TodoApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: TodoAPIwithJs
    Description: Name of the GraphQL API
Resources:
  TodoDynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: owner
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: owner
          KeyType: RANGE
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: owner-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: owner
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      TableName: !Sub '${TodoApiName}-Table'

  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref TodoApiName
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId

  TodoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: TodoDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref TodoDynamoDBTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt DataSourceRole.Arn

  NoneDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: "NONE"
      Type: NONE

  DataSourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt TodoDynamoDBTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !Sub '${TodoDynamoDBTable.Arn}/index/*'

  CreateTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoDataSource.Name
      Name: CreateTodoFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { input } = ctx.arguments;
          const id = util.autoId();
          const now = util.time.nowISO8601();
          const item = {
            id,
            owner: input.owner,
            name: input.name,
            description: input.description,
            createdAt: now,
            updatedAt: now,
          };
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: { id: { S: id } },
            attributeValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues(item),
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return ctx.result;
        }

  UpdateTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoDataSource.Name
      Name: UpdateTodoFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { input } = ctx.arguments;
          const now = util.time.nowISO8601();
          let expression = 'SET ';
          const exprNames = {};
          const exprValues = {};
          let first = true;
          if (input.name !== undefined) {
            if (!first) expression += ', ';
            expression += '#name = :name';
            exprNames['#name'] = 'name';
            exprValues[':name'] = input.name;
            first = false;
          }
          if (input.description !== undefined) {
            if (!first) expression += ', ';
            expression += 'description = :description';
            exprValues[':description'] = input.description;
            first = false;
          }
          if (!first) expression += ', ';
          expression += 'updatedAt = :updatedAt';
          exprValues[':updatedAt'] = now;
          const condition = 'attribute_exists(id) AND attribute_exists(owner)';
          return {
            operation: 'UpdateItem',
            key: { id: { S: input.id }, owner: { S: input.owner } },
            update: {
              expression: expression,

            condition: { expression: condition },

          const { id, owner } = ctx.arguments;
          return {
            operation: 'DeleteItem',
            key: { id: { S: id }, owner: { S: owner } },
            condition: { expression: 'attribute_exists(id) AND attribute_exists(owner)' },

            index: 'owner-index',
            limit: limit || 20,

          name: String!
          description: String

        input CreateTodoInput {

        input UpdateTodoInput {
          id: ID!

          description: String

        type Mutation {
          createTodo(input: CreateTodoInput!): Todo

        type Query {

        type Subscription {
          onCreateTodo(owner: String): Todo
            @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["createTodo"])
          onUpdateTodo(owner: String): Todo
            @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["updateTodo"])
          onDeleteTodo(owner: String): Todo
            @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["deleteTodo"])
        }
        type TodoConnection {
          items: [Todo]
          nextToken: String
        }

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for composite CloudWatch alarms monitoring cross-region failover application health (API Gateway, Lambda, RDS)."
Parameters:
  RemittanceApiName:
    Type: String
    Description: "Name of the existing Remittance API Gateway API (e.g., remittance-api)."
    Default: "remittance-api"
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Description: "Stage name of the API (e.g., prod)."
    Default: "prod"
  GetRemittancesFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Description: "Name of the existing GetRemittances Lambda function."
    Default: "GetRemittances"
  CreateRemittanceFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Description: "Name of the existing CreateRemittance Lambda function."
    Default: "CreateRemittance"
  RDSInstanceIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Description: "Identifier of the existing RDS instance (e.g., dbcluster1-instance1)."
    Default: "dbcluster1-instance1"
Resources:
  # API Gateway metric alarms
  Api4XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-api-4xx-error"
      AlarmDescription: "API Gateway 4XX errors average > 0 over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApiName
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref StageName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
  Api5XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-api-5xx-error"
      AlarmDescription: "API Gateway 5XX errors average > 1 over 60 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApiName
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref StageName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
  ApiLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-api-latency"
      AlarmDescription: "API Gateway latency average >= 10000 ms over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: Latency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApiName
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref StageName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
  # Lambda metric alarms (errors and invocations are summed across both functions using metric math)
  LambdaErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-lambda-errors"
      AlarmDescription: "Summed errors for GetRemittances and CreateRemittance > 0 over 60 seconds"
      Metrics:
        - Id: e1
          Label: "GetRemittances Errors"
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/Lambda
              MetricName: Errors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: FunctionName
                  Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: e2
          Label: "CreateRemittance Errors"
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/Lambda
              MetricName: Errors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: FunctionName
                  Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: sumErrors
          Label: "Total Errors"
          Expression: "e1 + e2"
          ReturnData: true
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 0
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
  LambdaInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-lambda-invocations"
      AlarmDescription: "Summed invocations for GetRemittances and CreateRemittance > 2 over 60 seconds"
      Metrics:
        - Id: i1
          Label: "GetRemittances Invocations"
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/Lambda
              MetricName: Invocations
              Dimensions:
                - Name: FunctionName
                  Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: i2
          Label: "CreateRemittance Invocations"
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/Lambda
              MetricName: Invocations
              Dimensions:
                - Name: FunctionName
                  Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: sumInvocations
          Label: "Total Invocations"
          Expression: "i1 + i2"
          ReturnData: true
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 2
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
  LambdaDurationAlarm1:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-lambda-duration-getremittances"
      AlarmDescription: "Average duration for GetRemittances >= 10000 ms over 900 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
  LambdaDurationAlarm2:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-lambda-duration-createremittance"
      AlarmDescription: "Average duration for CreateRemittance >= 10000 ms over 900 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
  # RDS metric alarms (TreatMissingData left unset)
  RDSCPUAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-rds-cpu"
      AlarmDescription: "RDS CPU utilization average >= 70% over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
  RDSConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-rds-connections"
      AlarmDescription: "RDS database connections average >= 100 over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DatabaseConnections
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
  RDSDeadlocksAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-rds-deadlocks"
      AlarmDescription: "RDS deadlocks average >= 10 over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Deadlocks
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
  RDSNetworkTransmitAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-rds-network-transmit"
      AlarmDescription: "RDS network transmit throughput average >= 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkTransmitThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
  RDSNetworkReceiveAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-rds-network-receive"
      AlarmDescription: "RDS network receive throughput average >= 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkReceiveThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
  RDSQueriesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-rds-queries"
      AlarmDescription: "RDS queries average >= 100 over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Queries
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
  RDSDiskQueueDepthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-rds-disk-queue-depth"
      AlarmDescription: "RDS disk queue depth average >= 50 over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DiskQueueDepth
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
  RDSReadLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-rds-read-latency"
      AlarmDescription: "RDS read latency average >= 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: ReadLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
  RDSWriteLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-rds-write-latency"
      AlarmDescription: "RDS write latency average >= 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: WriteLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
  # Composite alarms
  CompositeApiGatewayHealth:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-api-gateway-health"
      AlarmDescription: "Composite alarm for API Gateway health (OR of 4XX, 5XX, latency)"
      AlarmRule: !Sub "ALARM(${Api4XXErrorAlarm}) OR ALARM(${Api5XXErrorAlarm}) OR ALARM(${ApiLatencyAlarm})"
  CompositeLambdaHealth:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-lambda-health"
      AlarmDescription: "Composite alarm for Lambda health (OR of errors and duration alarms)"
      AlarmRule: !Sub "ALARM(${LambdaErrorsAlarm}) OR ALARM(${LambdaDurationAlarm1}) OR ALARM(${LambdaDurationAlarm2})"
  CompositeRDSHealth:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-rds-health"
      AlarmDescription: "Composite alarm for RDS health (OR of all RDS metric alarms)"
      AlarmRule: !Sub "ALARM(${RDSCPUAlarm}) OR ALARM(${RDSConnectionsAlarm}) OR ALARM(${RDSDeadlocksAlarm}) OR ALARM(${RDSNetworkTransmitAlarm}) OR ALARM(${RDSNetworkReceiveAlarm}) OR ALARM(${RDSQueriesAlarm}) OR ALARM(${RDSDiskQueueDepthAlarm}) OR ALARM(${RDSReadLatencyAlarm}) OR ALARM(${RDSWriteLatencyAlarm})"
Outputs:
  ApiGatewayCompositeAlarmArn:
    Description: "ARN of the API Gateway Health composite alarm"
    Value: !Ref CompositeApiGatewayHealth
  LambdaCompositeAlarmArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Lambda Health composite alarm"
    Value: !Ref CompositeLambdaHealth
  RDSCompositeAlarmArn:
    Description: "ARN of the RDS Health composite alarm"
    Value: !Ref CompositeRDSHealth

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket containing Glue job scripts
    Default: "admin-suite-scripts"
  ScriptBucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix (folder path) for scripts in the bucket
    Default: "scripts"
Resources:
  AdminSuiteKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                Fn::Sub: arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: "*"
      Description: KMS key for admin suite S3 bucket encryption
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
  AdminSuiteKMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName:
        Fn::Sub: alias/admin-suite-key-${AWS::AccountId}
      TargetKeyId:
        Ref: AdminSuiteKMSKey
  AdminSuiteS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName:
        Fn::Sub: admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID:
                Ref: AdminSuiteKMSKey
  AdminSuiteIAMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName:
        Fn::Sub: admin-suite-role-${AWS::AccountId}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: admin-suite-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:Describe*
                  - quicksight:List*
                  - quicksight:Get*
                  - quicksight:Search*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:CreateJob
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetJob
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:UpdateJob
                  - glue:BatchStopJobRun
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - Fn::Sub: arn:aws:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}
                  - Fn::Sub: arn:aws:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptBucketPrefix}/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - Fn::Sub: arn:aws:s3:::admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}
                  - Fn::Sub: arn:aws:s3:::admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  Fn::Sub: arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/admin-suite-role-${AWS::AccountId}
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  Fn::GetAtt:
                    - AdminSuiteKMSKey
                    - Arn
  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Role:
        Fn::Sub: arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/admin-suite-role-${AWS::AccountId}
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation:
          Fn::Sub: s3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptBucketPrefix}/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      MaxRetries: 0
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region":
          Ref: AWS::Region
        "--account-id":
          Ref: AWS::AccountId
        "--output-bucket":
          Fn::Sub: admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}
  GlueJobAssetsMetadata:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Serverless CRUD API for Kitten Service with API Gateway and DynamoDB'
Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: API Gateway stage name
Resources:
  KittenTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: Kitten
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaDynamoDBAndLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: !GetAtt KittenTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*
  KittenFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: KittenCrudFunction
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref KittenTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import uuid
          import boto3
          import os
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              http_method = event['httpMethod']
              path = event['path']
              path_params = event.get('pathParameters') or {}
              try:
                  if http_method == 'POST' and path == '/kitten':
                      return create_kitten(event)
                  elif http_method == 'GET' and path == '/kitten':
                      return list_kittens()
                  elif http_method == 'GET' and path.startswith('/kitten/'):
                      return get_kitten(path_params.get('id'))
                  elif http_method == 'PUT' and path.startswith('/kitten/'):
                      return update_kitten(path_params.get('id'), event)
                  elif http_method == 'DELETE' and path.startswith('/kitten/'):
                      return delete_kitten(path_params.get('id'))
                  else:
                      return response(400, {'error': 'Unsupported route'})
              except ClientError as e:
                  return response(500, {'error': str(e)})
              except Exception as e:
                  return response(500, {'error': 'Internal server error'})
          def response(status_code, body):
              return {
                  'statusCode': status_code,
                  'headers': {
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'
                  },
                  'body': json.dumps(body) if isinstance(body, dict) else body
              }
          def parse_body(event):
              try:
                  return json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
              except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
                  return None
          def create_kitten(event):
              body = parse_body(event)
              if body is None:
                  return response(400, {'error': 'Invalid JSON in request body'})
              name = body.get('name')
              color = body.get('color')
              if not name or not color:
                  return response(400, {'error': 'name and color are required'})
              kitten_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
              item = {'KittenId': kitten_id, 'name': name, 'color': color}
              table.put_item(Item=item)
              return response(201, item)
          def list_kittens():
              resp = table.scan()
              items = resp.get('Items', [])
              return response(200, items)
          def get_kitten(kitten_id):
              if not kitten_id:
                  return response(400, {'error': 'KittenId is required'})
              resp = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
              item = resp.get('Item')
              if not item:
                  return response(404, {'error': 'Kitten not found'})
              return response(200, item)
          def update_kitten(kitten_id, event):
              if not kitten_id:
                  return response(400, {'error': 'KittenId is required'})
              body = parse_body(event)
              if body is None:
                  return response(400, {'error': 'Invalid JSON in request body'})
              name = body.get('name')
              color = body.get('color')
              if not name or not color:
                  return response(400, {'error': 'name and color are required'})
              resp = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
              if 'Item' not in resp:
                  return response(404, {'error': 'Kitten not found'})
              item = {'KittenId': kitten_id, 'name': name, 'color': color}
              table.put_item(Item=item)
              return response(200, item)
          def delete_kitten(kitten_id):
              if not kitten_id:
                  return response(400, {'error': 'KittenId is required'})
              resp = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
              if 'Item' not in resp:
                  return response(404, {'error': 'Kitten not found'})
              table.delete_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
              return response(204, '')

    Properties:

      Description: Serverless CRUD API for Kitten Service
  KittenResource:

        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${KittenFunction.Arn}/invocations

          - StatusCode: 200

              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
        RequestTemplates:
