  HasOIDCProvider: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OIDCProviderArn, ""]]
Resources:
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${RoleNamePrefix}ControlPlane"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${RoleNamePrefix}Nodes"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${RoleNamePrefix}Controllers"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Fn::If:
              - HasOIDCProvider
              - Effect: Allow
                Principal:
                  Federated: !Ref OIDCProviderArn
                Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
              - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Path: /
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${RoleNamePrefix}EKSControlPlane"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy"
  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${RoleNamePrefix}ControlPlane"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${RoleNamePrefix}Nodes"
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole
  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${RoleNamePrefix}Controllers"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole
  ControlPlaneLegacyCloudProviderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${RoleNamePrefix}ControlPlane-LegacyCloudProvider"
      Description: "Permissions for legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider (EC2, ASG, ELB, KMS)"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - autoscaling:Describe*
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: "*"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
  NodePermissionsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${RoleNamePrefix}NodePermissions"
      Description: "Permissions for cluster nodes to register and pull images (EC2, ECR, SSM, Secrets Manager)"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:DescribeRepositories
              - ecr:ListImages
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource: "*"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
        - !Ref NodesRole
  ControllersInfrastructurePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${RoleNamePrefix}Controllers-Infrastructure"
      Description: "Broad EC2, ASG, ELB, launch template, and service-linked-role permissions for CAPA controllers"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
              - autoscaling:*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
              - ec2:ModifyLaunchTemplate
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:DeleteServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:GetServiceLinkedRoleDeletionStatus
            Resource: "*"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
  ControllersEKSPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${RoleNamePrefix}Controllers-EKS"
      Description: "EKS-specific permissions for CAPA controllers to manage clusters, node groups, add-ons, Fargate, and related IAM/KMS"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:*
              - iam:PassRole
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:CreateRole
              - iam:DeleteRole
              - iam:AttachRolePolicy
              - iam:DetachRolePolicy
              - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
              - iam:PutRolePolicy
              - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
              - iam:ListRolePolicies
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: "*"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
  ReadOnlyEKSPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${RoleNamePrefix}ReadOnly-EKS"
      Description: "Read-only permissions for EKS clusters, node groups, and workloads (console access)"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:DescribeAddon
              - eks:ListAddons
              - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
              - eks:ListFargateProfiles
              - eks:DescribeIdentityProviderConfig
              - eks:ListIdentityProviderConfigs
              - eks:AccessKubernetesApi
              - eks:DescribeUpdate
              - eks:ListUpdates
            Resource: "*"
Outputs:
  ControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the control plane IAM role"
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneRole.Arn
  NodesRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the nodes IAM role"
    Value: !GetAtt NodesRole.Arn
  ControllersRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the controllers IAM role"
    Value: !GetAtt ControllersRole.Arn
  EKSControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the EKS control plane IAM role"
    Value: !GetAtt EKSControlPlaneRole.Arn
  ControlPlaneInstanceProfileName:
    Description: "Name of the control plane instance profile"
    Value: !Ref ControlPlaneInstanceProfile
  NodesInstanceProfileName:
    Description: "Name of the nodes instance profile"
    Value: !Ref NodesInstanceProfile
  ControllersInstanceProfileName:
    Description: "Name of the controllers instance profile"
    Value: !Ref ControllersInstanceProfile
  ControlPlaneLegacyCloudProviderPolicyArn:
    Description: "ARN of the legacy cloud provider policy"
    Value: !Ref ControlPlaneLegacyCloudProviderPolicy
  NodePermissionsPolicyArn:
    Description: "ARN of the node permissions policy"
    Value: !Ref NodePermissionsPolicy
  ControllersInfrastructurePolicyArn:
    Description: "ARN of the controllers infrastructure policy"
    Value: !Ref ControllersInfrastructurePolicy
  ControllersEKSPolicyArn:
    Description: "ARN of the controllers EKS policy"
    Value: !Ref ControllersEKSPolicy
  ReadOnlyEKSPolicyArn:
    Description: "ARN of the read-only EKS policy (standalone, not attached)"
    Value: !Ref ReadOnlyEKSPolicy

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'VPC with managed NAT gateways, endpoints, and flow logs'

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/16'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for the first public subnet (AZ1)
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for the second public subnet (AZ2)
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.2.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet (AZ1)
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.3.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet (AZ2)
  FlowLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    Description: Retention period for VPC flow logs (in days)
  FlowLogTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL
    AllowedValues:
      - ACCEPT
      - REJECT
      - ALL
    Description: Traffic type to capture for flow logs

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flow-log-role'

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionInDays
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: !Ref FlowLogTrafficType
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-endpoint-sg'

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  VpcCidr:
    Description: VPC CIDR
    Value: !Ref VpcCIDR
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'

  AvailabilityZone1:
    Description: First availability zone
    Value: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AvailabilityZone1'

  AvailabilityZone2:
    Description: Second availability zone
    Value: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AvailabilityZone2'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'

  EndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID for VPC endpoints
    Value: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EndpointSecurityGroupId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC with public/private subnets, NAT Gateways, Flow Logs, VPC Endpoints for KerberosEMRonEKS"
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: KerberosEMRonEKS
    Description: Prefix for resource names
Resources:

    Properties:
      Tags:

    Properties:

  PublicSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PrivateSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.0.128/26"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnetA"
  PrivateSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.0.0.192/26"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnetB"
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

  PublicSubnetARouteTableAssociation:

    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:

  EIPA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP

    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

    Properties:

        Statement:

            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"

              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:

              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"

      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
  KMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${EnvironmentName}-flowlog-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template to create CloudWatch Logs Insights queries for Claude Code application metrics.

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/claude-code/metrics
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group containing Claude Code metrics.

Resources:
  # Real-time Monitoring Queries
  QueryTokenRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: RealTimeMonitoring-TokenRatePerUser
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp, user, tokens_in, tokens_out
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
          | stats sum(tokens_in) as total_tokens_in, sum(tokens_out) as total_tokens_out, count() as request_count by user
          | sort @timestamp desc
          | limit 20
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  QueryCurrentTpmRpmAverages:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: RealTimeMonitoring-CurrentTPMRPMAverages
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp, tokens_per_minute, requests_per_minute
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
          | stats avg(tokens_per_minute) as avg_tpm, avg(requests_per_minute) as avg_rpm
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  QueryRateLimitRisk:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: RealTimeMonitoring-RateLimitRisk
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp, user, tokens_per_minute, max_tpm
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}" and tokens_per_minute > (0.8 * max_tpm)
          | sort @timestamp desc
          | limit 50
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  # User and Session Analytics Queries
  QuerySessionLevelUsage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: UserSessionAnalytics-SessionLevelUsage
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp, session_id, user, tokens_in, tokens_out, duration_ms
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
          | stats sum(tokens_in) as total_tokens_in, sum(tokens_out) as total_tokens_out, max(duration_ms) as max_duration by session_id, user
          | sort @timestamp desc
          | limit 50
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  QueryHourlyActivityTimelines:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: UserSessionAnalytics-HourlyActivityTimelines
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp, user
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
          | stats count() as requests by bin(1h) as hour, user
          | sort hour desc
          | limit 100
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  QueryErrorThrottlingDetection:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: UserSessionAnalytics-ErrorThrottlingDetection
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp, user, error_code, error_message
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}" and (ispresent(error_code) or ispresent(error_message))
          | stats count() as error_count by error_code, user
          | sort error_count desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  # Cost and Attribution Queries
  QueryCostByUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CostAttribution-CostByUser
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp, user, cost
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}" and ispresent(cost)
          | stats sum(cost) as total_cost by user
          | sort total_cost desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  QueryCostByModel:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CostAttribution-CostByModel
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp, model, cost
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}" and ispresent(cost)
          | stats sum(cost) as total_cost by model
          | sort total_cost desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  QueryCostByOrganization:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CostAttribution-CostByOrganization
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp, organization, cost
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}" and ispresent(cost)
          | stats sum(cost) as total_cost by organization
          | sort total_cost desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  # Additional Debugging and Analysis Queries
  QueryModelEfficiency:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Debugging-ModelEfficiency
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, duration_ms
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
          | stats avg(tokens_out / (tokens_in + 1)) as avg_efficiency, avg(duration_ms) as avg_duration by model
          | sort avg_efficiency desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  QueryCacheHitMissOverall:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Debugging-CacheHitMissOverall
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp, cache_hit
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}" and ispresent(cache_hit)
          | stats count() as total, sum(cache_hit) as hits, count() - sum(cache_hit) as misses
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  QueryCacheHitMissOverTime:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Debugging-CacheHitMissOverTime
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp, cache_hit
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}" and ispresent(cache_hit)
          | stats sum(cache_hit) as hits, count() - sum(cache_hit) as misses by bin(1h) as hour
          | sort hour desc
          | limit 100
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  QueryCacheHitMissBySession:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Debugging-CacheHitMissBySession
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp, session_id, cache_hit
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}" and ispresent(cache_hit)
          | stats sum(cache_hit) as hits, count() - sum(cache_hit) as misses by session_id
          | sort hits desc
          | limit 50
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  QueryPeakUsageWindows:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Debugging-PeakUsageWindows
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
          | stats count() as request_count by bin(1h) as hour
          | sort request_count desc
          | limit 10
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  QueryDeepDiveSession:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Debugging-DeepDiveSession
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp, user, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, duration_ms, cost, cache_hit, error_code, error_message
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}" and session_id = "SESSION_ID_PLACEHOLDER"
          | sort @timestamp asc
          | limit 200
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  QueryFieldExplorer:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Debugging-FieldExplorer
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp, @message
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
          | limit 5
          | display @message
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  QueryDailyUsageSummary:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Debugging-DailyUsageSummary
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp, user, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
          | stats sum(tokens_in) as total_tokens_in, sum(tokens_out) as total_tokens_out, sum(cost) as total_cost, count() as request_count by bin(1d) as day
          | sort day desc
          | limit 30
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  # Additional queries to reach around 20 total
  QueryRequestRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: RealTimeMonitoring-RequestRatePerUser
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp, user
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
          | stats count() as request_rate by bin(1m) as minute, user
          | sort minute desc
          | limit 50
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  QueryUserActivityHeatmap:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: UserSessionAnalytics-UserActivityHeatmap
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp, user
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}"
          | stats count() as requests by bin(1h) as hour, user
          | sort hour desc, requests desc
          | limit 200
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  QueryCostTrend:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CostAttribution-CostTrend
      QueryString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          fields @timestamp, cost
          | filter @logGroup = "${LogGroupName}" and ispresent(cost)
          | stats sum(cost) as total_cost by bin(1d) as day
          | sort day desc
          | limit 30
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

Outputs:
  QueryDefinitionIds:
    Description: List of CloudWatch Logs Insights QueryDefinition IDs created by this stack.
    Value:
      Fn::Join:
        - ","
        - - !Ref QueryTokenRatePerUser
          - !Ref QueryCurrentTpmRpmAverages
          - !Ref QueryRateLimitRisk
          - !Ref QuerySessionLevelUsage
          - !Ref QueryHourlyActivityTimelines
          - !Ref QueryErrorThrottlingDetection
          - !Ref QueryCostByUser
          - !Ref QueryCostByModel
          - !Ref QueryCostByOrganization
          - !Ref QueryModelEfficiency
          - !Ref QueryCacheHitMissOverall
          - !Ref QueryCacheHitMissOverTime
          - !Ref QueryCacheHitMissBySession
          - !Ref QueryPeakUsageWindows
          - !Ref QueryDeepDiveSession
          - !Ref QueryFieldExplorer
          - !Ref QueryDailyUsageSummary
          - !Ref QueryRequestRatePerUser
          - !Ref QueryUserActivityHeatmap
          - !Ref QueryCostTrend

  QueryNames:
    Description: List of query names created by this stack.
    Value:
      Fn::Join:
        - ","
        - - RealTimeMonitoring-TokenRatePerUser
          - RealTimeMonitoring-CurrentTPMRPMAverages
          - RealTimeMonitoring-RateLimitRisk
          - RealTimeMonitoring-RequestRatePerUser
          - UserSessionAnalytics-SessionLevelUsage
          - UserSessionAnalytics-HourlyActivityTimelines
          - UserSessionAnalytics-ErrorThrottlingDetection
          - UserSessionAnalytics-UserActivityHeatmap
          - CostAttribution-CostByUser
          - CostAttribution-CostByModel
          - CostAttribution-CostByOrganization
          - CostAttribution-CostTrend
          - Debugging-ModelEfficiency
          - Debugging-CacheHitMissOverall
          - Debugging-CacheHitMissOverTime
          - Debugging-CacheHitMissBySession
          - Debugging-PeakUsageWindows
          - Debugging-DeepDiveSession
          - Debugging-FieldExplorer
          - Debugging-DailyUsageSummary

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'VPC with public/private subnets, NAT Gateways, VPC Endpoints, and Flow Logs for EMR on EKS and Celeborn shuffle service'
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 1
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 2
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    Default: 10.0.4.0/24
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SharedVPC
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SharedVPC-IGW
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet1
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet2
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet1
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet2
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NatGateway-AZ1
  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NatGateway-AZ2
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicRouteTable
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTable-AZ1
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTable-AZ2
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
  VPCEndpointsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: VPCEndpoints-SG
  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  EC2Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  CloudWatchLogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  CloudWatchMonitoringEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  STSEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  EMREndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.elasticmapreduce
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  KMSEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  FlowLogsKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
  FlowLogsKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/VpcFlowLogsKey
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKMSKey
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: VpcFlowLogs
      RetentionInDays: 30
  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKMSKey.Arn
  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogFormat: '${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status}'
      MaxAggregationInterval: 600
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: VPCFlowLogs
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-VpcId
  VpcCidr:
    Description: VPC CIDR block
