      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableSingle
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewaySingle
  PrivateSubnet1RouteAssociationSingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableSingle
  PrivateSubnet2RouteAssociationSingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableSingle
  PrivateSubnet3RouteAssociationSingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableSingle
  # Per-AZ NAT Gateway setup
  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatEIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-1"
  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-2"
  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-3"
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rtb-1"
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rtb-2"
  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rtb-3"
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2
  PrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3
  PrivateSubnet1RouteAssociationPerAz:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
  PrivateSubnet2RouteAssociationPerAz:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
  PrivateSubnet3RouteAssociationPerAz:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
  # VPC Flow Logs
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: flow-logs-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"
  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}"
      RetentionInDays: 7
  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPCId"
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: "List of public subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetIds"
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: "List of private subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetIds"
  NatGatewayIds:
    Description: "NAT Gateway IDs"
    Value: !If
      - IsSingleNat
      - !Ref NatGatewaySingle
      - !Join [",", [!Ref NatGateway1, !Ref NatGateway2, !Ref NatGateway3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NatGatewayIds"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  CloudFormation template for an isolated private VPC hosting an AI-powered customer support application.
  Creates a VPC spanning multiple AZs with three private subnets, VPC endpoints for required AWS services,
  VPC Flow Logs encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key with automatic rotation, and dedicated security
  groups for Agent Runtime, MCP Runtime, and Lambda functions.
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: ai-customer-support
    Description: Environment name used for resource tagging.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  SubnetCidr1:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1.
  SubnetCidr2:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2.
  SubnetCidr3:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 3.
  AvailabilityZone1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Default: us-east-1a
    Description: Availability zone for subnet 1.
  AvailabilityZone2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Default: us-east-1b
    Description: Availability zone for subnet 2.
  AvailabilityZone3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Default: us-east-1c
    Description: Availability zone for subnet 3.
  KmsKeyAdminArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: >
      Comma-separated list of IAM ARNs (users/roles) that can administer the
      customer-managed KMS key for Flow Logs encryption.
  DynamoDbPrefixListId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >
      The prefix list ID for DynamoDB in the target region (e.g., pl-xxxxx).
      Required to allow egress to DynamoDB gateway endpoint.
  S3PrefixListId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >
      The prefix list ID for S3 in the target region (e.g., pl-xxxxx).
      Required to allow egress to S3 gateway endpoint.
Conditions:
  HasKmsAdminArns: !Not [!Equals [!Join ["", !Ref KmsKeyAdminArns], ""]]
  HasDynamoDbPrefix: !Not [!Equals [!Ref DynamoDbPrefixListId, ""]]
  HasS3Prefix: !Not [!Equals [!Ref S3PrefixListId, ""]]
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr1
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr2
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone2
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr3
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone3
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting VPC Flow Logs
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If [HasKmsAdminArns, !Ref KmsKeyAdminArns, !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"]
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to encrypt/decrypt
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt*"
              - "kms:Decrypt*"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow VPC Flow Logs service
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt*"
              - "kms:Decrypt*"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-flowlogs-kms-key"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${EnvironmentName}-flowlogs-kms-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}"
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-flowlogs-log-group"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: flow-logs-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "logs:CreateLogStream"
                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogGroups"
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "kms:Encrypt"
                  - "kms:Decrypt"
                  - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-flowlogs-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCFlowLogs:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-flowlogs"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS from VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow outbound HTTPS to VPC CIDR (return traffic)
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc-endpoint-sg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  BedrockRuntimeVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.bedrock-runtime"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-bedrock-runtime-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  EcrApiVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-ecr-api-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  EcrDkrVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-ecr-dkr-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  CloudWatchLogsVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-logs-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  CloudWatchMonitoringVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-monitoring-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  RdsDataVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.rds-data"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-rds-data-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SecretsManagerVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-secrets-manager-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SSMVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-ssm-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  KMSVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-kms-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  XRayVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.xray"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-xray-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DynamoDBVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  S3VpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-s3-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Agent Runtime component
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTPS egress to VPC endpoints
        - !If
          - HasDynamoDbPrefix
          - IpProtocol: tcp
            FromPort: 443
            ToPort: 443
            DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref DynamoDbPrefixListId
            Description: HTTPS egress to DynamoDB gateway endpoint
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasS3Prefix
          - IpProtocol: tcp
            FromPort: 443
            ToPort: 443
            DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref S3PrefixListId
            Description: HTTPS egress to S3 gateway endpoint
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-agent-runtime-sg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  MCPRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for MCP Runtime component
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTPS egress to VPC endpoints
        - !If
          - HasDynamoDbPrefix
          - IpProtocol: tcp
            FromPort: 443
            ToPort: 443
            DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref DynamoDbPrefixListId
            Description: HTTPS egress to DynamoDB gateway endpoint
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasS3Prefix
          - IpProtocol: tcp
            FromPort: 443
            ToPort: 443
            DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref S3PrefixListId
            Description: HTTPS egress to S3 gateway endpoint
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-mcp-runtime-sg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  LambdaSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Lambda functions
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTPS egress to VPC endpoints
        - !If
          - HasDynamoDbPrefix
          - IpProtocol: tcp
            FromPort: 443
            ToPort: 443
            DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref DynamoDbPrefixListId
            Description: HTTPS egress to DynamoDB gateway endpoint
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasS3Prefix
          - IpProtocol: tcp
            FromPort: 443
            ToPort: 443
            DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref S3PrefixListId
            Description: HTTPS egress to S3 gateway endpoint
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-lambda-sg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the created VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VpcId"

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: List of private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetIds"

  AgentRuntimeSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID for Agent Runtime
    Value: !Ref AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AgentRuntimeSecurityGroupId"

  MCPRuntimeSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID for MCP Runtime
    Value: !Ref MCPRuntimeSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-MCPRuntimeSecurityGroupId"

  LambdaSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID for Lambda functions
    Value: !Ref LambdaSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-LambdaSecurityGroupId"

  VPCEndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID for VPC endpoints
    Value: !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPCEndpointSecurityGroupId"

  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs group name for VPC Flow Logs
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsLogGroupName"

  FlowLogsKmsKeyId:
    Description: KMS Key ID used for Flow Logs encryption
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsKmsKeyId"

  FlowLogsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS Key ARN used for Flow Logs encryption
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsKmsKeyArn"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC with public and private subnets across three AZs for EKS cluster, including NAT gateways, routing, security groups, and tags for internal load balancer discovery."
Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR notation
  VpcName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name tag for the VPC and associated resources
    Default: "EKS-VPC"
  Az1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Description: First Availability Zone
    Default: "us-east-1a"
  Az2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Description: Second Availability Zone
    Default: "us-east-1b"
  Az3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Description: Third Availability Zone
    Default: "us-east-1c"
  PublicSubnetCidr1:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR for public subnet in AZ1
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
  PublicSubnetCidr2:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR for public subnet in AZ2
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
  PublicSubnetCidr3:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR for public subnet in AZ3
    Default: "10.0.3.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
  PrivateSubnetCidr1:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR for private subnet in AZ1
    Default: "10.0.4.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
  PrivateSubnetCidr2:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR for private subnet in AZ2
    Default: "10.0.5.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
  PrivateSubnetCidr3:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR for private subnet in AZ3
    Default: "10.0.6.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$
  ControlPlaneSecurityGroupDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: "Security group for EKS control plane to worker nodes communication"
  ApplicationSecurityGroupDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: "Security group exposing application ports to internet"
  HttpPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
  HttpsPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 443
  CustomTcpPort1:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8080
  CustomTcpPort2:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8443
  CustomTcpPort3:
    Type: Number
    Default: 15021
  CustomTcpPort4:
    Type: Number
    Default: 15017
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref VpcName
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-igw"
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-public-rt"
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr1
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref Az1
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-public-subnet-1"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr2
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref Az2
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-public-subnet-2"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"
  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr3
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref Az3
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-public-subnet-3"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  NatEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatEip3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-nat-gw-1"
  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-nat-gw-2"
  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-nat-gw-3"
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr1
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref Az1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-private-subnet-1"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr2
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref Az2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-private-subnet-2"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"
  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr3
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref Az3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-private-subnet-3"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-private-rt-1"
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-private-rt-2"
  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-private-rt-3"
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2
  PrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
  EksControlPlaneSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Ref ControlPlaneSecurityGroupDescription
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-eks-control-plane-sg"
  ApplicationSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Ref ApplicationSecurityGroupDescription
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref HttpPort
          ToPort: !Ref HttpPort
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref HttpsPort
          ToPort: !Ref HttpsPort
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref CustomTcpPort1
          ToPort: !Ref CustomTcpPort1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref CustomTcpPort2
          ToPort: !Ref CustomTcpPort2
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref CustomTcpPort3
          ToPort: !Ref CustomTcpPort3
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref CustomTcpPort4
          ToPort: !Ref CustomTcpPort4
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-application-sg"
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  EksControlPlaneSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID for EKS control plane
    Value: !GetAtt EksControlPlaneSecurityGroup.GroupId
  ApplicationSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID for application ingress/gateway
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationSecurityGroup.GroupId
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: List of public subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: List of private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]
  AllSubnetIds:
    Description: List of all subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3, !Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'IAM Execution Role for SageMaker HyperPod with EKS integration'

Parameters:
  ResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: MyStack
    Description: Prefix for resource names
  EKSClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-eks-cluster
    Description: Name of the EKS cluster
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: vpc-12345678
    Description: VPC ID
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: List<String>
    Default: sg-12345678
    Description: List of security group IDs
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: List<String>
    Default: subnet-12345678
    Description: List of private subnet IDs
  LifecycleS3BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-lifecycle-bucket
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket for lifecycle scripts
  RigInputS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional RIG input S3 bucket name
  RigOutputS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional RIG output S3 bucket name
  CreateRigResources:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Flag to create RIG resources
  EnableGatedAccess:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Flag to enable gated access

Conditions:
  CreateRigResourcesTrue: !Equals [!Ref CreateRigResources, 'true']
  HasRigInputBucket: !And
    - Condition: CreateRigResourcesTrue
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigInputS3Bucket, '']]
  HasRigOutputBucket: !And
    - Condition: CreateRigResourcesTrue
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigOutputS3Bucket, '']]
  IsGatedAccess: !Equals [!Ref EnableGatedAccess, 'true']

Resources:
  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerClusterInstanceRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSCNIPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: ENIManagementPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                Resource:
                  - 'arn:aws:ec2:*:*:instance/*'
                  - 'arn:aws:ec2:*:*:network-interface/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ec2:*:*:vpc/${VpcId}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:eks:*:*:cluster/${EKSClusterName}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${LifecycleS3BucketName}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${LifecycleS3BucketName}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  SubnetENIPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: SubnetENIPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref ExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ForAllValues:StringEquals:
                ec2:Subnet: !Ref PrivateSubnetIds

  SecurityGroupENIPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: SecurityGroupENIPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref ExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ForAllValues:StringEquals:
                ec2:SecurityGroup: !Ref SecurityGroupIds

  RIGInputPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: HasRigInputBucket
    Properties:
      PolicyName: RIGInputPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref ExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${RigInputS3Bucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${RigInputS3Bucket}/*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
            Resource:
              - 'arn:aws:lambda:*:*:function:*SageMaker*'
              - 'arn:aws:lambda:*:*:function:*sagemaker*'

  RIGOutputPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: HasRigOutputBucket
    Properties:
      PolicyName: RIGOutputPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref ExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${RigOutputS3Bucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${RigOutputS3Bucket}/*'

  GatedAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: IsGatedAccess
    Properties:
      PolicyName: GatedAccessPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref ExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource:
              - 'arn:aws:s3:*:*:accesspoint/*'
              - 'arn:aws:s3:::*/'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:SendMessage
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
              - sqs:GetQueueUrl
            Resource:
              - 'arn:aws:sqs:*:*:*SageMaker*'
              - 'arn:aws:sqs:*:*:*sagemaker*'

Outputs:
  RoleName:
    Description: Name of the IAM execution role
    Value: !Ref ExecutionRole
  RoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM execution role
    Value: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template to create three private subnets with route tables, NAT routes, network ACL associations, and an S3 VPC endpoint
Parameters:
  TargetVPC:
    Type: String
    Description: ID of the VPC in which to create resources (must be provided to create resources)
    Default: ""
  NATGateway1:
    Type: String
    Description: NAT Gateway ID for the first Availability Zone (must be provided to create resources)
    Default: ""
  NATGateway2:
    Type: String
    Description: NAT Gateway ID for the second Availability Zone (must be provided to create resources)
    Default: ""
  NATGateway3:
    Type: String
    Description: NAT Gateway ID for the third Availability Zone (must be provided to create resources)
    Default: ""
  NetworkACL:
    Type: String
    Description: Network ACL ID to associate with each private subnet (must be provided to create resources)
    Default: ""
  AvailabilityZone1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Description: First Availability Zone
    Default: us-east-1a
  AvailabilityZone2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Description: Second Availability Zone
    Default: us-east-1b
  AvailabilityZone3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Description: Third Availability Zone
    Default: us-east-1c
Conditions:
  CreateAllSubnets: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetVPC, ""]]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref NATGateway1, ""]]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref NATGateway2, ""]]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref NATGateway3, ""]]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref NetworkACL, ""]]
Resources:
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateAllSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TargetVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.24.24.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateAllSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TargetVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.24.25.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateAllSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TargetVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.24.26.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-3
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateAllSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TargetVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateAllSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TargetVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateAllSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TargetVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-3
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateAllSubnets
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway1
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateAllSubnets
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway2
  PrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateAllSubnets
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway3
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateAllSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateAllSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateAllSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
  SubnetNetworkAclAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Condition: CreateAllSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkACL
  SubnetNetworkAclAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Condition: CreateAllSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkACL
  SubnetNetworkAclAssociation3:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC with three-tier architecture across three Availability Zones: web, application, and database tiers."

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC"
  WebSubnetCIDR1:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for web subnet in first AZ"
  WebSubnetCIDR2:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for web subnet in second AZ"
  WebSubnetCIDR3:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.3.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for web subnet in third AZ"
  AppSubnetCIDR1:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.11.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for application subnet in first AZ"
  AppSubnetCIDR2:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.12.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for application subnet in second AZ"
  AppSubnetCIDR3:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.13.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for application subnet in third AZ"
  DbSubnetCIDR1:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.21.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for database subnet in first AZ"
  DbSubnetCIDR2:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.22.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for database subnet in second AZ"
  DbSubnetCIDR3:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.23.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for database subnet in third AZ"

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPC"
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ThreeTierVPC"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::InternetGateway"
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ThreeTierIGW"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Web subnets (public) in three AZs
  WebSubnet1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnetCIDR1
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "WebSubnet-AZ1"

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnetCIDR2
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "WebSubnet-AZ2"

  WebSubnet3:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnetCIDR3
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "WebSubnet-AZ3"

  # Web route table (shared)
  WebRouteTable:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "WebRouteTable"

  WebRoute:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Route"
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Associations for web subnets to the web route table
  WebSubnet1Association:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet2Association:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet3Association:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  # Application subnets (private)
  AppSubnet1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnetCIDR1
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "AppSubnet-AZ1"

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnetCIDR2
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "AppSubnet-AZ2"

  AppSubnet3:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnetCIDR3
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "AppSubnet-AZ3"

  # Database subnets (private)
  DbSubnet1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref DbSubnetCIDR1
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "DbSubnet-AZ1"

  DbSubnet2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref DbSubnetCIDR2
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "DbSubnet-AZ2"

  DbSubnet3:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref DbSubnetCIDR3
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "DbSubnet-AZ3"

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  NatEIP1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::EIP"
    Properties:
      Domain: "vpc"

  NatEIP2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::EIP"
    Properties:
      Domain: "vpc"

  NatEIP3:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::EIP"
    Properties:
      Domain: "vpc"

  # NAT Gateways in each web subnet (one per AZ)
  NatGateway1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::NatGateway"
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "NatGateway-AZ1"

  NatGateway2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::NatGateway"
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "NatGateway-AZ2"

  NatGateway3:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::NatGateway"
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "NatGateway-AZ3"

  # Route tables for application subnets (one per subnet)
  AppRouteTable1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "AppRouteTable-AZ1"

  AppRouteTable2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "AppRouteTable-AZ2"

  AppRouteTable3:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "AppRouteTable-AZ3"

  # Routes for application subnets to the NAT in the same AZ
  AppRoute1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Route"
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  AppRoute2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Route"
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  AppRoute3:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Route"
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  # Route table associations for application subnets
  AppSubnet1Association:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1

  AppSubnet2Association:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2

  AppSubnet3Association:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3

  # Route tables for database subnets (one per subnet)
  DbRouteTable1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "DbRouteTable-AZ1"

  DbRouteTable2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "DbRouteTable-AZ2"

  DbRouteTable3:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "DbRouteTable-AZ3"

  # Routes for database subnets to the NAT in the same AZ
  DbRoute1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Route"
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  DbRoute2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Route"
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  DbRoute3:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Route"
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  # Route table associations for database subnets
  DbSubnet1Association:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1

  DbSubnet2Association:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable2

  DbSubnet3Association:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable3

Outputs:

    Description: "The VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC

  AvailabilityZones:

    Value: !Join [",", [!Select [0, !GetAZs ""], !Select [1, !GetAZs ""], !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]]]

  WebSubnetIds:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of web subnet IDs"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Lab VPC with web and app subnets, shared route table, VPC endpoints for S3, Kinesis Firehose, and Kinesis Data Streams
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  WebSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR for web subnet in first AZ
  WebSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR for web subnet in second AZ
  AppSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR for app subnet in first AZ
  AppSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.4.0/24
    Description: CIDR for app subnet in second AZ
  AvailabilityZone1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Default: us-east-1a
    Description: First Availability Zone
  AvailabilityZone2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Default: us-east-1b
    Description: Second Availability Zone
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LabVPC
  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet1
  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet2
  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet1
  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet2
  SharedRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SharedRouteTable
  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable
  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable
  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable
  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable
  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for web tier allowing HTTPS from within VPC
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSecurityGroup
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: '*'
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref SharedRouteTable
  KinesisFirehoseEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-firehose
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  KinesisDataStreamsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-streams
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  WebSubnet1Id:
    Description: Web subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet1
  WebSubnet2Id:
    Description: Web subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet2
  AppSubnet1Id:
    Description: App subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet1
  AppSubnet2Id:
    Description: App subnet 2 ID

    Default: 'my-eks'
  SourceBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Description: 'ARN of the source S3 bucket for deployment asset copying'
    AllowedPattern: 'arn:aws:s3:::[a-z0-9.-]+'
    Default: 'arn:aws:s3:::placeholder-source-bucket'
  DestinationBucketArn:
    Type: String

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Creates IAM user/group for SES SMTP, generates SMTP credentials via Lambda, stores in Parameter Store."
Parameters:
  IAMUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: SMTPUser
    Description: "Desired IAM username for the SES SMTP user."
  AccessKeyRotationVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: "1"
    Description: "Version number for access key rotation; change to create new key and credentials."
  LambdaLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: "Retention days for Lambda CloudWatch logs."
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional ARN of customer-managed KMS key to encrypt SSM parameters. If empty, uses AWS managed key."
Resources:
  SESGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub "${IAMUsername}-Group"
  SESPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: SESEmailSendPolicy
      Groups:
        - !Ref SESGroup
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ses:SendEmail
              - ses:SendRawEmail
            Resource: "*"
  SESUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref IAMUsername
      Groups:
        - !Ref SESGroup
  SESUserAccessKey:
    Type: AWS::IAM::AccessKey
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref SESUser
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMWriteAndKMS
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:AddTagsToResource
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/SES/SMTP/${IAMUsername}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:ListAccessKeys
                  - iam:GetAccessKeyLastUsed
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:user/${IAMUsername}"
  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${IAMUsername}-SMTPCredentialGenerator"
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import hmac
          import hashlib
          import base64
          import boto3

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              props = event['ResourceProperties']
              access_key_id = props['AccessKeyId']
              secret_key = props['SecretAccessKey']
              username = props['Username']
              kms_key_arn = props.get('KmsKeyArn', '')
              version = props.get('AccessKeyRotationVersion', '1')

              if request_type in ['Create', 'Update']:
                  message = "SendRawEmail"
                  signature = hmac.new(secret_key.encode('utf-8'), message.encode('utf-8'), hashlib.sha256).digest()
                  smtp_password = base64.b64encode(signature).decode('utf-8')
                  smtp_username = access_key_id

                  params = [
                      {
                          'Name': f"/SES/SMTP/{username}/SMTPUsername",
                          'Value': smtp_username,
                          'Type': 'SecureString',
                          'Overwrite': True,
                          'Tier': 'Standard'
                      },
                      {
                          'Name': f"/SES/SMTP/{username}/SMTPPassword",
                          'Value': smtp_password,
                          'Type': 'SecureString',
                          'Overwrite': True,
                          'Tier': 'Standard'
                      }
                  ]
                  if kms_key_arn:
                      for p in params:
                          p['KeyId'] = kms_key_arn

                  for p in params:
                      try:
                          ssm.put_parameter(**p)
                      except Exception as e:
                          print(f"Error storing parameter {p['Name']}: {str(e)}")
                          raise e

                  physical_id = f"SMTPCreds-{username}-{version}"
                  return {
                      'PhysicalResourceId': physical_id,
                      'Data': {
                          'SMTPUsername': smtp_username,
                          'SMTPPassword': smtp_password
                      }
                  }

              elif request_type == 'Delete':
                  for suffix in ['SMTPUsername', 'SMTPPassword']:
                      try:
                          ssm.delete_parameter(Name=f"/SES/SMTP/{username}/{suffix}")
                      except ssm.exceptions.ParameterNotFound:
                          pass
                  return {
                      'PhysicalResourceId': event['PhysicalResourceId'],
                      'Data': {}
                  }

              else:
                  raise ValueError(f"Unsupported request type: {request_type}")
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/${AWS::StackName}/*"
  CustomResource:
    Type: Custom::SESSMTPCredentials
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
      AccessKeyId: !Ref SESUserAccessKey
      SecretAccessKey: !GetAtt SESUserAccessKey.SecretAccessKey
      Username: !Ref IAMUsername
      KmsKeyArn: !Ref KmsKeyArn
      AccessKeyRotationVersion: !Ref AccessKeyRotationVersion
  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${LambdaFunction}"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LambdaLogRetentionDays
Outputs:
  SMTPUsernameParameterName:
    Description: "SSM Parameter Store name for SMTP username"
    Value: !Sub "/SES/SMTP/${IAMUsername}/SMTPUsername"
  SMTPPasswordParameterName:
    Description: "SSM Parameter Store name for SMTP password"
    Value: !Sub "/SES/SMTP/${IAMUsername}/SMTPPassword"
  IAMUser:
    Description: "IAM user created for SES SMTP"
    Value: !Ref SESUser
  IAMAccessKeyId:
    Description: "Access key ID for the IAM user"
    Value: !Ref SESUserAccessKey

Parameters:

    Fn::Not:

              - ""

          - ""
Resources:

      AttributeDefinitions:

      SSESpecification:

      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl

  LambdaEnvKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting Lambda function environment variables
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: LambdaEnvKeyPolicy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAdminAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowLambdaServiceToEncrypt
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:lambda:FunctionArn: !Sub "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:${LambdaFunctionName}"
          - Fn::If:
              - HasAdditionalPrincipals
              - Sid: AllowAdditionalPrincipalsToDecrypt
                Effect: Allow
                Principal:
                  AWS: !Ref AdditionalDecryptPrincipals
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: "*"
              - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
  LambdaEnvKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias

      TargetKeyId: !Ref LambdaEnvKMSKey
  APIGWLogsKMSKey:

      Description: KMS key for encrypting API Gateway CloudWatch Logs log group
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: APIGWLogsKeyPolicy

          - Sid: EnableAdminAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:

            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"

              - kms:DescribeKey

    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias

      TargetKeyId: !Ref APIGWLogsKMSKey
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${LambdaFunctionName}-ExecutionRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ConnectionsTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: KMSDecrypt
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKMSKey.Arn
        - PolicyName: APIGatewayManageConnections
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketAPI}/*/*"
  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunctionName
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKMSKey.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref ConnectionsTableName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3, os, json, logging
          from datetime import datetime

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              route_key = event['requestContext']['routeKey']
              connection_id = event['requestContext']['connectionId']
              domain_name = event['requestContext']['domainName']
              stage = event['requestContext']['stage']
              endpoint_url = f"https://{domain_name}/{stage}"

              if route_key == '$connect':
                  logger.info(f"Connect request: {connection_id}")
                  table.put_item(
                      Item={
                          'connectionId': connection_id,
                          'connectedAt': int(datetime.utcnow().timestamp()),
                          'ttl': int(datetime.utcnow().timestamp()) + 86400
                      }
                  )
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Connected'}

              elif route_key == '$disconnect':
                  logger.info(f"Disconnect request: {connection_id}")
                  table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Disconnected'}

              elif route_key == 'message':
                  logger.info(f"Message from {connection_id}")
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
                  apigw_management = boto3.client('apigatewaymanagementapi', endpoint_url=endpoint_url)
                  response_data = {
                      'message': 'Status update received',
                      'data': body
                  }
                  try:
                      apigw_management.post_to_connection(
                          ConnectionId=connection_id,
                          Data=json.dumps(response_data)
                      )
                  except Exception as e:
                      logger.error(f"Failed to post to connection {connection_id}: {str(e)}")
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Message processed'}

              else:
                  logger.warning(f"Unknown route: {route_key}")
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': 'Unknown route'}
  WebSocketAPI:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api

    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketAPI
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn

  LambdaInvokePermission:

  WebSocketAPIDeployment:

    Properties:

  WebSocketAPIStage:

  APIGWCloudWatchRole:
