AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for serverless webhook handler integrating Stripe, Squarespace, and Slack via SNS. Note: Both StripeWebhookSecret and SquarespaceApiToken must be provided with valid values."

Parameters:
  StripeWebhookSecret:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Default: "CHANGE_ME"
    Description: "Stripe webhook signing secret for verifying incoming webhooks. Replace default value."
  SquarespaceApiToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Default: "CHANGE_ME"
    Description: "Squarespace API token for fetching order and inventory details. Replace default value."

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for encrypting SNS topic"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}-sns-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  SnsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: "SlackNotifications"
      TopicName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-slack-notifications"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "LambdaBasicExecution"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "arn:aws:logs:*:*:*"
        - PolicyName: "PublishToSNS"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref SnsTopic
        - PolicyName: "KMSEncryption"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-webhook-handler"
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: !Ref StripeWebhookSecret
          SQUARESPACE_API_TOKEN: !Ref SquarespaceApiToken
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SnsTopic
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, boto3, logging
          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          sns = boto3.client('sns')
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event['body'])
                  event_type = body.get('type', 'unknown')
                  event_id = body.get('id', 'unknown')
                  message = f"Stripe webhook received: {event_type} (ID: {event_id})"
                  sns.publish(TopicArn=os.environ['SNS_TOPIC_ARN'], Message=message)
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps({'received': True})}
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Error processing webhook: {e}")
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})}
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128

  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${LambdaFunction}"
      RetentionInDays: 14

  ApiGatewayRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-webhook-api"
      Description: "REST API for Stripe webhook handler"
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ApiGatewayResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: "webhooks"
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi

  ApiGatewayMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      HttpMethod: POST
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayResource
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations"

  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ApiGatewayRestApi}/*/POST/webhooks"

  ApiGatewayDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGatewayMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      StageName: "prod"
      StageDescription:
        MetricsEnabled: true
        LoggingLevel: INFO

  CloudWatchAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-lambda-errors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when Lambda function errors exceed 0 in 1 minute"
      Namespace: "AWS/Lambda"
      MetricName: "Errors"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Statistic: Sum
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: "URL of the webhook endpoint (POST /webhooks)"
    Value: !Sub "https://${ApiGatewayRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/webhooks"
  SnsTopicArn:
    Description: "ARN of the SNS topic for Slack notifications"
    Value: !Ref SnsTopic
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: "ARN of the KMS key used for SNS encryption"
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  ClientSecurityGroup:

  DaxSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup

  DaxSecurityGroupIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress

  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table

    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:

        - AttributeName: "orderId"

      KeySchema:

          KeyType: "HASH"
        - AttributeName: "orderId"

      BillingMode: "PAY_PER_REQUEST"
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: false
  DaxSubnetGroup:

    Type: AWS::DAX::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      SubnetGroupName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-dax-subnets"
      Description: "Subnet group for DAX cluster"

        - !Ref Subnet2
  DaxRole:
    Condition: EnableDaxCondition
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-dax-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dax.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "dax-dynamodb-access"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${DynamoDBTable.Arn}/index/*"
  DaxCluster:
    Condition: EnableDaxCondition
    Type: AWS::DAX::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-dax"
      NodeType: "dax.t3.small"
      ReplicationFactor: !Ref DaxReplicationFactor
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      SubnetGroupName: !Ref DaxSubnetGroup
      IAMRoleARN: !GetAtt DaxRole.Arn
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DaxSecurityGroup
Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: "DynamoDB table name"
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
  TableArn:
    Description: "DynamoDB table ARN"
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
  DaxStatus:
    Description: "DAX cluster status (cluster ID if enabled, otherwise disabled)"
    Value:

        - EnableDaxCondition
        - !GetAtt DaxCluster.Id
        - "disabled"
  ClientSecurityGroupId:
    Description: "Client security group ID"
    Value: !Ref ClientSecurityGroup
  DaxEndpoint:
    Description: "DAX cluster discovery endpoint or disabled"
    Value:
      Fn::If:
        - EnableDaxCondition
        - !GetAtt DaxCluster.ClusterDiscoveryEndpoint
        - "disabled"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for a self-contained ElastiCache Redis test environment with cluster mode, encryption, SNS topic, and IAM role for SSM Automation signals.
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/22
  Subnet1CIDR:
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
  Subnet2CIDR:
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
  CacheNodeType:
    Description: ElastiCache node type
    Type: String
    Default: cache.t3.micro
    AllowedValues:
      - cache.t3.micro
      - cache.t3.small
      - cache.t3.medium
  RedisEngineVersion:
    Description: Redis engine version
    Type: String
    Default: '7.0'
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ElastiCacheTestVPC
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet1
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet2
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTable
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  CacheSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ElastiCache Redis cluster
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
  CacheSecurityGroupIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt CacheSecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 6379
      ToPort: 6379
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt CacheSecurityGroup.GroupId
  CacheSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      Description: Subnet group for ElastiCache Redis cluster
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for ElastiCache encryption at rest and SNS topic encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow ElastiCache to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: elasticache.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow SNS to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      Enabled: true
  KMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/elasticache-test-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  RedisReplicationGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::ReplicationGroup
    Properties:
      ReplicationGroupDescription: ElastiCache Redis cluster with cluster mode, encryption, Multi-AZ
      Engine: redis
      EngineVersion: !Ref RedisEngineVersion
      CacheNodeType: !Ref CacheNodeType
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Ref CacheSubnetGroup
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt CacheSecurityGroup.GroupId
      AutomaticFailoverEnabled: true
      MultiAZEnabled: true
      NumNodeGroups: 2
      ReplicasPerNodeGroup: 1
      AtRestEncryptionEnabled: true
      KmsKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      TransitEncryptionEnabled: true
      ClusterMode: enabled
  SNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: ElastiCacheAlarmTopic
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  SNSTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref SNSTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: SNS:Publish
            Resource: !Ref SNSTopic
  SSMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SSMAutomationSignalRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
  SSMRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: SendAutomationSignalPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref SSMRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: ssm:SendAutomationSignal
            Resource: '*'
Outputs:
  ReplicationGroupConfigurationEndPoint:
    Description: Configuration endpoint of the ElastiCache Redis replication group (cluster mode)
    Value: !GetAtt RedisReplicationGroup.ConfigurationEndPoint.Address
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RedisConfigEndpoint'
  KMSKeyId:
    Description: KMS key ID used for encryption
    Value: !Ref KMSKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KMSKeyId'
  SNSTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic for CloudWatch alarms
    Value: !Ref SNSTopic
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SNSTopicArn'
  SSMRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for SSM Automation signals
    Value: !GetAtt SSMRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SSMRoleArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  SongsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  AppSyncApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SongsApi
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      XrayEnabled: true

  AppSyncSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      Definition: |-
        type Song {
          id: ID!
          name: String!
          artist: String!
        }
        type Query {
          getSongs: [Song]
        }
        type Mutation {
          addSong(name: String!, artist: String!): Song
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  AppSyncRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDB
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: !GetAtt SongsTable.Arn

  AppSyncDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      Name: SongsDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref SongsTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncRole.Arn

  NoneDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      Name: NoneDS
      Type: NONE

  ValidateArtistFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: NoneDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      Name: ValidateArtist
      DataSourceName: NoneDS
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          const artist = ctx.arguments.artist;
          if (!artist || !/^[A-Za-z]+$/.test(artist)) {
            throw new Error('Validation error: artist must contain only letters and cannot be empty.');
          }
          return ctx.arguments;
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  AddSongFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      Name: AddSong
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt AppSyncDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          const name = ctx.arguments.name;
          const artist = ctx.arguments.artist;
          const id = util.autoId();
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: { id: { S: id } },
            attributeValues: { name: { S: name }, artist: { S: artist } }
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  GetSongsResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getSongs
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt AppSyncDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "Scan"
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($context.result.items)

  AddSongResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addSong
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !Ref ValidateArtistFunction
          - !Ref AddSongFunction
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "payload": $util.toJson($context.arguments)
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($context.result)

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Cognito secured API with user pool, Lambda function, and API Gateway'
Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  MyLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-handler'
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              claims = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('authorizer', {}).get('claims', {})
              if claims:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'body': json.dumps({'claims': claims}),
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
                  }
              else:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Public endpoint, no token required'}),
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
                  }
      Timeout: 10

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api'
      Description: 'API secured by Cognito user pool'

  MeResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: me

  OpenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: open

  CognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cognito-authorizer'
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization

  MeMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MeResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CognitoAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MyLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  OpenMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref OpenResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MyLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - MeMethod
      - OpenMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      StageName: prod

  LambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MyLambdaFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/GET/*'

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: 'Cognito User Pool ID'
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  AppClientId:
    Description: 'Cognito App Client ID'
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  ApiUrl:
    Description: 'Base URL of the API'
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template to connect AWS account to marbot.io monitoring and alerting service.

Parameters:
  MarbotEndpointID:
    Type: String
    Description: Endpoint ID provided by marbot.io for your account.
    Default: 'REQUIRED'
  MarbotAccountID:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS Account ID of marbot.io's monitoring account.
    Default: '000000000000'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID.
  EnableAutomaticMonitoring:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Enable automatic CloudWatch alarm and monitoring rule configuration.
  EnableFriendlyAliases:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Enable enrichment of account IDs with friendly aliases.
  EnableMetricGraphs:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Enable embedding of metric graphs in CloudWatch alarm notifications.
  EnableCodePipelineApproval:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Enable approval or rejection of CodePipeline manual approval requests.

Conditions:
  IsAutoMonitoringEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableAutomaticMonitoring, 'true']
  IsFriendlyAliasesEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableFriendlyAliases, 'true']
  IsMetricGraphsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableMetricGraphs, 'true']
  IsCodePipelineApprovalEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableCodePipelineApproval, 'true']
  HasValidParameters: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref MarbotEndpointID, 'REQUIRED']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref MarbotAccountID, '000000000000']]
  IsBoundaryNeeded: !And
    - !Condition IsAutoMonitoringEnabled
    - !Condition HasValidParameters

Resources:
  MarbotApiKeySecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Condition: HasValidParameters
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'marbot-apikey-${MarbotEndpointID}'
      Description: API key for marbot.io EventBridge connection.
      SecretString: !Ref MarbotEndpointID

  MarbotEventBridgeConnection:
    Type: AWS::Events::Connection
    Condition: HasValidParameters
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'marbot-connection-${MarbotEndpointID}'
      Description: Connection to marbot.io API endpoint.
      AuthorizationType: API_KEY
      AuthParameters:
        ApiKeyAuthParameters:
          ApiKeyName: 'X-API-Key'
          ApiKeyValue: !Sub '{{resolve:secretsmanager:${MarbotApiKeySecret}::SecretString}}'

  MarbotApiDestination:
    Type: AWS::Events::ApiDestination
    Condition: HasValidParameters
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'marbot-destination-${MarbotEndpointID}'
      Description: API destination for marbot.io service.
      ConnectionArn: !GetAtt MarbotEventBridgeConnection.Arn
      HttpMethod: POST
      InvocationEndpoint: !Sub 'https://api.marbot.io/v1/endpoints/${MarbotEndpointID}'

  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: HasValidParameters
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: '/'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeApiDestination
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: events:InvokeApiDestination
                Resource: !GetAtt MarbotApiDestination.Arn

  ScheduledRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Condition: HasValidParameters
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'marbot-keepalive-${MarbotEndpointID}'
      Description: Scheduled rule to keep marbot.io connection alive every 30 days.
      ScheduleExpression: 'rate(30 days)'
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: MarbotTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt MarbotApiDestination.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              account: $.account
            InputTemplate: !Sub |
              {
                "action": "register",
                "accountId": "${AWS::AccountId}",
                "stackName": "${AWS::StackName}",
                "stackId": "${AWS::StackId}",
                "endpointId": "${MarbotEndpointID}"
              }

  CrossAccountRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: HasValidParameters
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'marbot-monitoring-role-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Ref MarbotAccountID
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                sts:ExternalId: !Ref AWS::StackId
      Path: '/'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CrossAccountPolicy
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [IsAutoMonitoringEnabled, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryPolicy, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

  CrossAccountPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: HasValidParameters
    Properties:
      Description: Permissions for marbot.io cross-account monitoring role.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CloudWatchMonitoring
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
              - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmHistory
              - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics

  PermissionsBoundaryPolicy:

  CustomResourceLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: HasValidParameters
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: '/'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaBasicExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: CrossAccountRoleAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:GetRole
                Resource: !GetAtt CrossAccountRole.Arn

  CustomResourceLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: HasValidParameters
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'marbot-register-${MarbotEndpointID}'
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.14
      Role: !GetAtt CustomResourceLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import cfnresponse
          import boto3
          import os

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  endpoint_id = event['ResourceProperties']['EndpointId']
                  stack_id = event['ResourceProperties']['StackId']
                  role_arn = event['ResourceProperties']['RoleArn']
                  external_id = event['ResourceProperties']['ExternalId']

                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Create' or event['RequestType'] == 'Update':
                      url = f'https://api.marbot.io/v1/endpoints/{endpoint_id}/register'
                      payload = {
                          'stackId': stack_id,
                          'roleArn': role_arn,
                          'externalId': external_id
                      }
                      data = json.dumps(payload).encode('utf-8')
                      req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method='POST')
                      req.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
                      with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
                          response_body = response.read().decode('utf-8')
                          if response.status != 200:
                              raise Exception(f'Registration failed: {response_body}')
                  elif event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      url = f'https://api.marbot.io/v1/endpoints/{endpoint_id}/deregister'
                      payload = {
                          'stackId': stack_id
                      }
                      data = json.dumps(payload).encode('utf-8')
                      req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method='POST')
                      req.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
                      with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
                          if response.status != 200:
                              pass

                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'error': str(e)})

    Type: Custom::MarbotRegistration
    Condition: HasValidParameters
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for Glue Data Catalog database, optional crawler, and optional Spark ETL job for data lake catalog and transform layer."

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: "dev"
    Description: "Environment for naming (dev, staging, prod)."
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "my-prefix"
    Description: "Prefix used to build resource names."
  SourceBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Default: "arn:aws:s3:::placeholder-bucket"
    Description: "ARN of the existing S3 bucket to be crawled (e.g., arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket)."
  SourceBucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Prefix within the source bucket for the crawler (e.g., 'data/' or empty for root). Do not include leading slash."
  CrawlerSchedule:
    Type: String
    Default: "cron(0 2 * * ? *)"
    Description: "Cron expression for the crawler schedule (default daily at 2 AM UTC)."
  CrawlerEnabled:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "true"
    Description: "Enable or disable the crawler (false does not create the crawler)."
  ETLJobEnabled:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: "Enable or disable the ETL job (false does not create the job)."
  WorkerType:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - G.1X
      - G.2X
      - G.4X
      - G.8X
    Default: G.1X
    Description: "Worker type for the Glue ETL job."
  WorkerCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 299
    Description: "Number of workers for the Glue ETL job."
  Timeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2880
    MinValue: 1
    Description: "Job timeout in minutes (default 2880 = 48 hours)."
  MaxConcurrentRuns:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: "Maximum concurrent runs for the Glue ETL job."
  ScriptLocation:
    Type: String
    Default: "s3://placeholder/script.py"
    Description: "S3 URI (e.g., s3://bucket/path/script.py) of the ETL script. Required if ETLJobEnabled is true."
  TargetBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "ARN of the target S3 bucket for ETL output (optional, empty if not used)."
  TargetPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Prefix within the target bucket for ETL output (e.g., 'output/' or empty for root). Do not include leading slash."
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1827
      - 3653
    Default: 30
    Description: "Retention period in days for the CloudWatch Log Group used by the ETL job."

Conditions:
  CrawlerEnabledCondition: !Equals [!Ref CrawlerEnabled, "true"]
  ETLEnabledCondition: !Equals [!Ref ETLJobEnabled, "true"]
  HasTargetBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetBucketArn, ""]]
  HasSourcePrefix: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SourceBucketPrefix, ""]]
  HasTargetPrefix: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetPrefix, ""]]

Resources:
  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "GlueDataLakeAccess"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Ref SourceBucketArn
                  - !If
                    - HasSourcePrefix
                    - !Sub "${SourceBucketArn}/${SourceBucketPrefix}*"
                    - !Sub "${SourceBucketArn}/*"
              - !If
                - HasTargetBucket
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:PutObject
                    - s3:DeleteObject
                    - s3:ListBucket
                  Resource:
                    - !Ref TargetBucketArn
                    - !If
                      - HasTargetPrefix
                      - !Sub "${TargetBucketArn}/${TargetPrefix}*"
                      - !Sub "${TargetBucketArn}/*"
                - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-catalog"
        Description: !Sub "Data catalog database for ${Environment} environment."

  GlueCrawler:
    Condition: CrawlerEnabledCondition
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-crawler"
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      Targets:
        S3Targets:
          - Path: !Join
              - ""
              - - "s3://"
                - !Select [5, !Split [":", !Ref SourceBucketArn]]
                - "/"
                - !Ref SourceBucketPrefix
      SchemaChangePolicy:
        UpdateBehavior: "LOG"
        DeleteBehavior: "LOG"
      RecrawlPolicy:
        RecrawlBehavior: "CRAWL_NEW_FOLDERS_ONLY"
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref CrawlerSchedule
      Configuration: |
        {
          "Version": 1.0,
          "CrawlerOutput": {
            "Partitions": { "AddOrUpdateBehavior": "InheritFromTable" }
          }
        }

  GlueJobLogGroup:
    Condition: ETLEnabledCondition
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws-glue/jobs/${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-etl-job"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  GlueJob:
    Condition: ETLEnabledCondition
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-etl-job"
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: "glueetl"
        ScriptLocation: !Ref ScriptLocation
        PythonVersion: "3"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--continuous-log-logGroup": !Ref GlueJobLogGroup
        "--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log": "true"
        "--job-bookmark-option": "job-bookmark-enable"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: !Ref MaxConcurrentRuns
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: !Ref Timeout
      WorkerType: !Ref WorkerType
      NumberOfWorkers: !Ref WorkerCount
      GlueVersion: "3.0"

Outputs:
  DatabaseName:
    Description: "Name of the Glue Data Catalog database."
    Value: !Ref GlueDatabase
  CrawlerName:
    Description: "Name of the Glue crawler (if enabled)."
    Value: !If [CrawlerEnabledCondition, !Ref GlueCrawler, "Not created"]
  ETLJobName:
    Description: "Name of the Glue ETL job (if enabled)."
    Value: !If [ETLEnabledCondition, !Ref GlueJob, "Not created"]
  GlueServiceRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the IAM role used by Glue services."
    Value: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: CloudFormation template for Datadog Policy Macro with Lambda function
Resources:
  DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.handler
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Received event: %s", json.dumps(event))

              request_id = event.get('requestId')
              fragment = event.get('fragment', {})
              params = event.get('templateParameterValues', {})

              try:
                  policy_type = params.get('PolicyType')

                  if policy_type == 'LogArchive':
                      new_fragment = {
                          "Version": "2012-10-17",
                          "Statement": [
                              {
                                  "Effect": "Allow",
                                  "Action": [
                                      "s3:GetObject",
                                      "s3:PutObject",
                                      "s3:ListBucket"
                                  ],
                                  "Resource": [
                                      "arn:aws:s3:::*",
                                      "arn:aws:s3:::*/*"
                                  ]
                              }
                          ]
                      }
                  elif policy_type == 'CloudTrail':
                      new_fragment = {
                          "Version": "2012-10-17",
                          "Statement": [
                              {
                                  "Effect": "Allow",
                                  "Action": [
                                      "s3:ListBucket",
                                      "s3:GetObject",
                                      "s3:GetBucketLocation"
                                  ],
                                  "Resource": [
                                      "arn:aws:s3:::*",
                                      "arn:aws:s3:::*/*"
                                  ]
                              }
                          ]
                      }
                  else:
                      new_fragment = fragment

                  response = {
                      "requestId": request_id,
                      "status": "success",
                      "fragment": new_fragment
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error("Error processing macro: %s", str(e))
                  response = {
                      "requestId": request_id,
                      "status": "failure",
                      "fragment": fragment,
                      "errorMessage": str(e)
                  }

              logger.info("Returning response: %s", json.dumps(response))
              return response
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
  DatadogPolicy:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Macro
    Properties:
      Name: DatadogPolicy
      FunctionName: !GetAtt DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction.Arn
Outputs:
  MacroName:
    Description: Name of the created CloudFormation macro
    Value: !Ref DatadogPolicy
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function backing the macro
    Value: !GetAtt DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction.Arn

    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::RoutingControl

      ControlPanelArn: !GetAtt ControlPanel.ControlPanelArn

    Default: PRX-AutoScalingOrgSinkRole
    Description: IAM role name for Auto Scaling event forwarding
Resources:
  CloudWatchAlarmStateChangeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: cloudwatch-alarm-state-change-to-org-sink
      Description: Forwards CloudWatch alarm state changes to organizational event bus
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.cloudwatch
        detail-type:
          - CloudWatch Alarm State Change
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref OrgCloudWatchEventBusArn
          Id: org-sink-alarm-state-change

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template to create a customer-managed KMS key with key alias, key rotation, and optional deletion alerts via EventBridge.'
Parameters:
  ParentAlertStack:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Name of an existing CloudFormation stack that exports an SNS topic ARN (output name: AlertTopicArn). Leave empty to skip alert creation.'
  Service:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL_SERVICES
    AllowedValues:
      - ALL_SERVICES
      - S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS
      - connect
      - dms
      - ssm
      - ec2
      - elasticfilesystem
      - es
      - kinesis
      - kinesisvideo
      - lambda
      - lex
      - redshift
      - rds
      - secretsmanager
      - ses
      - s3
      - importexport
      - sqs
      - workmail
      - workspaces
    Description: 'Service to restrict KMS key usage. ALL_SERVICES allows any service. S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS allows only S3 decryption (public access). Other values restrict cryptographic operations to that service.'
Conditions:
  HasParentAlertStack: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ParentAlertStack, '']]
  IsNotAllServices: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Service, 'ALL_SERVICES']]
  IsS3PublicAccess: !Equals [!Ref Service, 'S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS']
  IsSpecificService: !And
    - !Condition IsNotAllServices
    - !Not [!Condition IsS3PublicAccess]
Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - !If
            - IsSpecificService
            - Sid: AllowCryptoViaService
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
              Action:
                - 'kms:Encrypt'
                - 'kms:Decrypt'
                - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                - 'kms:DescribeKey'
              Resource: '*'
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  'kms:ViaService': !Sub '${Service}.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !If
            - IsS3PublicAccess
            - Sid: AllowS3PublicDecrypt
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
              Action:
                - 'kms:Decrypt'
              Resource: '*'
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  'kms:ViaService': !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
  KMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  KMSDeletionAlertRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Condition: HasParentAlertStack
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Alert for KMS key deletion/disable events for key ${KMSKey}'
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.kms
        detail-type:
          - AWS API Call via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventSource:
            - kms.amazonaws.com
          eventName:
            - ScheduleKeyDeletion
            - DisableKey
          requestParameters:
            keyId:
              - !Ref KMSKey
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn:
            Fn::ImportValue: !Sub "${ParentAlertStack}-AlertTopicArn"
          Id: AlertSNSTopic
Outputs:
  KeyId:
    Description: KMS Key ID
    Value: !Ref KMSKey
  KeyArn:
    Description: KMS Key ARN
    Value: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
  KeyAlias:
    Description: KMS Key Alias
    Value: !Ref KMSAlias

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Creates an Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager lifecycle policy and IAM role for EBS snapshot management of web servers."

Parameters:
  DailySnapshotScheduledAt:
    Type: String
    Default: "17:00"
    Description: "Time of day to trigger snapshots, in HH:MM format (24-hour)."
  SnapshotInterval:
    Type: Number
    Default: 24
    AllowedValues: [2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24]
    Description: "Interval in hours between snapshot operations."
  SnapshotRetainRule:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1
    Description: "Number of most recent snapshots to retain."
  LogicalName:
    Type: String
    Default: "WebServers"
    Description: "Logical name used to name resources (e.g., IAM role, policy tag)."
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: "production"
    AllowedValues: ["production", "test", "development"]
    Description: "Deployment environment for volume tagging."
  TagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: "createdby"
    Description: "Custom tag key to filter volumes."
  TagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "aws-cloudformation-templates"
    Description: "Custom tag value to filter volumes."

Resources:
  DataLifecycleManagerRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${LogicalName}-DataLifecycleManager-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service: "dlm.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "DLM-${LogicalName}-Policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "ec2:CreateSnapshot"
                  - "ec2:DeleteSnapshot"
                  - "ec2:DescribeSnapshots"
                  - "ec2:DescribeVolumes"
                  - "ec2:CreateTags"
                  - "ec2:DeleteTags"
                  - "ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute"
                Resource: "*"

  DataLifecycleManagerPolicy:
    Type: "AWS::DLM::LifecyclePolicy"
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "DLM policy for ${LogicalName} EBS snapshots"
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt DataLifecycleManagerRole.Arn
      PolicyDetails:
        PolicyType: "EBS_SNAPSHOT_MANAGEMENT"
        ResourceTypes:
          - "VOLUME"
        TargetTags:
          - Key: "Environment"
            Value: !Ref Environment
          - Key: !Ref TagKey
            Value: !Ref TagValue
        Schedules:
          - Name: "Daily Snapshots"
            CopyTags: true
            TagsToAdd:
              - Key: "Name"
                Value: !Sub "policy-${LogicalName}-${AWS::Region}"
            CreateRule:
              Interval: !Ref SnapshotInterval
              IntervalUnit: "HOURS"
              Times:
                - !Ref DailySnapshotScheduledAt
            RetainRule:
              Count: !Ref SnapshotRetainRule
      State: "ENABLED"

Outputs:
  LifecyclePolicyId:
    Description: "ID of the created DLM lifecycle policy"
    Value: !Ref DataLifecycleManagerPolicy
  ExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the IAM role used by DLM"
    Value: !GetAtt DataLifecycleManagerRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Enforces S3 Block Public Access at account level via scheduled SSM Automation"
Parameters:
  ScheduleRate:
    Type: String
    Default: "rate(1 day)"
    Description: "Schedule expression for the EventBridge rule"
  DocumentName:
    Type: String
    Default: "EnforceS3BlockPublicAccess"
    Description: "Name for the SSM Automation document"
Resources:
  SSMExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3BlockPublicAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock
                Resource: "*"
  EventBridgeExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartSSMAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${DocumentName}:*"
  AutomationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: !Ref DocumentName
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Enforce S3 Block Public Access at account level"
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: "IAM role ARN for automation execution"
          AccountId:
            type: String
            default: "{{global:ACCOUNT_ID}}"
            description: "AWS Account ID to apply the policy to"
        mainSteps:
          - name: "PutPublicAccessBlock"
            action: "aws:executeAwsApi"
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: PutPublicAccessBlock
              Role: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
              InputPayload:
                AccountId: "{{ AccountId }}"
                PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                  BlockPublicAcls: true
                  BlockPublicPolicy: true
                  IgnorePublicAcls: true
                  RestrictPublicBuckets: true
            description: "Execute PutPublicAccessBlock for the account"
  ScheduledRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    DependsOn:
      - AutomationDocument
    Properties:
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleRate
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${DocumentName}:$DEFAULT"
          Id: "EnforceS3BlockPublicAccessTarget"
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeExecutionRole.Arn
          Input: !Sub
            - '{"AutomationAssumeRole": "${SSMRoleArn}", "AccountId": "${AWS::AccountId}"}'
            - SSMRoleArn: !GetAtt SSMExecutionRole.Arn
Outputs:
  AutomationDocumentName:
    Description: "Name of the SSM Automation document"
    Value: !Ref DocumentName
  AutomationDocumentArn:
    Description: "ARN of the SSM Automation document"
    Value: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${DocumentName}"
  EventBridgeRuleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the EventBridge rule"
    Value: !GetAtt ScheduledRule.Arn
  SSMRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the IAM role used by SSM"
    Value: !GetAtt SSMExecutionRole.Arn
  EventBridgeRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the IAM role used by EventBridge"
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    Description: Project name used for naming resources and secret path.
  RequireSymbols:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Whether password policy requires symbols.
Conditions:
  RequireSymbolsCondition:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref RequireSymbols
      - "true"
Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentcore-gateway-pool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: !If
            - RequireSymbolsCondition
            - true
            - false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  CognitoUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain:
        Fn::Join:
          - ""
          - - !Ref "AWS::Region"
            - "-"
            - Fn::Select:
                - 0
                - Fn::Split:
                    - "-"
                    - Fn::Select:
                        - 2
                        - Fn::Split:
                            - "/"
                            - Ref: "AWS::StackId"
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  CognitoResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: agentcore-gateway
      Name: agentcore-gateway
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Admin access

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ClientSecretLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:CreateUserPoolClient
                  - cognito-idp:UpdateUserPoolClient
                  - cognito-idp:DeleteUserPoolClient
                  - cognito-idp:DescribeUserPoolClient
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${CognitoUserPool}"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:CreateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:UpdateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  ClientSecretFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.13
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import logging
          import traceback

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f"Received event: {json.dumps(event)}")
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              props = event['ResourceProperties']
              user_pool_id = props['UserPoolId']
              secret_name = props['SecretName']
              region = props.get('Region', 'us-east-1')
              resource_server_identifier = props.get('ResourceServerIdentifier', 'agentcore-gateway')
              project_name = props.get('ProjectName', 'unknown')

              cognito_client = boto3.client('cognito-idp', region_name=region)
              secrets_client = boto3.client('secretsmanager', region_name=region)

              try:
                  if request_type in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      client_name = 'agentcore-gateway-client'
                      scopes = [
                          f'{resource_server_identifier}/read',
                          f'{resource_server_identifier}/write',
                          f'{resource_server_identifier}/admin'
                      ]

                      if request_type == 'Create':
                          # Create the client and capture the secret
                          response = cognito_client.create_user_pool_client(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              ClientName=client_name,
                              GenerateSecret=True,
                              ExplicitAuthFlows=[],
                              AllowedOAuthFlows=['client_credentials'],
                              AllowedOAuthScopes=scopes,
                              AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient=True,
                              SupportedIdentityProviders=['COGNITO']
                          )
                          client_id = response['UserPoolClient']['ClientId']
                          client_secret = response['UserPoolClient']['ClientSecret']
                          physical_resource_id = client_id
                      else:  # Update
                          physical_resource_id = event['PhysicalResourceId']
                          client_id = physical_resource_id
                          # Update the client (may generate new secret)
                          response = cognito_client.update_user_pool_client(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              ClientId=client_id,
                              ClientName=client_name,
                              GenerateSecret=True,
                              ExplicitAuthFlows=[],
                              AllowedOAuthFlows=['client_credentials'],
                              AllowedOAuthScopes=scopes,
                              AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient=True,
                              SupportedIdentityProviders=['COGNITO']
                          )
                          # The update response may or may not contain the secret
                          # If not, we need to describe (but describe doesn't return secret)
                          # So we assume the update returns the secret when GenerateSecret=True
                          client_secret = response['UserPoolClient'].get('ClientSecret')
                          if not client_secret:
                              # Fallback: try to retrieve from existing secret (if any)
                              try:
                                  existing_secret = secrets_client.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret_name)
                                  secret_data = json.loads(existing_secret['SecretString'])
                                  client_secret = secret_data['clientSecret']
                              except:
                                  raise Exception('Unable to retrieve client secret during update')

                      # Store the secret
                      secret_value = json.dumps({
                          'clientId': client_id,
                          'clientSecret': client_secret,
                          'userPoolId': user_pool_id
                      })
                      try:
                          secrets_client.describe_secret(SecretId=secret_name)
                          secrets_client.update_secret(
                              SecretId=secret_name,
                              SecretString=secret_value
                          )
                          logger.info(f"Updated secret {secret_name}")
                      except secrets_client.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                          secrets_client.create_secret(
                              Name=secret_name,
                              SecretString=secret_value,
                              Description=f"Cognito OAuth2 client secret for {project_name}",
                              Tags=[{'Key': 'Project', 'Value': project_name}]
                          )
                          logger.info(f"Created secret {secret_name}")

                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      client_id = event['PhysicalResourceId']
                      # Delete the client
                      try:
                          cognito_client.delete_user_pool_client(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              ClientId=client_id
                          )
                          logger.info(f"Deleted client {client_id}")
                      except cognito_client.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                          pass
                      # Delete the secret
                      try:
                          secrets_client.delete_secret(
                              SecretId=secret_name,
                              ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery=True
                          )
                          logger.info(f"Deleted secret {secret_name}")
                      except secrets_client.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                          pass
                      physical_resource_id = client_id

                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                                   {'ClientId': client_id},
                                   physical_resource_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Error: {str(e)}\n{traceback.format_exc()}")
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED,
                                   {'Error': str(e)},
                                   event.get('PhysicalResourceId', ''))
